units.sanskrit: असौ वा आदित्य उद्गीथ एष प्रणवः । ओम् इति ह्य् एष स्वरन्न् एति ॥
units.english: This Sun verily is Udgītha and it is Praṇava;

units.sanskrit: वक्तव्यमित्यारभ्यतेअथ खलु य उद्गीथः स प्रणवो बह्वृचानां यश्च प्रणवस्तेषां स एव च्छान्दोग्य उद्गीथशब्दवाच्यः ।
units.english: because it moves along uttering Om Now, verily, that which is Udgītha is Praṇava,What is ‘Praṇava’ for the Ṛgvedins,that is precisely what, in the Sāmaveda, is spoken of by the name ‘Udgītha’

units.sanskrit: असौ वा आदित्य उद्गीथ एष प्रणवशब्दवाच्यो ऽपि स एव बह्वृचानां नान्यः ।
units.english: that is, what is spoken of, among Ṛgvedins by the name ‘Praṇava’ is this same Sun, not anything else

units.sanskrit: उद्गीथ आदित्यः कथम् । उद्गीथाख्यमक्षरमोमित्येतदेष हि यस्मात्स्वरन्नुच्चारयन्ननेकार्थत्वाद्धातूनाम् । अथवा स्वरन्गच्छन्नैति । अतो ऽसावुद्गीथः सविता ॥
units.english: Udgītha is the Sun;Why?because it is this syllable Om, which is named Udgītha, which this Sun utters;the word ‘svaran’ signifying utterance or pronunciation by reason of one and the same root having several meanings,or it may mean goes,and mooes along;and for this reason the Sun is Udgītha

units.sanskrit: एतम् उ एवाहम् अभ्यगासिषं तस्मान् मम त्वम् एको ऽसीति ह कौषीतकिः पुत्रम् उवाच ।
units.english: To Him verily did sing; hence thou art my only oneSo said Kauṣītaki to his son;Do thou reflect upon the Rays;

units.sanskrit: बहवो वै ते भविष्यन्ति ।
units.english: so wilt thou have many

units.sanskrit: इत्य् अधिदैवतम् ॥
units.english: This is as relating to Divinities

units.sanskrit: तेन तस्मात्कारणान्मम त्वमेको ऽसि पुत्र इति ह कौषीतकिः कुषीतकस्यापत्यं कौषीतकिः पुत्रमुवाचोक्तवान् ।
units.english: To Him verily did sing, addressed the song to Him,that is, reflected upon the Sun regarding Him as identical with the Rays;hence,for this reason,thou art my only oneSon; So said Kauṣītakithe son of Kuṣītaka,to his son

units.sanskrit: अतो रश्मीनादित्यं च भेदेन त्वं पर्यावर्तयात्पर्यावर्तयेत्यर्थः । त्वंयोगात् ।
units.english: For this reason, thou should reflect upon the Sun and the Rays as distinct from one anotherThe term ‘paryāvartayāt’ Third Person, Singular should be taken as ‘paryāvartaya’ Second Person Singular, because of the presence of the second person pronoun ‘Thou’

units.sanskrit: एवं बहवो वै ते तव पुत्रा भविष्यन्तीत्यधि दैवतम् ॥
units.english: Thus wilt thou have many sons This is as relating to Divinities

units.sanskrit: अथाध्यात्मम् । य एवायं मुख्यः प्राणस् तम् उद्गीथम् उपासित ।
units.english: Now with reference to the BodyThat which is the Breath in the Mouth,on that one should meditate as Udgītha;

units.sanskrit: ओम् इति ह्य् एष स्वरन्न् एति ॥
units.english: because it moves along pronouncing Om,

units.sanskrit: अथानन्तरमध्यात्ममुच्यते । य एवायं मुख्यः प्राणस्तमुद्गीथमुपासीतेत्यादि पूर्ववत् ।
units.english: Nowafter this,is described the Meditation in reference to the Body,That which is the Breath in the mouth,on that one should meditate as ‘Udgītha’ etc, etc,as above under Text

units.sanskrit: तथोमिति ह्येष प्राणो ऽपि स्वरन्नेत्योमिति ह्यनुज्ञां कुर्वन्निव वागादिप्रवृत्त्यर्थमेतोत्यर्थः ।
units.english: Similarly, this Breath also moves along pronouncing Om; that is, it moves along for the purpose of exciting speech and other functions, while pronouncing the syllable ‘Om’, thereby according permission, as it were, to the said functionings

units.sanskrit: न हि मरणकाले मुमूर्षोः समीपस्थाः प्राणस्योङ्कारणं शृण्वन्तीति ।
units.english: at the time of that a man is dying, persons near him do not hear the Breath pronouncing ‘Om’ as Speech and the other functions have ceased

units.sanskrit: एतत्सामान्यादादित्ये ऽप्योङ्करणमनुज्ञामात्रं द्रष्टव्यम् ॥
units.english: On this analogy, in the case of the Sun also, the pronouncing of ‘Om’ should be regarded merely as according permission

units.sanskrit: एतम् उ एवाहम् अभ्यगासिषं तस्मान् मम त्वम् एको ऽसीति ह कौषीतकिः पुत्रम् उवाच ।
units.english: This verily did sing to Him; hence thou art my only one,so said Kauṣītaki to his son;

units.sanskrit: प्राणांस् त्वं भूमानम् अभिगायताद् बहवो वै मे भविष्यन्तीति ॥
units.english: Thou shouldst sing to the Breaths as manifold,so that thou mayst have many

units.sanskrit: एतमु एवाहमभ्यगासिषित्यादि पूर्ववदेव ।
units.english: This verily did sing etc, etc as before

units.sanskrit: अतो वागादीन्मुख्यं च प्राणं भेदगुणविशिष्टगुद्गीथं पश्यन्भूमानं मनसाभिगायतात् । पूर्ववदावर्तयेत्यर्थः । बहवो वै मे मम पुत्रा भविष्यन्तीत्येवमभिप्रायः सन्नित्यर्थः ।
units.english: Hence one should view Speech and the other Breaths and the Breath in the Mouth as distinct from one another, and thus reflect in his mind, upon them as manifold,as before;the idea being that ‘by so doing many sons may be born to me The contemplation of Breath, and of the Sun, as, singly representing Udgītha is defective, in so far as it brings, as its reward, a single son, and, as such, should be discarded;

units.sanskrit: प्राणादित्यैकत्वोद्गीथदृष्टेरेकपुत्रत्वफलदोषेणापोदितत्वाद्रश्मिप्राणभेददृष्टेः कर्तव्यता चोद्यते ऽस्मिन्काण्डे बहुपुत्रफलत्वार्थम् ॥
units.english: and the contemplation of the manifold Rays of the Sun and the manifold Breaths, as representing Udgītha, what should be practised, as leading to better results in the shape of many sons;this is what has been taught in this section

units.sanskrit: अथ खलु य उद्गीथः स प्रणवो यः प्रणवः स उद्गीथ इति ।
units.english: Now, verily, that which is Udgītha is Praṇava; that which is Praṇava is Udgītha

units.sanskrit: होतृषदनाद् ध एवापि दुरुद्गीथम् अनुसमाहरतीत्य् अनुसमाहरतीति ॥
units.english: , one, from the seat of the Hotrpriest rectifies wrong singing;yea, he doth rectify it

units.sanskrit: अथ खलु य उद्गीथ इत्यादिप्रणवोद्गीथैकत्वदर्शनमपक्तं तस्यैतत्फलमाहर्तुं शक्यम् ।
units.english: That which is Udgītha etc In this text has been set forth the view that Udgītha and Praṇava are one; the reward of this knowledge is now described

units.sanskrit: किं तद्धैवापि दुरुद्गीतं दुष्टमुद्गीतमुद्गानं कृतमुद्गात्रा स्वकर्मणि क्षतं कृतमित्यर्थः । तदनुसमाहरत्यनुसन्धत्त इत्यर्थः ।
units.english: as no result can accrue from the mere seat What is that reward?It is thisWhatever may have been badly or wrongly sung by the UdgātṛPriest in course of the performance of his functions,ie whatever mistakes he may have committed,all that be rectifies, sets right;

units.sanskrit: चिकित्सयेव धातुवैषम्यसमीकरणमिति ॥
units.english: just as the disorders of the bodily humours are set right by proper medication

units.sanskrit: इति छान्दोग्योपनिषच्छाङ्करभाष्ये प्रथमाध्यायस्य पञ्चमः खण्डः
units.english: The Text is next going to lay down another method of meditating on the Udgītha, which is calculated to fulfil all desirable results

units.sanskrit: इयम् एवर्क् ।
units.english: This is Ṛk;

units.sanskrit: अग्निः साम ।
units.english: Fire is Sāma;

units.sanskrit: तद् एतद् एतस्याम् ऋच्य् अध्यूढं साम । तस्माद् ऋच्य् अध्यूढं साम गीयते ।
units.english: this Sāma rests upon this Ṛk; hence is the Sāma sung as resting upon the Ṛk

units.sanskrit: इयम् एव सा । अग्निर् अमः ।
units.english: This is Sā and Fire is ama;

units.sanskrit: तत् साम ॥
units.english: and that makes up Sāma

units.sanskrit: ऋचि पृथिवीदृष्टिः कार्या ।
units.english: that is, the Ṛk should be viewed as the Earth

units.sanskrit: तथाग्निः साम ।
units.english: Similarly, Fire is Sāman;

units.sanskrit: साम्न्यग्निदृष्टिः ।
units.english: that is, the Sāman should be viewed as Fire

units.sanskrit: कथं पृथिव्यग्न्योर् ऋक्सामत्वमिति ।
units.english: QuestionHow can Earth and Fire be regarded as Ṛk and Sāman respectively

units.sanskrit: उच्यते । तदेतत्तदेतदग्न्याख्यं सामैतस्यां पृथिव्यामृच्यध्यूढमधिगतमुपरिभावेन स्थितमित्यर्थः ।
units.english: AnswerThisWhat has been just spoken ofSāmanwhich has been called ‘Fire’,rests upon this Ṛk i

units.sanskrit: ऋचीव साम ।
units.english: the Earth;

units.sanskrit: तस्मादत एव कारणादृच्यध्यूढमेव साम गीयत इदानीमपि सामगैः । यथा च ऋक्सामनी नात्यन्तं भिन्ने अन्योन्यं तथैतौ पृथिव्यग्निद्वयं सामैकशब्दाभिधेयत्वमापन्नं साम ।
units.english: hence,for this reason,the Sāman is, even now, sung by Sāmavedins, as based upon the Ṛkverse Just as Ṛk and Sāman are not entirely different from one another, so also are Earth and Fire not entirely different from one another How so?ThisEarthis ‘Sā’, ie Earth is expressed by the letter ‘Sā’ which is one half of the name ‘Sāma’;

units.sanskrit: तस्मान्नान्योन्यं भिन्नं पृथिव्यग्निद्वयं नित्यसंश्लिष्टमृक्सामनी इव । तस्माच्च पृथिव्यग्न्योर् ऋक्सामत्वमित्यर्थः ।
units.english: Thus then the two, Earth and Fire, are not entirely different from each other they are always mingled together, exactly like Ṛk and Sāman,and thus Earth and Fire are Ṛk and Sāma

units.sanskrit: सामाक्षरयोः पृथिव्यग्निदृष्टिविधानार्थमियमेव साग्निरम इति केचित् ॥
units.english: Some people have suggested the explanation that the sentence’ This is sā and Fire is ama’ is meant to lay down the meditation upon the two letters of the name ‘Sāma’ as Earth and Fire

units.sanskrit: अन्तरिक्षम् एवर्क् ।
units.english: ‘The Sky, is Ṛk;

units.sanskrit: वायुः साम ।
units.english: the Air is Sāma;

units.sanskrit: तद् एतद् एतस्याम् ऋच्य् अध्यूढं साम । तस्माद् ऋच्य् अध्यूढं साम गीयते ।
units.english: this Sāma rests upon this Ṛk; hence is the Sāma sung as resting upon the Ṛk

units.sanskrit: अन्तरिक्षम् एव सा । वायुर् अमः । तत् साम ॥
units.english: The Sky is Sā, the Air is ama, and that makes up Sāma’ ‘The Heaven is Ṛk;

units.sanskrit: आदित्यः साम ।
units.english: the Sun is Sāma;

units.sanskrit: तद् एतद् एतस्याम् ऋच्य् अध्यूढं साम । तस्माद् ऋच्य् अध्यूढं साम गीयते ।
units.english: this Sāma rests upon this Ṛk; hence is the Sāma sung as resting upon the Ṛk

units.sanskrit: द्यौर् एव सा । आदित्यो ऽमः । तत् साम ॥
units.english: The Heaven is Sā, the Sun is āma,and that makes up Sāma

units.sanskrit: अन्तरिक्षमेवर्ग्वायुः सामेत्यादि पूर्ववत् ॥
units.english: The Sky is Ṛk and Air is Sāma etc etc as before

units.sanskrit: चन्द्रमाः साम ।
units.english: The Stars are Ṛk, the Moon is Sāma;

units.sanskrit: तद् एतद् एतस्याम् ऋच्य् अध्यूढं साम । तस्माद् ऋच्य् अध्यूढं साम गीयते ।
units.english: this Sāma rests upon this Ṛk Hence is the Sāma sung as resting upon the Ṛk The Stars are Sā, the Moon is ama; and that makes up Sāma

units.sanskrit: चन्द्रमा अमः ।
units.english: The Moon is the Lord of Stars;

units.sanskrit: तत् साम ॥
units.english: hence it is Sāma

units.sanskrit: अथ यद् एतद् आदित्यस्य शुक्लं भाः सैवर्क् । अथ यन् नीलं परःकृष्णं तत् साम ।
units.english: Now That which is the White Light in the Sun is Ṛk; that which is Blue, very black, is Sāma;

units.sanskrit: तद् एतद् एतस्याम् ऋच्य् अध्यूढं साम । तस्मद् ऋच्य् अध्यूढं साम गीयते ॥
units.english: this Sāma rests upon this Ṛk; hence is the Sāma sung as resting upon the Ṛk

units.sanskrit: अथ यदेतदादित्यस्य शुक्लं भाः शुक्ला दीप्तिः सैवर्क । अथ यदादित्ये नीलं परः कृष्णं परो ऽतिशयेन कार्ष्ण्यं तत्साम ।
units.english: Now, that which is white Light,the white effulgencein the Sunis Ṛk That which is Blue, very dark,extreme blackness,is Sāma;

units.sanskrit: तद्ध्येकान्तसमाहितदृष्टेर्दृश्यते ॥
units.english: this Blackness is perceived only by one who is able to concentrate his eyes absolutely upon the Sun

units.sanskrit: अथ यद् एवैतद् आदित्यस्य शुक्लं भाः सैव सा । अथ यन् नीलं परःकृष्णं तद् अमः ।
units.english: That which is the white Light in the Sun is Sō, and that which is Blue, the very black, is ama;

units.sanskrit: तत् साम । अथ य एषो ऽन्तरादित्ये हिरण्मयः पुरुषो दृश्यते हिरण्यश्मश्रुर् हिरण्यकेश आ प्रणखात् सर्व एव सुवर्नः ॥
units.english: and that makes up Sāma,Now that golden Personality who is seen within the Sun, with golden beard and golden hair, and golden all through to the very nailtips

units.sanskrit: ते एवैते भाः शुक्लकृष्णत्वे सा चामश्च साम ।
units.english: These two lights, the White and the Black, are respectively ‘Sā’ and ‘ama’

units.sanskrit: अथ य एषो ऽन्तरादित्ये आदित्यस्यान्तर्मध्ये हिरण्मयो हिरण्मय इव हिरण्मयः ।
units.english: Now that which is within the Sun,inside the Sun, within the Solar disc ‘golden’ as if made of gold;

units.sanskrit: न हि सुवर्णविकारत्वं देवस्य सम्भवति । ऋक्सामगेष्णत्वापहतपाप्मत्वासम्भवात् । न हि सौवर्णे ऽचेतने पाप्मादिप्राप्तिरस्ति येन प्रतिषिध्येत ।
units.english: It is not possible for a thing made of gold, which must be inanimate, to have any evil propensities which could be precluded by the qualification of ‘being free from evil’;also because no such ‘golden’ character is visible to the eye

units.sanskrit: चाक्षुषे चाग्रहणात् । अतो लुप्तोपम एव हिरण्मयशब्दो ज्योतिर्मय इत्यर्थः ।
units.english: For these reasons the two terms ‘Hiraṇmaya’, have to be taken in the metaphorical sense, standing for luminous

units.sanskrit: उत्तरेषवपि समाना योजना ।
units.english: The same interpretation is to be applied to the rest of the passage

units.sanskrit: पुरुषः पुरि शयनात्पूरयति वा स्वेना'त्मना जगदिति ।
units.english: The ‘personality, ‘Puruṣa’ is so called because it lies śete in the body puri, or because it pervades the entire universe with its self Pūrayati

units.sanskrit: दृश्यते निवृत्तचक्षुर्भिः समाहितचेतोभिर्ब्रह्मचर्यादिसाधनापेक्षम् ।
units.english: ‘Is seen’by persons who have withdrawn their physical eyes and have concentrated their mind, through such means as leading the life of the Religious Student and the like

units.sanskrit: तेजस्विनो ऽपि श्मश्रुकेशादयः कृष्णाः स्युरित्यतो विशिनष्टिहिरण्यश्मश्रुर्हिरण्यकेश इति ।
units.english: Inasmuch as even effulgent beards and hairs might be black, the text adds the qualification ‘with golden beard and golden hair’; the sense being that His hairs and beard also are luminous

units.sanskrit: आप्रणखात्प्रणखो नखाग्रं नखाग्रेण सह सर्वः सुवर्ण इव भारूप इत्यर्थः ॥
units.english: To the very nailtips,’‘praṇakha’ stands for the nailtips; the meaning therefore is that upto and including the nailtips, it is like one mass of gold, pure effulgence

units.sanskrit: तस्य यथा कप्यासं पुण्डरीकम् एवम् अक्षिणी ।
units.english: His eyes are like monkeyseat lotus

units.sanskrit: तस्योद् इति नाम ।
units.english: His name is Ut

units.sanskrit: स एष सर्वेभ्यः पाप्मभ्य उदितः ।
units.english: He is risen above all evils

units.sanskrit: उदेति ह वै सर्वेभ्यः पाप्मभ्यो य एवं वेद ॥
units.english: He verily rises above all evils who knows thus

units.sanskrit: तस्यैवं सर्वतः सुवर्णवर्णस्याप्यक्ष्णोर्वशेषः ।
units.english: Of the person who is all through of golden colour, there is a peculiarity in the eyes

units.sanskrit: कथं?तस्य यथा कपेर्मर्कटस्या'सः कप्यासः ।
units.english: How?‘Kapyāsa’ is the ‘āsa’, seat, of the ‘Kapi’, monkey;

units.sanskrit: आसेरुपवेशनार्थस्य करणे घञ् ।
units.english: the term ‘āsa’ being derived from the root ‘āsa’ to sit, with the ghañ affix

units.sanskrit: कपिपृष्ठान्तो येनोपविशति । कप्यास इव पुण्डरीकमत्यन्ततेजस्व्येवमस्य देवस्याक्षिणी ।
units.english: so that when the lotus is spoken of as ‘Kapyāsa’, ‘monkeyseat’, what is meant is that it is extremely bright and red;so the eyes of the Solar Person also are bright red

units.sanskrit: उपमितोपमानत्वान्न हीनोपमा । तस्यैवङ्गुणविशिष्टस्य गौणमिदं नामोदिति ।
units.english: Inasmuch as the Simile is an indirect one,the lotus being likened to the monkey’s seat, and the eyes being likened to the lotus,it cannot be regarded as incompatible with the dignity of the subject

units.sanskrit: कथं गौणत्वम् । स एष देवः सर्वेभ्यः पाप्मभ्यः पाप्मना सह तत्कार्येभ्य इत्यर्थः । य आत्मापहतपाप्मेत्यादि वक्ष्यति । उदित उद् इत उद्गत इत्यर्थः ।
units.english: Of this person, thus qualified, the indirect figurative name is ‘Ut’Why should this be regarded as the indirect name?‘He’This deity the Person in the Sun,‘above all evils’,above all evils along with their effects;the text is going to speak of ‘the Self being one in whom all evil has been destroyed’;‘has risen’, ‘Uditaḥ’ standing for Utitaḥ, risen above, passed beyond;

units.sanskrit: अतो ऽसावुन्नामा ।
units.english: hence He is named ‘Ut’

units.sanskrit: तमेवङ्गुणसम्पन्नमुन्नामानं यथोक्तेन प्रकारेण यो वेद सो ऽप्येवमेवोदेत्युद्गच्छति सर्वेभ्यः पाप्मभ्यः ।
units.english: One who knows this Deity as endowed with the qualities described above and as bearing the name ‘Ut’he also rises’ above, passes beyond, all evils

units.sanskrit: ह वा इत्यवधारणार्थौ निपातौ ।
units.english: The particles ‘ha’ and ‘vā’ indicate emphasis;

units.sanskrit: उदेत्येवेत्यर्थः ॥
units.english: he verily, surely, rises above evils

units.sanskrit: तस्यर्क् च साम च गेष्णौ ।
units.english: Ṛk and Sāma are His joints;

units.sanskrit: तस्माद् उद्गीथः । तस्मात् त्व् एव उद्गाता । एतस्य हि गाता ।
units.english: hence is the Udgītha, Hence one who sings this Deity, Ut is the Udgātṛ lit ‘singer of ut’

units.sanskrit: स एष ये चामुष्मात् पराञ्चो लोकास् तेषां चेष्ट देवकामानां च ।
units.english: He controls the regions above Him, as also the desires of the Deities This is in reference to the Deities

units.sanskrit: इत्य् अधिदैवतम् ॥ तस्योद्गीथत्वं देवस्या'दित्यादीनामिव विवक्षितत्वादाहतस्यर्क्च साम च गेष्णौ पृथिव्याद्युक्तलक्षणे पर्वणी ।
units.english: What the text means to describe now is the fact of the said Deity Person in the Sun being Udgītha, just like Āditya and others described above as Udgītha ‘Ṛk and Sāma are his joints’,they are his joints, in the shape of Earth and the rest as described above Earth standing for Ṛk and so on

units.sanskrit: सर्वात्मा हि देवः ।
units.english: The Deity in question is the Self ensouling all things;

units.sanskrit: परापरलोककामेशितृत्वादुपपद्यते पृथिव्यग्न्यृक्सामगेष्णत्वम् । सर्वयोनित्वाच्च ।
units.english: and inasmuch as he controls the lower as well as the higher regions, as also all desires, it is only right that the Earth and Fire, as Ṛk and Sāma, should be His joints;also because he is the origin of all things

units.sanskrit: यत एवमुन्नामाचासावृक्सामगेष्णश्च तस्मादृक्सामगेष्णत्वप्राप्तमुद्गीथत्वमुच्यते परोक्षेण परोक्षप्रियत्वाद्देवस्य तस्मादुद्गीथ इति ।
units.english: Inasmuch as this Deity is named ‘Ut’ and has the Ṛk and Sāma for his joints,this character of having Ṛk and Sāma for His joints makes him the Udgītha;this is what is asserted mystically,as the Deity is fond of mysticism,in the phrase ‘Hence is Udgītha’

units.sanskrit: तस्मात्तवेव हेतोरुदं गायतीत्युद्गाता ।
units.english: Hence,for this reason,the Priest who sings to the Ut is called the ‘UdgātṛPriest’;

units.sanskrit: यस्माद्ध्येतस्य यथोक्तस्योन्नाम्नो गातासावतो युक्तोद्गातेति नामप्रसिद्धिरुद्गातुः ।
units.english: that is, inasmuch as he is the singer ‘gātṛ’ of the aforesaid Deity named ‘Ut’, it is only right that he should be known as Udgātṛ; this is what fixes the name of the Udgātṛ Priest

units.sanskrit: स एष देव उन्नामा ये चामुष्मादादित्यात्पराञ्चः परागञ्चनादूर्ध्वा लोकास्तेषां लोकानां चेष्टे न केवलमीशितृत्वमेव चशब्दाद्धारयति च । स दाधार पृथिवीं द्यामुतेमामित्यादिमन्त्रवर्णात् ।
units.english: This same Deity named ‘Ut’ controls the regions that lie above Himie, the Sun; He is not only the Controller of the regions, but also the Upholder; this is what is implied by the particle ‘ca’; this idea is supported by such Vedic texts as ‘He upheld this Earth and also Heaven’Further, He controls also the desires of the Deities

units.sanskrit: किञ्च देवकामानामीष्ट इत्येतदधिदैवतं देवताविषयं देवस्योद्गीथस्य स्वरूपमुक्तम् ॥
units.english: This is in reference to the Deities; that is, herein has been described that form of the Udgītha which consists of the Deity End of Section of Discourse

units.sanskrit: अथाध्यात्मम् । वाग् एवर्क् ।
units.english: Now with reference to the Body Speech itself is Ṛk;

units.sanskrit: प्राणः साम ।
units.english: Breath is Sāma

units.sanskrit: तद् एतद् एतस्याम् ऋच्य् अध्यूढं साम । तस्माद् ऋच्य् अध्यूढं साम गीयते ।
units.english: This Sāma rests upon this Ṛk; hence is the Sāma sung as resting upon the Ṛk;

units.sanskrit: वाग् एव सा । प्राणो ऽमः ।
units.english: Speech itself is Sā and Breath is ama;

units.sanskrit: तत् साम ॥
units.english: and this makes up Sāma;

units.sanskrit: अथाधुनाध्यात्ममुच्यते ।
units.english: Now is going to be described the Meditation in reference to the Body

units.sanskrit: वागेवर्क्प्राणः साम । अधरोपरिस्थानत्वसामान्यात् ।
units.english: Speech itself is Ṛk, Breath is Sāma;this is on the analogy of their relative upper and lower position

units.sanskrit: प्राणो घ्राणमुच्यते सह वायुना, वागेव सा प्राणो ऽम इत्यादि पूर्ववत् ॥
units.english: It is the Olfactory Organ along with Air that is càlled ‘Breath’ here Speech is ‘Sa’, Breath is ‘ama’ etc, etc, as before

units.sanskrit: चक्षुर् एवर्क् ।
units.english: The eye itself is Ṛk;

units.sanskrit: आत्मा साम ।
units.english: the Self is Sāma;

units.sanskrit: तद् एतद् एतस्याम् ऋच्य् अध्यूढं साम । तस्माद् ऋच्य् अध्यूढं साम गीयते ।
units.english: this Sāma rests upon this Ṛk; hence is the Sāma sung as resting on the Ṛk

units.sanskrit: चक्षुर् एव सा । आत्मामः ।
units.english: The Eye itself is Sā, the Self is ama;

units.sanskrit: तत् साम ॥
units.english: and that makes up Sāma

units.sanskrit: चक्षुरेवर्गात्मा साम ।
units.english: The eye is Ṛk;

units.sanskrit: आत्मेति च्छायात्मा तत्स्थत्वात्साम ॥
units.english: The term ‘Self’ ‘ātmā’ here stands for the Shadow, Reflection of the Self;

units.sanskrit: श्रोत्रम् एवर्क् ।
units.english: The Ear itself is Ṛk;

units.sanskrit: मनः साम ।
units.english: the Mind is Sāma;

units.sanskrit: तद् एतद् एतस्याम् ऋच्य् अध्यूढं साम । तस्माद् ऋच्य् अध्यूढं साम गीयते ।
units.english: this Sāma rests upon this Ṛk; hence is the Sāma sung as resting upon the Ṛk

units.sanskrit: श्रोत्रम् एव सा ।
units.english: The Ear itself is ‘Sā’;

units.sanskrit: मनो ऽमः ।
units.english: the Mind is ‘ama’;

units.sanskrit: तत् साम ॥
units.english: and this makes up Sāma

units.sanskrit: श्रोत्रमेवर्ङ्मनः साम, श्रोत्रस्याधिष्ठातृत्वान्मनसः सामत्वम् ॥
units.english: The Ear is Ṛk, the Mind is Sāma; the Ear being the controller like Ṛk, the character of Sāma belongs to the Mind

units.sanskrit: अथ यद् एतद् अक्ष्नः शुक्लं भाः सैवर्क् । अथ यन् नीलं परःकृष्णं तत् साम ।
units.english: That which is the White Light in the Eye is Ṛk; that which is blue, very black, is Sāma;

units.sanskrit: तद् एतद् एतस्याम् ऋच्य् अध्यूढं साम । तस्माद् ऋच्य् अध्यूढं साम गीयते ।
units.english: this Sāma rests upon the Ṛk Hence is the Sāma sung as resting upon the Ṛk

units.sanskrit: अथ यद् एवैतद् अक्ष्णः शुक्लं भाः सैव सा । अथ यन् नीलं परःकृष्णं तद् अमः ।
units.english: That which is the White Light in the Eye is Sā that which is blue, very black, is ama;

units.sanskrit: तत् साम ॥
units.english: and that makes up Sāma

units.sanskrit: अथ यदेतदक्ष्णः शुक्लं भाः सैवर्क । अथ यन्नीलं परः कृष्णमादित्य इव दृक्शक्त्यधिष्ठानं तत्साम ॥
units.english: That which is the White Light in the Eye is Ṛk; and that which is blue, very black,which, like the Sun, is the subsubtratum of the faculty of vision, is Sāma

units.sanskrit: अथ य एषो ऽन्तर् अक्षिणि पुरुषो दृश्यते सैवर्क् ।
units.english: Now, that Person who is seen within the Eye, that, indeed, is Ṛk;

units.sanskrit: तत् साम ।
units.english: that is Sāma;

units.sanskrit: तद् उक्थम् ।
units.english: that is Uktha;

units.sanskrit: तद् यजुः ।
units.english: that is Yajuṣ;

units.sanskrit: तद् ब्रह्म ।
units.english: that is Brahman Veda

units.sanskrit: तस्य एतस्य तद् एव रूपं यद् अमुष्य रूपम् ।
units.english: His form is the same as the form of that other Person;

units.sanskrit: याव् अमुष्य गेष्णौ तौ तौ गोष्णौ ।
units.english: his joints are the same as the joints of that other Person;

units.sanskrit: यन् नाम तन् नाम ॥
units.english: his name is the same as the name of that other Person

units.sanskrit: अथ य एषो ऽन्तरक्षिणि पुरुषो दृश्यते ।
units.english: Now, that Person who is seen within the Eye etc, etc

units.sanskrit: पूर्ववत् । सैवर्गध्यात्मं वागाद्या पृथिव्याद्या चाधिदैवतम् ।
units.english: as before;that is Ṛk, appertaining to the Body; Speech and the rest and Breath and the rest appertaining to the Divinities

units.sanskrit: प्रसिद्धा च ऋक्पादबद्धाक्षरात्मिका ।
units.english: It is well known that the Ṛk verse has its component letters arranged in welldefined quarters

units.sanskrit: तथा साम ।
units.english: Similarly, it is Sāma

units.sanskrit: उक्थसाहचर्याद्वा स्तोत्रं सामोक्थं शस्त्रम् ।
units.english: It is Uktha, ie Śastrachant, as distinct from the aforementioned Stotra

units.sanskrit: उक्थादन्यत् तथा यजुः स्वाहास्वधावषडादि सर्वमेव वाग्यजुस्तत्स एव ।
units.english: It is Yajuṣ; the term stands for all such as ‘Svāhā’, ‘Svadhā’ ‘Vaṣaṭ’ and so forth; all this is Speech, and it is Yajuṣ;

units.sanskrit: सर्वात्मकत्वात्सर्वयोनित्वाच्चेति ह्यवोचाम ।
units.english: because he is the soul of all things and also the source of all things,as already explained by us

units.sanskrit: ऋगादिप्रकरणात्तद्ब्रह्मेति त्रयो वेदाः ।
units.english: As the present context is dealing with Ṛk and allied things, the term ‘brahman’ should be taken as standing for the Three Vedas

units.sanskrit: तस्यैतस्य चाक्षुषस्य पुरुषस्य तदेव रूपमतिदिश्यते । किं तद्यदमुष्या'दित्यपुरुषस्य ।
units.english: That same form is attributed to this Person in the Eye;What form?That form is the same as that of the Person in the Sun, that is ‘golden’ etc, as described in connection with the Divinities

units.sanskrit: हिरण्मय इत्यादि यदधिदैवतमुक्तम् ।
units.english: The ‘joints’ that have been described as those of the Solar Person are also the joints of the Person in the Eye

units.sanskrit: यच्चामुष्य नामोदित्युद्गीथ इति च तदेवास्य नाम ।
units.english: His name also is the same as that of that Person,viz, ‘Ut’ and ‘Udgītha’

units.sanskrit: स्थानभेदाद्रूपगिणनामातिदेशादीशितृत्वविषयभेदव्यपदेशाच्चा'दित्यचाक्षुषयोर्भेद इति चेत् । न ।
units.english: It might be argued that the Visual Person must be different from the Solar Person; because they occupy different positions, because the qualities and name of the one are attributed figuratively to the other, because there is difference in their spheres of influence, and because they are mentioned separatelyBut this would not be right;

units.sanskrit: अमुनानेनैवेत्येकस्योभयात्मप्राप्त्यनुपपत्तेः । द्विधाभावेनोपपद्यत इति चेत् । वक्ष्यति हि स एकधा भवति त्रिधा भवतीत्यादि । न ।
units.english: Such identification with two Personalities might be possible through bifurcation ;in fact, the Upaniṣad itself is going to declare that ‘He becomes one, two, three etc, etc’That is not possible;

units.sanskrit: चेतनस्यैकस्य निरवयवत्वाद्द्विधाभावानुपपत्तेः ।
units.english: that which is of the nature of pure Intelligence, and hence without any constituent parts, cannot become bifurcated

units.sanskrit: तस्मादध्यात्माधिदैवतयोरेकत्वमेव ।
units.english: Hence the Bodily and the Divine Persons must be one and the same

units.sanskrit: यत्तु रूपाद्यतिदेशो भेदकारणमवोचो न तद्भेदावगमाय । किं तर्हि स्थानभेदाद्भेदाशङ्का मा भूदित्येवमर्थम् ॥
units.english: As regards the figurative attribution of form etc, which you have brought forward as the ground of differentiation,it does not indicate difference at all; it is only meant to preclude the notion of difference that might arise on account of the difference in their position

units.sanskrit: स एष ये चैतस्माद् अर्वाञ्चो लोकास् तेषां चेष्टे मनुष्यकामानां चेति ।
units.english: He controls the regions below this, and also the desires of Men

units.sanskrit: तद् य इमे वीणायां गायन्त्य् एतं ते गायन्ति । तस्मात् ते धनसनयः ॥
units.english: Hence those who sing to the lute sing to Him and hence they become acquirers of wealth

units.sanskrit: स एष चाक्षुषः पुरुषो ये चैतस्मादाध्यात्मिकादात्मनोर्ऽवाञ्चोर्ऽवाग्गता लोकास्तेषां चेष्टे मनुष्यसम्बन्धिनां च कामानाम् ।
units.english: This Person in the Eye controls all those regions that lie below thisie below this bodily physical self,and also the desires relating to human beings

units.sanskrit: तत्स्माद्य इमे वीणायां गायन्ति गायकस्त एतमेव गायन्ति ।
units.english: Hence for this reason,those singers who sing to the lute really sing to this Self;

units.sanskrit: यस्मादीश्वरं गायन्ति तस्मात्ते धनसनयो धनलाभयुक्ता धनवन्त उत्यर्थः ॥
units.english: and because they sing to this controller Lord, therefore they become acquirers of wealth, supplied with wealth, ie wealthy

units.sanskrit: अथ य एतद् एवं विद्वान् साम गायत्य् उभौ स गायति ।
units.english: Now, he who, knowing thus, sings Sāman, sings to both

units.sanskrit: सो ऽमुनैव स एष ये चामुष्मात् पराञ्चो लोकास् तांश् चाप्नोति देवकामांश् च ॥
units.english: Such a one obtains, through that same, those regions that lie above that, as also the desires of the Divinities

units.sanskrit: अथ य एतदेवं विद्वान्यथोक्तं देवमुद्गीथं विद्वान्साम गायत्युभौ स गायति चाक्षुषमादित्यं च । तस्यैवंविदः फलमुच्यतेसो ऽमुनैवा'दित्येन स एष ये चामुष्मात्पराञ्चो लोकास्तांश्चा'प्नोति आदित्यान्तर्गतदेवो भूत्वेत्यर्थो देवकामांश्च ॥
units.english: Now, one who knowing this,knowing the deity Udgītha as described above,sings Sāman, sings to both,ie to the Visual as well as the Solar Person The text next describes the reward that comes to one who knows this Through that sameie, through the Solar Person,such a one obtains regions that lie above Him,that is, by having become the divinity within the Sun,and also the ‘desires of the deities’

units.sanskrit: अथानेनैव ये चैतस्माद् अर्वाञ्चो लोकास् तांश् चाप्नोति मनुष्यकामांश् च ।
units.english: And through this same, one obtains the regions that lie beneath Him, as also the desires of men

units.sanskrit: तस्माद् उ हैवंविद् उद्गाता ब्रूयात् ॥ कं ते कामम् आगायानीति । एष ह्य् एव कामागानस्येष्टे य एवं विद्वान् साम गायति साम गायति ॥
units.english: Hence, verily, the Udgātṛ Priest knowing this, should say to the sacrificerWhat desire may sing out for thee?Because one who, knowing this, sings Sāma becomes capable of singing out the fulfilment of desires

units.sanskrit: अथानेनैव चाक्षुषेणैव ये चैतस्मादर्वाञ्चो लोकास्तांश्चा'प्नोति मनुष्यकामांश्च चाक्षुषो भूत्वेत्यर्थः ।
units.english: Now, through this same,Visual Person himself,one obtains the regions that lie below Him, as also the desires of Menthat is, on having become the Visual Person

units.sanskrit: तस्मादु हैवंविदुद्गाता ब्रूयाद्यजमानं कमिष्टं ते तव काममागायानीति । एष हि यस्मादुद्गाता कामागानस्योद्गानेन कामं सम्पादयितुमीष्टे समर्थ इत्यर्थः । को ऽसौ?य एवं विद्वान्साम गायति साम गायति ।
units.english: Hence, knowing this, the Udgātṛ Priest should say to the sacrificer‘What desiredesired thing,may sing for Thee?’Because the Udgātṛ Priest, knowing this, is capable of singing out the fulfilment of desires,ie bringing about the fulfilment of the desired end by means of singing;Who is so capable?He who, knowing this, sings Sāma

units.sanskrit: द्विरुक्तिरुपासनसमाप्त्यर्था ॥ इति छान्दोग्योपनिषच्छाङ्करभाष्ये प्रथमोध्यायस्य सप्तमः खण्डः
units.english: The repetition of the phrase ‘sings Sāma’ is meant to indicate the conclusion of the account of the particular form of meditation

units.sanskrit: त्रयो होद्गीथे कुशला बभूवुः शिलकः शालावत्यश् चैकितायनो दाल्भ्यः प्रवाहणो जैवलिर् इति ।
units.english: There were three persons who were experts in UdgīthaŚilakaŚālāvatya, CaikitānaDālbhya and PravāhaṇaJaibali

units.sanskrit: ते होचुर् उद्गीथे वै कुशलाः स्मो हन्तोद्गीथे कथां वदाम इति ॥
units.english: They saidWe are experts in Udgītha let us carry on a discussion on Udgītha

units.sanskrit: अनेकधोपास्यत्वादक्षरस्य प्रकारान्तरेण परोवरीयस्त्वगुणफलमुपासनान्तरमानिनाय । इतिहासस्तु सुखावबोधनार्थः ।
units.english: The syllable ‘Om’ lends itself to being meditated upon in several ways; hence the Text has introduced another method of meditation, calculated to bring its reward in the shape of the quality of being the highest and best The story has been brought in for the purpose of making the subject easily comprehensible

units.sanskrit: त्रयस्त्रिसंख्याकाः । ह, इत्यैतिह्यार्थः ।
units.english: ‘Three’persons three in number;the particle ‘ha’ indicates the fact that such is the popular belief,were ‘Experts’

units.sanskrit: उद्गीथ उद्गीथज्ञानं प्रति कुशला निपुणा बभूवुः । कस्मिंश्चिद्देशे काले च निमित्ते वा समेतानामित्यभिप्रायः ।
units.english: wellversed;‘in Udgītha’,in the science of Udgītha;that is, among persons who had gathered together for some purpose, at a particular time and place;

units.sanskrit: न हि सर्वस्मिञ्जगति त्रयाणामेव कौशलमुद्गीथादिविज्ञाने ।
units.english: certainly, it is not possible that in the whole world there should be only three persons, wellversed in Udgītha and the related subjects;

units.sanskrit: श्रूयन्ते ह्युषस्तिजानश्रुतिकैकेयप्रभृतयः सर्वज्ञकल्पाः ।
units.english: in fact, we hear of many such persons as Uṣasti, Jānaśruti, Kaikeya and others who were wellnigh omniscient

units.sanskrit: के ते त्रय इत्याहशिलको नामतः शलावतो ऽपत्यं शालावत्यः । चिकितायनस्यापत्यं चैकितायनः ।
units.english: The Text next mentions who these three experts were Śilaka, by name, the ‘Śālāvatya’, ie, the son of Śalāvat; ‘Caikitāyana the son of Cikitāyana, of the gotra of Dalbha;

units.sanskrit: दल्भगोत्रो दाल्भ्यो द्व्यामुष्यायणो वा । प्रवाहणो नामतो जीवलस्यापत्यं जैवलिरित्येते त्रयस्ते होचुरन्योन्यमुद्गीथे वै कुशला निपुणा इति प्रसिद्धाः स्मः ।
units.english: or he may have been the son of both Cikitāyana and Dalbha being the bodyborn son of one and the adopted son of the other;and Pravāhaṇa, by name, the ‘Jaibali’, the son of Jībala;these were the three They said to each otherWe are known to be expertswellversedin Udgītha;

units.sanskrit: अतो हन्त यद्यनुमतिर्भवतामुद्गीथ उद्गीथज्ञाननिमित्तां कथां विचारणां पक्षप्रतिपक्षोपन्यासेन वदामो वादं कुर्म इत्यर्थः ।
units.english: hence, well,if you agree,let us carry on discussion,debate, through the system of setting forth the two sides of the question,the correct view and its contrary,on Udgīthā,ie, on the science, relating to the Udgītha;

units.sanskrit: तथा च तद्विद्यसंवादे विपरीतग्रहणनाशो ऽपूर्वविज्ञानोपजनः संशयनिवृत्तिश्चेति ।
units.english: and such discussion among persons knowing the subject leads to the rejection of the wrong view and the establishment of the correct view, not quite well known before, and also the setting aside of all doubts on the subject

units.sanskrit: अतस्तद्विद्यसंयोगः कर्तव्य इति चेतिहासप्रयोजनम् । दृश्यते हि शिलकादीनाम् ॥
units.english: For this reason, persons conversant with the subject should be brought together;such is the teaching meant to be conveyed by the story;the sense being that, that the said results have followed from discussions is found to have been a fact in the case of the said sages, Śilaka and the rest

units.sanskrit: तथेति ह समुपविविशुः ।
units.english: Having said Be it so, they sat down

units.sanskrit: स ह प्रावहणो जैवलिर् उवाच ।
units.english: Then Pravāhaṇa Jaibali saidYou revered Sirs, speak first;

units.sanskrit: भ्रामणयोर् वदतोर् वाचं श्रोष्यामीति ॥
units.english: shall listen to the talk of two Brāhmaṇas conversing

units.sanskrit: तथेत्युक्त्वा ते समुपविविशुर्हेपविष्टवन्तः किल । तत्र राज्ञः प्रागल्भ्योपपत्तेः स ह प्रवाहणो जैवलिरुवाचेतरौभगवन्तौ पूजावन्तावग्रे पूर्वं वदताम् ।
units.english: Having said ‘Be it so’, they sat down So it it said Where they had sat down, inasmuch as the Kṣattriya is by his very nature, more forward, Pravāhaṇa Jaibali said to the other twoYou revered Sirs,you who deserve all honour,speak firstbefore others

units.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणयोरिति लिङ्गाद्राजासौ ।
units.english: The term ‘to two Brāhmaṇas’ is indicative of the fact that the speaker himself was a Kṣattriya

units.sanskrit: युवयोर्ब्राह्मणयोर्वदतोर्वाचं श्रोष्यामि । अर्थरहितामित्यपरे वाचमिति विशेषणात् ॥
units.english: While you two Brāhmaṇas are conversing, shall listen to your conversation Some people explain the qualifing term ‘vācam’, ‘talk, to mean mere words without much sense,

units.sanskrit: स ह शिलकः शालावत्यश् चैकितायनं दाल्भ्यम् उवाच हन्त त्वा पृच्छानीति ।
units.english: ‘Thereupon, Śilaka Śālavatya said to CaikitāyanaDālbhyaWell, may question you?Do question said the other’

units.sanskrit: उक्तयोः स ह शिलकः शालावत्यश्चैकितायनं दाल्भ्यमुवाचहन्त यद्यनुमंस्यसे त्वा त्वां पृच्छानीत्युक्त इतरःपृच्छेति होवाच
units.english: On the two men being thus addressed, Śilaka Śālāvatya said to Caikitāyana DālbhyaWell, if you will permit, may question youBeing thus addressed, the other said Do question

units.sanskrit: का साम्नो गतिर् इति । स्वर इति होवाच । स्वरस्य का गतिर् इति । प्राण इति होवाच ।
units.english: What is the essence of Sāma?AnswerAccentWhat is the essence of accent?Answer‘Breath What is the essence of Breath?

units.sanskrit: अन्नस्य का गतिर् इति ।
units.english: AnswerFoodWhat is the essence of Food?AnswerWater

units.sanskrit: आप इति होवाच ॥ लब्धानुमतिराहका साम्नः, प्रकृतत्वादुद्गीथस्य ।
units.english: Having obtained permission, he saidOf Sāma,which stands here for Udgītha, which forms the subjectmatter of the discourse;

units.sanskrit: उद्गीथो ह्यत्रोपास्यत्वेन प्रकृतः ।
units.english: it is Udgītha asto be meditated upon which forms the subjectmatter of the discourse;

units.sanskrit: परोवरीयांसमुद्गीथमिति च वक्ष्यति । गतिराश्रयः परायणमित्येतत् ।
units.english: the text also is going to declare Udgītha is the highest and best,what is the essence,the substratum, the ultimate basis?

units.sanskrit: एवं पृष्टो दाल्भ्य उवाचस्वर इति ।
units.english: Being thus’ questioned, Dālbhya answeredAccent’;

units.sanskrit: स्वरात्मकत्वात्साम्नः ।
units.english: because Sāma is made up of accent;

units.sanskrit: यो यदात्मकः स तद्गतिस्तदाश्रयश्च भवतीति युक्तं मृदाश्रय इव घटादिः ।
units.english: when one thing is made up of another, it is said to have that for its essence, its ultimate basis; as for instance, the Jar and other objects made of clay have clay for their essence

units.sanskrit: स्वरस्य का गतिरिति,
units.english: What is the essence of accent?

units.sanskrit: प्राण इति होवाच ।
units.english: AnswerBreath;

units.sanskrit: प्राणनिष्पाद्यो हि स्वरस्तस्मात्सवरस्य प्राणो गतिः ।
units.english: it is through Breath that Accent is produced; hence Breath is the essence of Accent

units.sanskrit: प्राणस्य का गतिरित्यन्नमिति होवाच ।
units.english: What, is the essence of Breath?

units.sanskrit: अन्नावष्टम्भो हि प्राणः ।
units.english: AnswerFood; as Breath is supported by Food;

units.sanskrit: शुष्यति वै प्राण ऋते ऽन्नातिति हि श्रुतेः ।
units.english: as declared by the Śruti texts Breath dries up without food and Food is the string

units.sanskrit: अन्नस्य का गतिरित्याप इति होवाच ।
units.english: What is the Essence of food?

units.sanskrit: अप्सम्भवत्वादन्नस्य ॥
units.english: AnswerWater,as Food is produced out of Water

units.sanskrit: अपां का गतिर् इति । असौ लोक इति होवाच । अमुष्य लोकस्य का गतिर् इति । न स्वर्गं लोकम् अतिनयेद् इति होवाच ।
units.english: What is the essence of Water?AnswerThat other RegionWhat is the essence of that other Region?AnswerOne should not carry the Region of Heaven;

units.sanskrit: स्वर्गं वयं लोकं सामाभिसंस्थापयामः ।
units.english: we base the Sāma on the Region of Heaven too far;

units.sanskrit: स्वर्गसंस्तावं हि सामेति ॥
units.english: because Sāma has been eulogised as Heaven

units.sanskrit: अपां का गतिरित्यसौ लोक इति ।
units.english: What is the essence of Water?That other Region’;

units.sanskrit: अमुष्माल्लोकाद्वृष्टिः सम्भवति ।
units.english: because it is from that other Region that rain proceeds

units.sanskrit: अमुष्य लोकस्य का गतिरिति पृष्टो दाल्भ्य उवाचस्वर्गममुं लोकमतीत्याश्रयान्तरं साम न नयेत्कश्चिदिति होवाचा'ह ।
units.english: On being askedWhat is the essence of that other Region?Dālbhya saidOne should not carrySāmatoo farbeyond, to any other substratum than,that Region of Heaven

units.sanskrit: अतो वयमपि स्वर्गं लोकं सामाभिसंस्थापयामः ।
units.english: It is for this reason that we also base the

units.sanskrit: स्वर्गलोकप्रतिष्ठं साम जानीम इत्यर्थः । स्वर्गसंस्तावं स्वर्गत्वेन संस्तवनं संस्तावो यस्य तत्साम स्वर्गसंस्तावं हि यस्मात्स्वर्गो वै लोकः सामवेदैति श्रुतिः ॥
units.english: Sāma on the Region of Heaven; that is, we regard Sāma as based upon the Heavenly Region Because Sāma has been eulogised as Heaven,ie, it is as Heaven that Sāma has been eulogised as declared in the Śruti textThe Region of Heaven is SāmaVeda

units.sanskrit: तं ह शिलकः शालावत्यश् चैकितायनं दाल्भ्यम् उवाचाप्रतिष्ठितं वै किल ते दाल्भ्य साम ।
units.english: Śilaka Śālāvatya said to Caikitāyana DālbhyaVerily, O Dālbhya, your Sāma is not wellestablished

units.sanskrit: यस् त्व् एतर्हि ब्रूयान् मूर्धा ते विपतिष्यतीति मूर्धा ते विपतेद् इति ॥
units.english: If, now, some one were to tell you, your head shall fall, surely your head would fall

units.sanskrit: तमितरः शिलकः शालावत्यश्चैकितायनं दाल्भ्यमुवाचअप्रतिष्ठितमसंस्थितं परोवरीयस्त्वेनासमाप्तगति सामेत्यर्थः ।
units.english: Thereupon, the other person, Śilaka Śālāvatya said to Caikitāyana DālbhyaYour Sāma verily is not wellestablished,that is, not securely based upon an ultimate substratum and hence established as the highest and best

units.sanskrit: वा इत्यागमं स्मारयति किलेति च,
units.english: The particle ‘vā’, as also the particle ‘ca’ indicates the scripture bearing upon the point

units.sanskrit: दाल्भ्य ते तव साम । यस्त्वसहिष्णुः सामविदेतर्ह्येतस्मिन्काले ब्रूयात्कश्चिद्विपरीतविज्ञानमप्रतिष्ठितं साम प्रतिष्ठितमित्येवंवादापराधिनं मूर्धा शिरस्ते विपतिष्यति
units.english: O Dālbhya, as you put it, the Sāma is not wellestablishedIf some one, knowing the true character of Sāma, were to take offence at your representation of it, and were, at this time, to say to one whose idea of Sāma is wrong, and who may be committing the serious offence of misrepresenting the insecurely established Sāma as wellestablished, that ‘your head shall fall,shall fall off completely’,then this head of yours,who have committed the said offence,would surely fall;

units.sanskrit: विस्पष्टं पतिष्यतीति ।
units.english: there can be no doubt

units.sanskrit: एवमुक्तस्यापराधिनस्तथैव तद्विपतेन्न संशयो न त्वाहं ब्रवीमीत्यभिप्रायः ।
units.english: do not say this to you, however,this is what is meant’

units.sanskrit: ननु मूर्धपातार्ऽहं चेदपराधं कृतवानतः परेणानुक्तस्यापि पतेन्मूर्धा;
units.english: ObjectionIf the man has really committed the offence for which the head should fall,it should fall off, even without his being told so;

units.sanskrit: न चेदपराध्युक्तस्यापि नैव पतति ।
units.english: and if the offence is not one for which the offender’s head should fall off, then, it would not fall, even on his being told so

units.sanskrit: अन्यथाकृताभ्यागमः कृतनाशश्च स्याताम् ।
units.english: Otherwise if one’s head were to fall off simply because of some one telling him it would fall, then there would be the incongruity of something accruing to the man which he had not earned by his deeds, and also his being deprived of what he had earned

units.sanskrit: नैष दोषः ।
units.english: AnswerThis does not affect our position;

units.sanskrit: कृतस्य कर्मणः शुभाशुभस्य फलप्राप्तेर्देशकालनिमित्तापेक्षत्वात् ।
units.english: as a matter of fact, the actual accruing of the results of one’s good and bad deeds is dependent upon the conditions of place, time and other accessory causes

units.sanskrit: तत्रैवं सति मूर्धपातनिमित्तस्याप्यज्ञानस्य पराभिव्याहारनिमित्तापेक्षत्वमिति ॥
units.english: Such being the case, even though the offence of Ignorance be the cause of the falling of the head, yet its actual occurrence may be dependent upon some one uttering the imprecation

units.sanskrit: हन्ताहम् एतद् भगवत्तो वेदानीति । विद्धीति होवाच ।
units.english: Well then, may learn this from you, revered Sir?Learn, he said

units.sanskrit: अमुष्य लोकस्य का गतिर् इति । अयं लोक इति होवाच । अस्य लोकस्य का गतिर् इति । न प्रतिष्ठां लोकम् अतिनयेद् इति होवाच ।
units.english: What is the Essence of that other Region?This Region, he said What is the Essence of this Region?He said, One should not carry too far the Base of this Region of stability

units.sanskrit: प्रतिष्ठां वयं लोकं सामाभिसंस्थापयामः ।
units.english: We locate the Sima on the base of this Region;

units.sanskrit: प्रतिष्ठासंस्तावं हि सामेति ॥
units.english: because the Sāma has been eulogised as the Base

units.sanskrit: एवमुक्तो दाल्भ्य आहहन्ताहमेतद्भगवत्तो वेदानि यत्प्रतिष्ठं सामेत्युक्तः प्रत्युवाच शालावत्यो विद्धीति होवाच ।
units.english: Being addressed as above, Dālbhya saidWell, then, may learn this from you, revered Sir,on what Sāma is based?Being thus addressed, Śālāvatya answeredLearn, he said

units.sanskrit: अमुष्य लोकस्य का गतिरिति पृष्टो दाल्भ्येन शालावत्यो ऽयं लोक इति होवाच ।
units.english: Being asked by DālbhyaWhat is the Essence of that other Region?Śālāvatya said This Region, he said

units.sanskrit: अयं हि लोको यागदानहोमादिभिरमुं लोकं पुष्यतीति ।
units.english: The sense is that this Region of Human beings supports the other Region of Heaven through sacrifices, gifts, libations and such acts

units.sanskrit: इतः प्रदानं देवा उपजीवन्तिइति हि श्रुतयः । प्रत्यक्षं हि सर्वभूतानां धरणी प्रतिष्ठेति ।
units.english: The Śruti texts have declared that ‘the Deities live upon offerings from this world’ It is perceptible also that the Earth is the support of all things;

units.sanskrit: अतः साम्नो ऽप्ययं लोकः प्रतिष्ठैवेति युक्तम् ।
units.english: hence it is only right that the Earth should be the support, ultimate basis, of Sāma also

units.sanskrit: अस्य लोकस्य का गतिरित्युक्त आह शालावत्यः । न प्रतिष्ठामिमं लोकमतीत्य नयेत्साम कश्चित् ।
units.english: Being ashedWhat is the essence of this Region?Śālāvatya saidOne should not carry too farthe Sāmabeyond the Base of this Region

units.sanskrit: अतो वयं प्रतिष्ठां लोकं सामाभिसंस्थापयामः ।
units.english: It is for this reason that we locate the Sāma on the base of this Region;

units.sanskrit: यस्मात्प्रतिष्ठासंस्तावं हि प्रतिष्ठात्वेन संस्तुतं सामेत्यर्थः ।
units.english: because Sāma has been eulogised as the Base; ie Sāman has been praised as being the Base

units.sanskrit: इयं वै रथन्तरमिति च श्रुतिः ॥
units.english: Says the ŚrutitextThis is Rathaṇtara Sāma

units.sanskrit: तं ह प्रवाहणो जैवलिर् उवाच । अन्तवद् वै किल ते शालावत्य साम ।
units.english: PravāhaṇaJaibali said to himVerily, Śālavatya, your Sāma would have an end;

units.sanskrit: यस् त्व् एतर्हि ब्रूयान् मूर्धा ते विपतिष्यतीति मूर्धा ते विपतेद् इति । हन्ताहम् एतद् भगवत्तो वेदानीति ।
units.english: if, now, some one were to tell you that your head shall fall, your head would surely fallWell then, may learn it from you, revered Sir?Learn, he said

units.sanskrit: विद्धीति होवाच ॥ तमेवमुक्तवन्तं ह प्रवाहणो जैवलिरुवाचान्तवद्वै किल ते शालावत्य सामेत्यादि पूर्ववत् ।
units.english: When Dālbhya had said this, Pravāhaṇa Jaibali saidYour Sāma, O Śālāvatya, would have an end etc etcas before

units.sanskrit: ततः शालावत्य आहहन्ताहमेतद्भगवत्तो वेदानीति विद्धीति होवाचेतरो ऽनुज्ञात आह ॥
units.english: Then Śālāvatya saidWell then, may learn it from you, revered Sir?He said Learn

units.sanskrit: इति छान्दोग्योपनिषच्छाङ्करभाष्ये प्रथमोध्यायस्याष्टमः खण्डः
units.english: Being thus permitted the other said as follows in the next text End of Section of Discourse

units.sanskrit: अस्य लोकस्य का गतिर् इति । आकाश इति होवाच ।
units.english: What is the essence of this Region? Ākāśa, he said;

units.sanskrit: सर्वाणि ह वा इमानि भूतान्य् आकाशाद् एव समुत्पद्यन्ते ।
units.english: all these things in this world are born out of Ākāśa and become dissolved into Ākāśa;

units.sanskrit: आकाशं प्रत्य् अस्तं यन्ति ।
units.english: Ākāśa indeed is greater than these;

units.sanskrit: आकाशः परायणम् ॥
units.english: Ākāśa is the ultimate substratum

units.sanskrit: अस्य लोकस्य का गतिरिति । आकाश इति होवाच प्रवाहणः ।
units.english: What is the essence of this Region?Ākāśasaid Pravāhaṇa

units.sanskrit: आकाश इति च पर आत्माआकाशो वै नामेति श्रुतेः ।
units.english: Ākāśa here stands for the Supreme Self; as the Vedic Text says‘Ākāśa by name’;

units.sanskrit: तस्य हि कर्म सर्वभूतोत्पादकत्वम् । तस्मिन्नेव हि भूतप्रलयः ।
units.english: as the producing of all things is the function of that Self, all things become dissolved into that Self

units.sanskrit: तेजः परस्यां देवतायामिति हि वक्ष्यति ।
units.english: The Text itself is going to declare later on that It created Light

units.sanskrit: सर्वाणि ह वा इमानि भूतानि स्थावरजङ्गमान्याकाशादेव समुत्पद्यन्ते तेजोबन्नादिक्रमेण, सामर्थ्यात् । आकाशं प्रत्यस्तं यन्ति प्रलयकाले तेनैव विपरीतक्रमेण हि यस्मादाकाश एवैभ्यः सर्वेभ्यो भूतेभ्यो ज्यायान्महत्तरो ऽतः स सर्वेषां भृतानां परमयनं परायणं
units.english: The Light becomes dissolved into the Supreme Deity’All these things in this World,animate as well as inanimate, mobile and immobileare produced out of Ākāśa,in a regulated order of Light, Food and so forth, in accordance with the capacity of things;they become dissolved into Ākāśa, at the time of Universal Dissolution,in the reverse order;because Ākāśa indeed is greater than thesesuperior, larger, than all things;

units.sanskrit: प्रतिष्ठा त्रिष्वपि कालेष्वित्यर्थः ॥
units.english: and for that reason, it is the ‘param’‘ultimate’‘ayanam’‘substratum’, basis, support, at all three points of time

units.sanskrit: स एष परोवरीयान् उद्गीथः ।
units.english: This is the highest and best Udgītha;

units.sanskrit: स एषो ऽनन्तः ।
units.english: this is endless

units.sanskrit: परोवरीयो हास्य भवति परोवरीयसो ह लोकाञ् जयति य एतद् एवं विद्वान् परोवरीयांसम् उद्गीथम् उपास्ते ॥
units.english: One who, knowing this, meditates upon the highest and best Udgītha,to him comes the highest and best, and he wins the highest and best regions

units.sanskrit: यस्मात्परं परं वरीयो वरीयसो ऽप्येष वरः परश्च वरीयाश्च रपोवरीयानुद्गीथः परमात्मा सम्पन्न इत्यर्थः ।
units.english: Because the Udgītha is higher than the high and better than the good,ie highest and besttherefore it has become the Supreme Self,such is the meaning of the text

units.sanskrit: अत एव स एषो ऽनन्तो ऽविद्यामानान्तस्तमेतं परोवरीयांसं परमात्मभूतमनन्तमेवं विद्वान्परोवरीयांसमुद्गीथमुपास्ते । तस्यैतत्फलमाहपरोवरीयः परं परं वरीयो विशिष्टतरं जीवनं हास्य विदुषो
units.english: And because it is so, therefore it is endless,has no end One who, knowing it, as the highest and best, the Supreme Self, the endless,meditates upon the highest and best Udgītha,to him accrues the reward which the following text describes To him comes the highest and best,ie the life of such a knowing person becomes highest and best,higher and higher and better and better; this is the perceptible physical reward;

units.sanskrit: भवति दृष्टं फलमदृष्टं च परोवरीयस उत्तरोत्तरविशिष्टतरानेव ब्रह्माकाशान्तांल्लोकाञ्जयति
units.english: the imperceptible reward is that he wins higher and higher and better and better regions, culminating in the Region of Brahma, Ākāśa;

units.sanskrit: य एतदेवं विद्वानुद्गीथमुपास्ते ॥
units.english: all this comes to one who, knowing this, meditates upon the Udgītha

units.sanskrit: तं हैतम् अतिधन्वा शौनक उदरशाण्डिल्यायोक्त्वोवाच । यावत् त एनं प्रजायाम् उद्गीथं वेदिष्यन्ते परोवरीयो हैभ्यस् तावद् अस्मिंल् लोके जीवनं भविष्यति ॥
units.english: Atidhanvā Śaunaka, having taught this to UdaraŚāṇḍilya, said to himAs long as, among your offsprings, they will know the Udgītha, so long will their life be higher and better than these ordinary lives

units.sanskrit: किं च तमेतमुद्गीथं विद्वानतिधन्वा नामतः शुनकस्यापत्यं शौनक उदरशाडिल्याय शिष्यायैतमुद्गीथदर्शनमुक्त्वोवाच । यावत्ते तव प्रजायां प्रजासन्ततावित्यर्थः । एनमुद्गीथं त्वत्सन्ततिजा वेदिष्यन्ते ज्ञास्यन्ति तावन्तं कालं परोवरीयो हैभ्यः प्रसिद्धेभ्यो लौकिकजीवनेभ्य उत्तरोत्तरविशिष्टतरं
units.english: Further, knowing the Udgītha as described above, Atidhanvā by name,the son of Śunaka,having taught this science of Udgītha to his pupil, UdaraŚāṇḍilya, said to himAs long as among your offspringsin the line of your decendants,persons born in your family will know this Udgītha,so long will their life be higher and better more arid more excellentthan these well known ordinary lives

units.sanskrit: स य एतम् एव विद्वान् उपास्ते परोवरीय एव हास्यामुष्मिंल् लोके जीवनं भवति तथामुष्मिंल् लोके लोक इति लोके लोक इति ॥
units.english: So also in that other region,in that regionHe who, knowing this, meditates; his life in this world becomes highest and best, and so also in that other world,yea, in that world

units.sanskrit: तथादृष्टे ऽपि परलोके ऽमुष्मिन्परोवरीयांल्लोको भविष्यतीत्युक्तवाञ्शाण्डिल्यायातिधन्वा शौनकः ।
units.english: Similarly, in the other superphysical world also,one would become highest and best;thus did Atidhanvā Śaunaka say to Śāṇḍilya

units.sanskrit: स्यादेतत्फलं पूर्वेषां महाभाग्यानां नैदंयुगीनानामित्याशङ्कानिवृत्तय आहस यः
units.english: People might entertain the notion that though such rewards might have accrued to the blessed ancients, they cannot be possible for men of the present age;

units.sanskrit: कश्चिदेतदेवं विद्वानुद्गीथमेतर्ह्युपास्ते तस्याप्येवमेव परोवरीय एव हास्यास्मिंल्लोके
units.english: the rest of the text proceeds to set aside this notion in the next sentence He who,whoever he beknowing this, meditatesupon the Udgītha, in the manner described,for him also life in this world becomes highest and best;

units.sanskrit: जीवनं भवति तथामुष्मिंल्लोके लोके लोक इति ॥
units.english: and so also in that other world,yea, in that other world End of Section of Discourse

units.sanskrit: मटचीहतेषु कुरुष्व् आटिक्या सह जाययोषस्तिर् ह चाक्रायण इभ्यग्रामे प्रद्राणक उवास ॥
units.english: At a time when the Kuru country had been devastated by thunder and hail, UṣastiCākrāyaṇa, with his childwife, lived in a deplorable condition, in village Ibhya of the Elephantman

units.sanskrit: उद्गीयोपासनप्रसङ्गेन प्रस्तावप्रतिहारविषयमप्युपासनं वक्तव्यमितीदमारभ्यते ।
units.english: In connection with the meditation of Udgītha, it becomes necessary to expound the meditation of Prastāva and Pratihāra which are details relating to the Sāmachant;

units.sanskrit: आख्यायिका त सुखावबोधार्था ।
units.english: The anecdote has been introduced for the purpose of making the subject easily intelligible

units.sanskrit: मटचीहतेषु मटच्यो ऽशनयस्ताभिर्हतेषु नाशितेषु कुरुषु कुरुसस्येष्वित्यर्थः । ततो दुर्भिक्षे जात आटिक्यानुपजातपयोधरादिस्त्रीव्यञ्जनया सह जाययोषस्तिर्ह नामतश्चक्रस्यापत्यं चाक्रायणः ।
units.english: At a time when the Kuru countryie, the crops growing in that region,had been devastateddestroyedby thunder and hail, and consequent scarcity of food prevailed;Uṣastiby nameCākrāyaṇathe son of Cakra,with his childwife,ie his wife who had not yet developed her breasts or other feminine signs of youth;

units.sanskrit: इभो हस्ती तमर्हतीतीभ्य ईश्वरो हस्त्यारोहो वा तस्य ग्राम इभ्यग्रामस्तस्मिन्प्रद्राणको ऽन्नालाभात् ।
units.english: in village Ibhya , of the elephant man‘ibha’ is elephant, and ‘ibhya’ therefore stands for the owner, or rider, of elephants;

units.sanskrit: कृत्सितां गतिं गतो ऽन्त्यावस्थां प्राप्त इत्यर्थः । उवासोषितवान्कस्यचिद्गृहमाश्रित्य ॥
units.english: the meaning therefore is that the man had been reduced to a most deplorable condition, reduced to extreme circumstances;lived,lodged, in the house of some one

units.sanskrit: स हेभ्यं कुल्माषान् खादन्तं बिभिक्षे ।
units.english: He begged of the Elephantman who was eating Kulmāṣa grains

units.sanskrit: नेतो ऽन्ये विद्यन्ते यच् च ये म इम उपनिहिता इति ॥
units.english: The man said to himThere are no other than these, which have been served to me

units.sanskrit: सो ऽन्नार्थमटन्निभ्यं कुल्माषान्कुत्सितान्माषान्खादन्तं भक्षयन्तं यदृच्छयोपलभ्य बिभिक्षे याचितवान् ।
units.english: Wandering about in search of food, by chance, he met the Elephantman who was eating Kulmāṣa grain,coarse grains of Māṣa,and begged of him

units.sanskrit: तमुषस्तिं होवाचेभ्यः ।
units.english: The manthe Elephantmansaid to himUṣasti

units.sanskrit: नेतो ऽस्मान्मया भक्ष्यमाणादुच्छिष्टराशेः कुल्माषा अन्ये न विद्यन्ते ।
units.english: Other than these,coarse grains that am eating and which are therefore contaminated,there are no grains;

units.sanskrit: यच्च ये राशौ मे ममोपनिहिताः प्रक्षिप्ता इमे भाजते किं करोमीत्युक्तः प्रत्युवाचोषस्तिः ॥
units.english: apart from what has been served to meplaced before me in the dish; what can do?Thus addressed, Uṣasti saidas follows

units.sanskrit: एतेषां मे देहीति होवाच ।
units.english: Give me of thesehe said

units.sanskrit: हन्तानुपानम् इति । उच्छिष्टं वै मे पीतं स्याद् इति होवाच ॥
units.english: He gave them to him, and said, Well, here is waterHe repliedI would be drinking what is contaminated

units.sanskrit: मे मह्यं देहीति होवाच ।
units.english: Give me of theseie give these, to me’he said

units.sanskrit: तान्स इभ्यो ऽस्मा उषस्तये प्रददौ प्रदत्तवान् ।
units.english: The Elephantman gave them to Uṣasti

units.sanskrit: उच्छिष्टं वै मे ममेदमुदकं पीतं स्याद्यदि पास्यामीत्युक्तवन्तं प्रत्युवाचेतरः ॥
units.english: Well, water is herenear me; take thisHe said in replyIf drank this water, would be drinking what is contaminated

units.sanskrit: न स्विद् एते ऽप्य् उच्छिष्टा इति । न वा अजीविष्यम् इमान् अखादन्न् इति होवाच ।
units.english: When he said this, the other man said as follows Are not these also contaminated?He saidNot eating these, would not live;

units.sanskrit: कामो म उदपानम् इति ॥
units.english: water can get wherever like

units.sanskrit: किं न स्विदेते कुल्माषा उप्युच्छिष्टा इत्युक्त आहोषस्तिर्न वा अजीविष्यं न जीविष्यामीमान्कुल्माषानखादन्नभक्षयन्निति होवाच ।
units.english: Are not these grains also contaminated? Being thus addressed, Uṣasti saidI would not live, shall not eating these,if do not eat these grains

units.sanskrit: काम इच्छातो मे ममोदकपानं लभ्यत इत्यर्थः ।
units.english: Water is not live, available wherever wish

units.sanskrit: अतश्चैतामवस्यां प्राप्तस्य विद्याधर्मयशोवतः स्वात्मपरोपकारसमर्थस्यैतदपि कर्म कुर्वतो ना'गःस्पर्श इत्यभिप्रायः । तस्यापि जावितं प्रत्युपायान्तरे ऽजुगुप्सिते सति जुगुप्सितमेतत्कर्म दोषाय ।
units.english: The sense of all this is as followsa When a man, who is famous for learning and righteousness, and capable of doing good to himself and to others, does such an act as here decribed of eating forbidden food for saving his life, he does not incur sin;but b even for such a one, if he has recourse to discreditable means of saving life, while other unobjectionable means are available,he does incur sin

units.sanskrit: ज्ञानावलेपेन कुर्वतो नरकपातः स्यादेवेत्यभिप्रायः ।
units.english: In fact, if he did such an act, through arrogance born of learning, he would surely fall into hell

units.sanskrit: प्रद्राणकशब्दश्रवणात् ॥
units.english: That such is the sense is clear from the epithet ‘pradrāṇaka’, ‘in deplorable condition’

units.sanskrit: स ह खादित्वातिशेषाञ् जायाया आजहार ।
units.english: Having eaten, he gave the remainder to his wife;

units.sanskrit: साग्र एव सुभिक्षा बभूव ।
units.english: she had already eaten before;

units.sanskrit: तान् प्रतिगृह्य निदधौ ॥
units.english: having accepted the beans, she kept them

units.sanskrit: तांश्च स खादित्वातिशेषानतिशिष्टाञ्जायायै कारुण्यादाजहार । साऽटिक्यग्र एव कुल्माषप्राप्तेः सुभिक्षा शोभनभिक्षा लब्धान्नेत्येतद्बभूव संवृत्ता ।
units.english: The sage having eaten the beans, gave the remainder,the beans that remained after he had eatento his wife, through pity for her She,the childwife,had already eatenobtained food and partaken of itbefore the beans were obtained by her husband;

units.sanskrit: तथापि स्त्रीस्वाभाव्यादनवज्ञाय तान्कुल्माषान्पत्युर्हस्तात्प्रतिगृह्य निदधौ निक्षिप्तवती ॥
units.english: and yet, in accordance with her womanly nature, she did not refuse the gift; she received them from her husband’s hands and kept them,stored them

units.sanskrit: स ह प्रातः संजिहान उवाच । यद् बतान्नस्य लभेमहि लभेमहि धनमात्राम् ।
units.english: Next morning, on rising, he saidAlas! If could get some food, would get some wealth

units.sanskrit: राजासौ यक्ष्यते । स मा सर्वैर् आर्त्विज्यैर् वृणीतेति ॥
units.english: The king here is going to perform a sacrifice and he would appoint me to all the priestly offices

units.sanskrit: स तस्याः कर्म जानन्प्रातरुषःकाले सञ्जिहानः शयनं निद्रां वा परित्यजन्नुवाच पत्न्याः शृण्वत्या यद्यदि वतेति खिद्यमानो ऽन्नस्य स्तोकं लभेमहि तद्भुक्त्वान्नं समर्थो गत्वा लभेमहि धनमात्रां धनस्याल्पम् । ततो ऽस्माकं जीवनं भविष्यतीति । धनलाभे च कारणमाहराजासौ नातिदूरे स्थाने यक्ष्यते ।
units.english: Next morning,early at dawn,on rising, ie on relinquishing his bed, or sleep,he, knowing what his wife had done, said,within his wife’s hearingAlas; saying this in anguish,if could get someeven a littlefood, then having eaten it and recovering strength, would go forth and would get some wealth,a little wealth, and then our livelihood would be securedHe proceeds to explain his reasons for expecting to obtain wealthThe king here, not very far from this place,is going to perform a sacrifice;the verb ‘yakṣyate’ is put in the ātmanepada form because the king would be performing the sacrifice for his own benefit;and this king, on finding a fit and proper person in myself, would appoint me to all the priestly offices,the priestly functions, ie, for the performance of priestly functions

units.sanskrit: हन्त पत इम एव कुल्माषा इति ।
units.english: His wife said to himO, my Lord, here are those grains

units.sanskrit: तान् खादित्वामुं यज्ञं विततम् एयाय ॥
units.english: Having eaten them, he repaired to the sacrifice that was being elaborated

units.sanskrit: एवमुक्तवन्तं जायोवाचहन्त गृहाण हे पत इम एव ये मद्धस्ते विनिक्षिप्तास्त्वया कुल्माषा इति । तान्खादित्वामुं यज्ञं राज्ञो विततं विस्तारितमृत्विग्भिरेयाय ॥
units.english: When he had said this, his wife said to him O, my Lord, take these grains which had been deposited by you in my handsHaving eaten those grains, he repaired to the king’s sacrifice which; was being elaborated, performed in great detail,by the priests

units.sanskrit: तत्रोद्गात्ःन् आस्तावे स्तोष्यमाणान् उपोपविवेश ।
units.english: There he went and sat in the orchestra, near the UdgātṛPriest, when they were going to chant the hymns of praise

units.sanskrit: स ह प्रस्तोतरम् उवाच ॥
units.english: He said to the Prastotṛ Priest as follows

units.sanskrit: तत्र च गत्वोद्गातॄनुद्गातृपुरुषानागत्य स्तुवन्त्यस्मिन्नित्यास्तावस्तस्मिन्नास्तावे स्तोष्यमाणानुपोपविवेश समीप उपविष्टस्तेषामित्यर्थः
units.english: Having gone there, he approached the subordinates of the Udgātṛ Priest, in the orchestra,āstāva, orchestra, being the place where they sing hymns of praise stuvanti asmin,and sat near them, when they were going to chant the hymns of praise

units.sanskrit: उपविश्य स ह प्रस्तोतारमुवाच ॥
units.english: Having sat there, he said to the Prastotṛ priest as follows

units.sanskrit: प्रस्तोतर् या देवता प्रस्तावम् अन्वायत्ता तां चेद् अविद्वान् प्रस्तोष्यसि मूर्धा ते विपतिष्यतीति ॥
units.english: O, PrastotṛPriset, without knowing the Deity connected with the Prastāva, if thou dost chant the Introductory words, thy head shall fall off

units.sanskrit: हे प्रस्तोतरित्यामन्त्र्याभिमुखीकरणाय ।
units.english: O PrastotṛPriestthis address is for the purpose of attracting the Priest’s attention

units.sanskrit: या देवता प्रस्तावं प्रस्तावभक्तिमनुगतान्वायत्ता तां चेद्देवतां प्रस्तावभक्तेरविद्वान्सन्प्रस्तोष्यसि विदुषो मम समीपे ।
units.english: That Deity which is connected with the Prastāvathe Prastāva Introductory portion of the Sāma,if, without knowing this Deity of the Introductory section, thou dost chant the Introductory words,in the presence of myself who know that Deity;this qualification has to be understood;

units.sanskrit: तत्परोक्षे ऽपि चेद्विपतेत्तस्य मूर्धा कर्ममात्रविदामनधिकार एव कर्मणि स्यात् ।
units.english: because, if the meaning were that the head would fall off even in the absence of a man knowing the Deity, then a person who knows only the act but not the Deity would not be entitled to the performance of the act at all;

units.sanskrit: तच्चानिष्टमविदुषामपि कर्मदर्शनात् । दक्षिणमार्गश्रुतेश्च ।
units.english: because even unlearned persons are actually found to be performing acts;also because the Śrutitext itself speaks of the ‘Southern Path’;

units.sanskrit: अनधिकारे चाविदुषामुत्तर एवैको मार्गः श्रूयेत ।
units.english: if the unlearned were not entitled to the performance of such acts, then the Śruti would have spoken of the ‘Northern Path’ only;

units.sanskrit: न च स्मार्तकर्मनिमित्त एव दक्षिणः पन्थाः । यज्ञेन दानेनेत्यादिश्रतेः । तथोक्तस्य मयेति च विशेषणाद्विद्वत्समक्षमेव कर्मण्यनधिकारो न सर्वत्राग्निहोत्रस्मार्तकर्माध्ययनादिषु च ।
units.english: nor would it be right to argue that the ‘Southern Path’ relates only to the acts prescribed in the Smṛtis and not to those prescribed in the Śruti,because the Śruti also speaks of ‘sacrifice, charity etc’ where charity is a preeminently Smārta act

units.sanskrit: अनुज्ञायास्तत्र तत्र दर्शनात् कर्ममात्रविदामप्यधिकारः सिद्धः कर्मणीति ।
units.english: specially because permission for such performance by the unlearned is found to have been accorded in several texts Thus it is established that even such a person is entitled to the performance of an act as is conversant with

units.sanskrit: मूर्धा ते विपतिष्यतीति ॥
units.english: that particular act alone and is ignorant in regard to its detailsThy head will fall off

units.sanskrit: एवम् एवोद्गातारम् उवाच । उद्गातर् या देवतोद्गीथम् अन्वायत्ता तां चेद् अविद्वान् उद्गास्यसि मूर्धा ते विपतिष्यतीति ॥
units.english: Similarly he said to the Udgātṛ PriestO Udgātṛ Priest, without knowing the Deity connected with the Udgītha, if thou performest the chanting, then thy head shall fall off0

units.sanskrit: एवम् एव प्रतिहर्तारम् उवाच । प्रतिहर्तर् या देवता प्रतिहारम् अन्वायत्ता तां चेद् अविद्वान् प्रतिहरिष्यसि मूर्धा ते विपतिष्यतीति । ते ह समारतास् तूष्णीम् आसां चक्रिरे ॥
units.english: Similarly, he said to the Pratihartṛ PriestO Pratihartṛ Priest, without knowing the Deity connected with the Pratihāra if thou performest the Pratihāra, tfiy head shall fall offThereupon, they stopped and sat down in silence

units.sanskrit: एवमेवोद्गातारं प्रतिहर्तारमुवाचेत्यादि समानमन्यत् ।
units.english: Similarly he spoke to the Udgātṛ and the Pratihartṛ The rest is as before

units.sanskrit: ते प्रस्तोत्रादयः कर्मभ्यः समारता उपरताः सन्तो मूर्धपातभयात्तूष्णीमासांचक्रिरे ऽन्यच्चाकुर्वन्तः अर्थित्वात् ॥
units.english: These Priests, Prastotṛ and the rest, thereupon stoppeddesisted from their functions, and, through fear of their heads falling off, sat down in silence; not doing anything else, being desirous of learning things from Uṣasti

units.sanskrit: इति छान्दोग्योपनिषच्छाङ्करभाष्ये प्रथमोधध्यायस्य दशमः खण्डः
units.english: End of Section 0 of Discourse

units.sanskrit: उषस्तिर् अस्मि चाक्रायण इति होवाच ॥ अथानन्तरं हैनमुषस्तिं यजमानो राजोवाच । भगवन्तं वै पूजावर्न्तमहं विविदिषामि वेदितुमिच्छामीत्युक्त उषस्तिरस्मि चाक्रायणस्तवापि श्रोत्रपथमागतो यदीति होवाचोक्तवान् ॥ स होवाच ।
units.english: Thereupon, the Master of the Sacrifice said to himI should like to know you, Revered SirI am Uṣasti, the son of Cakra, he said Thereupon,after the above,the Master of the Sacrifice,the Sacrificer, the KingsaidI should like to know youwho are deserving of all honour, desire to know who you arebeing thus addressed, Uṣasti saidI am Uṣasti, the son of Cakra,if you have heard of the name

units.sanskrit: भगवन्तं वा अहम् एभिः सर्वैर् आर्त्विज्यैः पर्यैषिषम् ।
units.english: He saidI looked for you, revered Sir, for all these priestly offices;

units.sanskrit: भगवतो वा अहम् अवित्त्यान्यान् अवृषि ॥
units.english: and it was only when did not find you that appointed others

units.sanskrit: स ह यजमान उवाच सत्यमेवमहं भगवन्तं बहुगुणमश्रौषं सर्वैश्च ऋच्विक्कर्मभिरार्त्विज्यैः पर्यैषिषं पर्येषणं कृतवानस्मि
units.english: The Master of the Sacrifice saidTruly have heard of you, revered Sir, as equipped with many qualifications; and looked for you in connection with all these priestly off icesthe functions of the Priests;

units.sanskrit: अन्विष्य भगवतो वा अहमवित्त्यालाभेनान्यानिमानवृषि वृतवानस्मि ॥
units.english: and it was only when having looked for you and not found you, that have appointed these others

units.sanskrit: भगवांस् त्व् एव मे सर्वैर् आर्त्विज्यैर् इति ।
units.english: But now you, Sir, take up all the priestly functionsVery well;

units.sanskrit: अथ तर्ह्य् एत एव समतिसृष्टाः स्तुवताम् ।
units.english: then, let these same, with my permission, sing the hymns of praise;

units.sanskrit: यावत् त्व् एभ्यो धनं दद्यास् तावन् मम दद्या इति । तथेति ह यजमान उवाच ॥
units.english: but as much wealth you give to these, so much you should give to me alsoVery wellsaid the Master of the Sacrifice

units.sanskrit: किन्त्वथैवं तर्ह्येत एव त्वया पूर्व वृता मया समतिसृष्टा मया सम्यक्प्रसन्नेनानुज्ञाताः सन्तः स्तुवताम् । त्वया त्वेतत्कार्यम् । यावत्त्वेभ्यः प्रस्तोत्रादिभ्यः सर्वेभ्यो धनं दद्याः प्रयच्छसि तावन्मम दद्या इत्युक्तस्तथेति ह यजमान उवाच ॥
units.english: But these same persons who have been previously appointed by you,let these, with my permission,ie only permitted by me who am quite satisfied,sing the hymns But you should do thisAs much wealth you give as present to thesePrastotṛ and other priests,so much you should give to me alsoBeing thus requested, the Sacrificer saidVery well

units.sanskrit: अथ हैनं प्रस्तोतोपससाद । प्रस्तोतर् या देवता प्रस्तावम् अन्वायत्ता तां चेद् अविद्वान् प्रस्तोष्यसि मूर्धा ते विपतिष्यतीति मा भगवान् अवोचत् । कतमा सा देवतेति ॥
units.english: Thereupon the PrastotṛPriest approached him and saidSir, you said to me ‘O Prastotṛ, without knowing the Deity connected with the Prastāva, if thou dost chant the Introductory words, thy head shall fall off’;now, what is that Deity?

units.sanskrit: अथ हैनमौषस्त्यं वचः श्रुत्वा प्रस्तोतोपससादोषस्तिं विनयेनोपजगाम ।
units.english: Thereupon,having heard Uṣasti’s assertion, the Prastotṛ approached himwent to Uṣasti, with due respect

units.sanskrit: प्रस्तोतर्या देवतेत्यादि मा मां मगवानवोचत्पूर्वम् ।
units.english: Before this, you, Sir, said to me ‘O Prastotṛ, the Deity etc

units.sanskrit: कतमा सा देवता या प्रस्तावभक्तिमन्वायत्तेति ॥
units.english: etc’Now, what is that Deitywhich is connected with the Prastāva Introduction?

units.sanskrit: प्राण इति होवाच ।
units.english: He saidBreath

units.sanskrit: सर्वाणि ह वा इमानि भूतानि प्राणम् एवाभिसंविशन्ति ।
units.english: Verily all these beings merge into Breath itself, and from Breath itself do they

units.sanskrit: प्राणम् अभ्युज्जिहते ।
units.english: arise

units.sanskrit: सैषा देवता प्रस्तावम् अन्वायत्ता ।
units.english: This is the Deity connected with the Prastāva;

units.sanskrit: तां चेद् अविद्वान् प्रास्तोष्यो मूर्धा ते विपतिष्यत् तथोक्तस्य मयेति ॥
units.english: if, without knowing It, you had sung the Prastāva, your head would have fallen off, if had said so to you

units.sanskrit: पृष्टः प्राण इति होवाच । युक्तं प्रस्तावस्य प्राणो देवतेति ।
units.english: On being questioned, Uṣasti saidBreath It is only right that Breath should be the Deity of the Prastāva

units.sanskrit: कथं, सर्वाणि स्थावरजङ्गमानि भूतानि प्राणमेवाभिसंविशन्ति प्रलयकाले प्राणमभि लक्षयित्वा प्राणात्मनैवोज्जिहते प्राणादेवोद्गच्छन्तीत्यर्थः
units.english: Why?Because all beingsanimate and inanimate,merge into Breath, at the time of Dissolution,and also arise out of Breath at the time of birth, evolution;ie in the form of Breath itself; the prefix ‘abhi’ indicating in connection with, out of

units.sanskrit: अतः सैषा देवता प्रस्तावमन्वायत्ता तां चेदविद्वांस्त्वं प्रास्तोष्यः प्रस्तवनं प्रस्तावभक्तिं
units.english: It is for this reason that this Deity is connected with Prastāva

units.sanskrit: कृतवानसि यदि मूर्धा शिरस्ते व्यपतिष्यद्विपतितमभविष्यत्तथोक्तस्य मया तत्काले मूर्धा ते विपतिष्यतीति । अतस्त्वया साधु कृतम् । मया निषिद्धः कर्मणो यदुपरममकार्षीरित्यभिप्रायः ॥
units.english: If, without knowing this Deity, you had sung the Prastāva,if you had sung the Introductory Section of the Sāma,your head would have fallen off,if had said to you at that time that ‘thy head shall fall off’Thus you have done well, in desisting from the performance when forbidden by me

units.sanskrit: अथ हैनम् उद्गातोपससाद । उद्गातर् या देवतोद्गीथम् अन्वायत्ता तां चेद् अविद्वान् उद्गास्यसि मूर्धा ते विपतिष्यतीति मा भगवान् अवोचत् ।
units.english: Then, the Udgatṛ Priest approached him and said You, Sir, told me that if, without knowing the Deity connected with the Udgītha, thou performest the chanting, thy head would fall off;now, what is that Deity?

units.sanskrit: तथोद्गाता पप्रच्छ कतमा सोद्गीथभक्तिमनुगतान्वायत्ता देवतेति ॥
units.english: Similarly, the Udgātṛ Priest asked himWhat is the Deity connected with the UdgīthaSection of Sāma?

units.sanskrit: आदित्य इति होवाच ।
units.english: He saidThe Sun

units.sanskrit: सर्वाणि ह वा इमानि भूतान्य् आदित्यम् उच्चैः सन्तं गायन्ति ।
units.english: All these beings sing to the Sun when It stands on high;

units.sanskrit: सैषा देवतोद्गीथम् अन्वायत्ता ।
units.english: this is the Deity connected with the Udgītha

units.sanskrit: तां चेद् अविद्वान् उदगास्यो मूर्धा ते व्यपतिष्यत् तथोक्तस्य मयेति ॥
units.english: If, without knowing this, thou hadst done the singing, thy head would have fallen off,if had said so

units.sanskrit: पृष्ट आदित्य इति होवाच ।
units.english: Being questioned, he saidThe Sun;

units.sanskrit: सर्वाणि ह वा इमानि भूतान्यादित्यमुच्चैरूर्ध्वं सन्तं गायन्ति शब्दयन्ति स्तुवन्तीत्यभिप्रायः ।
units.english: all these beings singraise their voice to, ie sing the praises ofthe Sun when it stands on high

units.sanskrit: उच्छब्दसामान्यात्प्रशब्दसामान्यादिव प्राणो ऽतः सैषा देवतेत्यादि पूर्ववत् ॥ अथ हैनं प्रतिहर्तोपससाद ।
units.english: This Sun because of the syllable ‘ut’ being common to both ‘Udgītha’ and uccaiḥ santam ādityam,just as because the syllable ‘pra’ is common to both ‘Prāṇa’ and ‘Prastāva’ The rest as before

units.sanskrit: प्रतिहर्तर् या देवता प्रतिहारम् अन्वायत्ता तां चेद् अविद्वान् प्रतिहरिष्यसि मूर्धा ते विपतिष्यतीति मा भगवान् अवोचत् ।
units.english: Thereupon the Pratihārtṛ Priest approached him and saidYou Sir, said to me ‘if, Pratihartṛ, thou performest the Pratihāra, without knowing the Deity connected with the Pratihāra, thy head shall fall off’;

units.sanskrit: कतमा सा देवतेति ॥
units.english: now, what is that Deity?

units.sanskrit: एवमेवाथ हैनं प्रतिहर्तोपसाद कतमा सा देवता प्रतिहारमन्वायत्तेति ॥
units.english: Similarly, the Pratihārtṛ Priest approached him and askedWhat is that deity which is connected with the Pratihāra?

units.sanskrit: अन्नम् इति होवाच ।
units.english: He saidFood

units.sanskrit: सर्वाणि ह वा इमानि भूतन्य् अन्नम् एव प्रतिहरमाणानि जीवन्ति ।
units.english: All these beings live only when absorbing food

units.sanskrit: सैषा देवता प्रतिहारम् अन्वायत्ता ।
units.english: This is the Deity connected with Pratihāra

units.sanskrit: तां चेद् अविद्वान् प्रत्यहरिष्यो मूर्धा ते व्यपतिष्यत् तथोक्तस्य मयेति तथोक्तस्य मयेति ॥
units.english: If, without knowing it, thou hadst performed the Pratihāra, thy head would have fallen off,if had said so

units.sanskrit: पृष्टो ऽन्नमिति होवाच ।
units.english: Being questioned, he saidFood

units.sanskrit: सर्वाणि ह वा इमानि भूतान्यन्नमेवा'त्मानं प्रति सर्वतः प्रतिहरमाणानि जीवन्ति ।
units.english: All these beings live only when absorbingtaking to themselvesfood

units.sanskrit: सैषा देवता प्रतिशब्दसामान्यात्प्रतिहारभक्तिमनुगता । समानमन्यत्तथोक्तस्य मयेति ।
units.english: This is the Deity connected with the PratihāraSection of the Sāma, on account of the syllable ‘prati’ being common to both ‘pratihāra’ and ‘pratiharamāṇāni’The rest as before

units.sanskrit: प्रस्तावोद्गीथप्रतिहारभक्तीः प्राणादित्यान्नदृष्ट्योपासीतेति समुदायार्थः । प्राणाद्यापत्तिः कर्मसमृद्धिर्वा फलमिति ॥ इति छान्दोग्योपनिषच्छाङ्करभाष्ये प्रथमोध्यायस्यैकादशः खण्डः
units.english: The three factors of Sāma,viz, the Prastāva, the Udgītha and Pratihāra,one should meditate upon these as ‘Breath’, ‘Sun’ and ‘Food’,such is the upshot of the whole of this section,The reward for this would consist, either in becoming transformed into Breath Sun and Food or the due fulfilment of the Sacrifice End of Section of Discourse

units.sanskrit: अथातः शौव उद्गीथः ।
units.english: Now, then, the Udgītha connected with dogs

units.sanskrit: तद् ध बको दाल्भ्यो ग्लावो वा मैत्रेयः स्वाध्यायम् उद्वव्राज ॥
units.english: BakaDālbhya or Glāva Maitreya went out for Vedic study

units.sanskrit: अतीते खण्डे ऽन्नाप्राप्तिनिमित्ता कष्टावस्थोक्तोच्छिष्टपर्युषितभक्षणलक्षणा ।
units.english: In the foregoing Section, the Text has described the deplorable state to which one is reduced for want of food,the state represented by the necessity of eating stale and unclean food

units.sanskrit: सा मा भूदित्यन्नलाभायाथानन्तरं शौवः श्वभिर्दृष्ट उद्गीथ उद्गानं सामातः प्रस्तूयते ।
units.english: In order to avoid such a condition, one has to obtain food, and to that end, the Text proceeds now with the Udgītha connected with dogs that is, the chanting, the Sāma, perceived by revealed to Dogs

units.sanskrit: तत्तत्र ह किल बको नामतो दल्भस्यापत्यं दाल्भ्यो ग्लावो वा नामतो मित्रायाश्चापत्यं मैत्रेयः । वाशब्दश्चार्थे । द्व्यामुष्यायणो ह्यसौ ।
units.english: As regards this, Baka, by name, the son of Dalbha who was also Glāva the son of Mitra;the particle ‘vā’ has the sense of ‘ca’ the sense, therefore, is that only one person is mentioned, who was a Dvyāmuṣyāyaṇa, born of two families one by birth and another by adoption;

units.sanskrit: वस्तुविषये क्रियास्विव विकल्पानुपपत्तेः ।
units.english: the text cannot be taken as mentioning two alternative names, because there can be no option as between things, as there is between actions

units.sanskrit: द्विनामा द्विगोत्र इत्यादि हि स्मृतिः ।
units.english: The Smṛti speaks of persons ‘having two names, and belonging to two gotras’;

units.sanskrit: दृश्यते चोभयतः पिण्डभाक्त्वम् ।
units.english: it is also found that such persons are recipients of offerings from both families

units.sanskrit: उद्गीथे बद्धचित्तत्वादृषावनादराद्वा ।
units.english: Or, it may be that the Text was engrossed with the main subject of Udgītha and hence did not care whether it was speaking of one or two or more sages;

units.sanskrit: वाशब्दः स्वाध्यायार्थः ।
units.english: and the particle ‘vā’ is meant only to facilitate the recital of the text

units.sanskrit: स्वाध्यायं कर्तुं ग्रामाद्बहिरुद्वव्राजोद्गतवान्विविक्तदेशस्थोदकाभ्याशम् । उद्वव्राज प्रतिपालयाञ्चकारेति चैकवचनाल्लिङ्गादेको ऽसावृषिः ।
units.english: For the purposes of Vedic study the said sage went out to a place outside the village, to a quiet place near a river He went out and waited there;the singular number in the verb ‘udvabrāja’ went out clearly indicates that the sage in question was one only bearing the two names

units.sanskrit: श्वोद्गीथकालप्रतिपालनादृषेः स्वाध्यायकरणमन्नकामनयेति लक्ष्यत इत्यभिप्रायः ॥
units.english: The sense appears to be that, inasmuch as the sage awaited the Udgītha connected with Dogs, it would seem as if his Vedic study was for the purpose of obtaining food

units.sanskrit: तस्मै श्वा श्वेतः प्रादुर् बभूव ।
units.english: A white dog appeared before him;

units.sanskrit: तम् अन्ये श्वान उपसमेत्योचुः । अन्नं नो भगवान् आगायतु ।
units.english: and other dogs, gathering round that Dog, saidSir, please sing food for us;

units.sanskrit: अशनायाम वा इति ॥
units.english: really we are hungry

units.sanskrit: स्वाध्यायेन तोषिता देवतर्षिर्वा श्वरूपं गृहीत्वा श्वा श्वेतः संस्तस्मा ऋषये तदनुग्रहार्थं प्रादुर्बभूव प्रादुश्चकार ।
units.english: Being pleased with the learning of BakaDālbhya a deity, or a sage, took the shape of the dog, and thus was it that a white dog appearedie was made to appearbefore himie for the purpose of bestowing a favour upon him

units.sanskrit: तमन्ये शुक्लं श्वानं क्षुल्लकाः श्वान उपसमेत्योचुरुक्तवन्तो ऽन्नं नो ऽस्मभ्यं भगवानागायत्वागानेन निष्पादयत्वित्यर्थः ।
units.english: Other dogssmaller onesgathering round that dog,said to himSir, please sing food for us,ie secure food for us by means of singing The right meaning to be deduced from all this is that Speech and the rest, being partakers of food in the wake of Breath, said this to the Breath in the Mouth;

units.sanskrit: मुक्यप्राणं वागादयो वा प्राणमन्वन्नभुजः स्वाध्यायपरितोषिताः सन्तो ऽनुगृह्णीयुरेनं स्वरूपमादायेति युक्तमेवं प्रतिपत्तुम् ।
units.english: the idea being that being pleased with Vedic learning, they would help the Breath through their own forms

units.sanskrit: अशनायाम वै बुभुक्षिताः स्मो वा इति ॥
units.english: Really we are hungry

units.sanskrit: तद् ध बको दाल्भ्यो ग्लावो वा मैत्रेयः प्रतिपालयां चकार ॥
units.english: He said to themMeet me here in the morning BakaDālbhya or GlāvaMaitreya awaited their reappearance

units.sanskrit: एवमुक्ते श्वा श्वेत उवाच तान्क्षुल्लाकाञ्शुन इहैवास्मिन्नेव देशे मा मां प्रातः प्रातःकाल उपसमीयातेति ।
