units.english: Thus then, the meaning is that those householders who know the philosophy of the Five Fires, those who dwell in the forest, ie, Hermits and Renunciates,along with the Lifelong Religion, Studentswho meditate upon Faith and Penance,ie, who are endowed with Faith and are devoted to penances,the term ‘meditate’ here standing for being devoted to, engaged in, just as in the phrase ‘who meditate upon acts of public utility and charity’;and on the strength of another Vedic text, those who meditate upon the true Brahman named ‘Hiraṇyagarbha’

units.sanskrit: श्रुत्यन्तराद्ये च सत्यं ब्रह्म हिरण्यगर्भाख्यमुपासते ते सर्वे ऽर्चिषमर्चिरभिमानिनीं देवतामभिसम्भवन्ति प्रतिपद्यन्ते ।
units.english: all these four kinds of persons go to Flame,they reach the Deity kindling the flame

units.sanskrit: समानमन्यच्चतुर्थगतिव्याख्यानेन ।
units.english: The rest is similar to the explanations provided under the similar description of the ‘Process’, under Discourse

units.sanskrit: एष देवयानः पन्था व्याख्यातः सत्यलोकावसानो नाण्डाद्बहिः ।
units.english: Thus has been described the Path of the Divinities, culminating in the Satyaloka, which is well within the Universal Egg;

units.sanskrit: यदन्तरा पितरं मातरं चैति मन्त्रवर्णात् ॥
units.english: as has been indicated by the Mantra text ‘Which lies between the Father and the Mother’

units.sanskrit: अथ य इमे ग्राम इष्टापूर्ते दत्तम् इत्य् उपासते । ते धूमम् अभिसंभवन्ति ।
units.english: And those who, living in villages, meditate upon sacrifices and works of public utility and charity,pass on to Smoke;

units.sanskrit: धूमाद् रात्रिम् । रात्रेर् अपरपक्षम् ।
units.english: from Smoke to Night; from Night to the Darker Fortnight;

units.sanskrit: अपरपक्षाद् यान् षड् दक्षिणैति मासांस् तान् ।
units.english: from the Darker Fortnight to those months during which the Sun moves Southwards;

units.sanskrit: नैते संवत्सरम् अभिप्राप्नुवन्ति ॥
units.english: from there they do not reach the year

units.sanskrit: अथेत्यर्थान्तरप्रस्तावनार्थो य इमे गृहस्था ग्रामे । ग्राम इति गृहस्थानामसाधारणं विशेषणमरण्यवासिभ्यो व्यावृत्त्यर्थम् ।
units.english: The term ‘atha’ and is meant to indicate the beginning of a new subject ThoseHouseholderswho living in villages; ‘living in villages’ is the common characteristic of all Householders, differentiating them from the Dwellers in the Forest;

units.sanskrit: यथा वानप्रस्थपरिव्राजकानामरण्यं विशेषणं गृहस्थेभ्यो व्यावृत्त्यर्थं तद्वत् ।
units.english: just as ‘dwelling in the Forest’ serves to differentiate Hermite and Renunciates from Householders

units.sanskrit: इष्टापूर्ते इष्टमग्निहोत्रादि वैदिकं कर्म पूर्तं वापीकूपतडागारामादिकरणम् । दत्तं बहिर्वेदि यथाशक्त्यर्हेभ्यो द्रव्यसंविभागो दत्तम् ।
units.english: A gnihotra and other Rites, prescribed in the Vedas;works of public utility such as the digging of tanks and wells and the laying out of Parks;Charity giving, distributing, apart from the sacrificial altar, to the best of one’s resources, of things to deserving persons;those who meditate upon such service and protection;

units.sanskrit: इत्येवंविधं परिचरणपरित्राणाद्युपासते । इतिशब्दस्य प्रकारदर्शनार्थत्वात् ।
units.english: the particle ‘iti’ ùn the phrase ‘Dattamityupāsate’ is meant to indicate the methods of meditation

units.sanskrit: ते दर्शनवर्जितत्वाद्धूमं धूमाभिमानिनीं देवतामभिसम्भवन्ति प्रतिपद्यन्ते ।
units.english: All these persons, being devoid of true insight, go over to smoke,ie, they reach the Deity ensouling Smoke;

units.sanskrit: तयातिवाहिता धूमाद्रात्रिं रात्रिदेवतां रात्रेदेवतां रात्रेरपरपक्षदेवतामेव कृष्णपक्षाभिमानिनीमपरपक्षाद्यान्षण्मासान्दक्षिणा दक्षिणां दशमेति
units.english: and being passed on by that Deity, they go to Night ie, to the Deity of the Night;from Night, they go to the Darker Fortnight,ie, the Deity of the DarkFortnight;from that to those six monthsthe Deity ensouling these monthsduring which the San moves Southwards The Deities of these six months always move in a group;

units.sanskrit: सविता ।
units.english: ‘months’

units.sanskrit: तान्मासान्दक्षिणायनषण्मासाभिमानिनीर्देवताः प्रतिपद्यन्त इत्यर्थः । सङ्घचारिण्यो हि षण्मासदेवता इति मासानिति बहुवचनप्रयोगस्तासु नैते कर्मिणः
units.english: These persons mentioned here being addicted to the performance of Acts, do not reach the Deity ensouling the Year QuestionWhen was there any likelihood of these persons reaching the Year, that it should have been specially denied?

units.sanskrit: प्रकृताः संवत्सरं संवत्सरस्य ह्येकस्यावयवभूते दक्षिणोत्तरायणे तत्रार्चिरादिमार्गप्रवृत्तानामुदगयनमासेभ्यो ऽवयविनः संवत्सरस्य प्राप्तिरुक्ता ।
units.english: AnswerThere was a likelihood the Northern and Southern Paths of the Sun, both equally form part of the Year; and for those who go by the path of Flame and the rest it has been asserted above that from the six months of the Northern Path of the Sun, they proceed to the complete Year

units.sanskrit: अत इहापि तदवयवभूतानां दक्षिणायनमासानां प्रप्तिं श्रुत्वा तदवयविनः संवत्सरस्यापि पूर्ववत्प्रप्तिरापन्नेत्यतस्तत्प्राप्तिः प्रतिषिध्यते नैते संवत्सरमभिप्राप्नुवन्तीति ॥
units.english: Hence it was only natural that on the same analogy, those who have been spoken of as having reached the six months of the Southern Path should be regarded as going next to the year; consequently it was necessary to deny this specifically from them they do not go to the Year

units.sanskrit: मासेभ्यः पितृलोकम् ।
units.english: From the months, they go to the Region of the Fathers;

units.sanskrit: पितृलोकाद् आकाशम् ।
units.english: from the Region of the Fathers to Ākāśa;

units.sanskrit: आकासाच् चन्द्रमसम् ।
units.english: from Ākāśa to the Moon

units.sanskrit: एष सोमो राजा ।
units.english: That is Soma the King

units.sanskrit: तद् देवानाम् अन्नम् । तं देवा भक्षयन्ति ॥
units.english: That is the food of the Deities This the Deities eat

units.sanskrit: मासेभ्यः पितृलोकं पितृलोकादाकाशमाकाशाच्चन्द्रमसम् ।
units.english: From the months, they go to the Region of the Fathers,from the Region of the Fathers, to Ākāśa; from Ākāśa to the Moon

units.sanskrit: को ऽसौ यस्तैः प्राप्यते चन्द्रमा य एष दृश्यते ऽन्तरिक्षे सोमो राजा ब्राह्मणानां,
units.english: QuestionWho is it who is reached by them? AnswerThe Moon, which is seen by us in the sky, who is Soma, the Kingof Brāhmaṇas;

units.sanskrit: तदन्नं देवानां तं चन्द्रमसमन्नं देवा इन्द्रादयो भक्षयन्ति ।
units.english: that is the food of the Deities; and this food in the shape of the Moon, the Deities eat

units.sanskrit: अतस्ते धूमादिना गत्वा चन्द्रभूताः कर्मिणो देवैर्भक्ष्यन्ते । नन्वनर्थायेष्टादिकरणं यद्यन्नभूता देवैर्भक्ष्येरन् ।
units.english: Thus the performers of Rituals and other acts, having gone through smoke and the rest, become merged in the Moon and hence are eaten by the Deities Objection;If becoming food, these persons are eaten by the Deities,then the performance of sacrifices and other acts leads to evil consequences

units.sanskrit: नैष दोषः ।
units.english: There is no point in this objection

units.sanskrit: अन्नमित्युपकरणमात्रस्य विवक्षितत्वात् । न हि ते कवलोत्क्षेपेण देवैर्भक्ष्यन्ते । किं तर्ह्युपकरणमात्रं देवानां भवन्ति ते स्त्रीपशुभृत्यादिवत् ।
units.english: What is really meant by their being eaten is only that they become the accessories or tools of the Deities,not that they are actually eaten, swallowed by the Deities as morsels of food; they only become tools in the hands of the Deities,like women, cattle, servants and such dependents

units.sanskrit: दृष्टश्चान्नशब्द उपकरणेषुस्त्रियो ऽन्नं पशवो ऽन्नं विशां विशो ऽन्नं राज्ञाम् इत्यादि ।
units.english: The term ‘anna’ food is actually found to be used in the sense of accessory, in such expressions as‘women are food’, ‘cattle are food’, ‘the people are food’,‘of the King’; and so forth

units.sanskrit: न च तेषां स्त्र्यादीनां पुरुषोपभोग्यत्वे ऽप्युपभोगो नास्ति ।
units.english: Just as in the case of women, cattle and the rest,though they are themselves objects of enjoyment for man,it does not follow from that that they do not have their own enjoyments,so is the case in question;

units.sanskrit: तस्मात्कर्मिणो देवानामुपभोग्या अपि सन्तः सुखिनो देवैः क्रीडन्ति ।
units.english: even though the performers of acts are objects of enjoyment for Deities, yet they enjoy their own pleasures, sporting with Deities

units.sanskrit: शरीरं च तेषां सुखोपभोगयोग्यं चन्द्रमण्डल आप्यमारभ्यते ।
units.english: The body for these persons, fit for the experiencing of those pleasures, is an aqueous one, produced in the Lunar Region

units.sanskrit: तदुक्तं पुरस्ताच्छ्रद्धाशब्दा आपो द्युलोकाग्नौ हुताः सोमो राजा सम्भवतीति ।
units.english: This is what has been described above in the text ‘Water, named Faith, having been offered into the fire of the Heavenly Region, becomes King Soma’ Ibid,

units.sanskrit: ता आपः कर्मसमवायिन्य इतरैश्च भूतैरनुगता द्युलोकं प्राप्य चन्द्रत्वमापन्नाः शरीराद्यारम्भिका इष्टाद्युपासकानां भवन्ति ।
units.english: What happens is that the Water, entering into the constitution of the Rites performed, and accompanied by other elementary substances, reaches the Heavenly Region, and becoming merged in the Moon, it becomes the constituent making up the body for persons devoted to sacrifices and other acts

units.sanskrit: अन्त्यायां च शरीराहुतावग्नौ हुतायामग्निना दह्यमाने शरीरे तदुत्था आपो धूमेन सहोर्ध्वं यजमानमावेष्ट्य चन्द्रमण्डलं प्राप्य कुशमृत्तिकास्थानीया बाह्यशरीरारम्भिका भवन्ति ।
units.english: And it is through this aqueous body that they are enabled to experience the joys of Heaven That is to say, when the last oblation has been poured into the fire and the body has been burnt, the water rising out of the body goes up along with the smoke, and having enveloped the sacrificer his soul, it reaches the Lunar Region and becomes the material of which the external body of the sacrificer is built up,just as straw and clay form the material in the making of the ClayIdol;

units.sanskrit: तदारब्धेन च शरीरेणेष्टादिफलमुपभुञ्जाना आसते ॥
units.english: and it is with the body built of this water that these persons stay in Heaven, enjoying the reward of their sacrificial and other acts

units.sanskrit: तस्मिन् यवात्संपातम् उषित्वाथैतम् एवाध्वानं पुनर् निवर्तन्ते ।
units.english: Having dwelt there till exhaustion, they return again, by the same path as they came, to Ākāśa;

units.sanskrit: आकाशाद् वायुम् ।
units.english: from Ākāśa to Air;

units.sanskrit: वायुर् भूत्वा धूमो भवति । धूमो भूत्वाभ्रं भवति ॥
units.english: having become Air, they become Smoke; and having become Smoke, they become the Mist

units.sanskrit: यावत्तदुपभोगनिमित्तस्य कर्मणः क्षयः सम्पतन्ति येनेति सम्पातः कर्मणः क्षयो यावत्सम्पातं यावत्कर्मणः क्षय इत्यर्थः तावत्तस्मिंश्चन्द्रमण्डल उषित्वाथानन्तरमेतमेव वक्ष्यमाणमध्वानं मार्गं पुनर्निवर्त्नते ।
units.english: By the time that the Kārmic force to which the heavenly pleasures are due become exhausted;the term ‘sampāta’ stands for that whereby there is exhaustion of the Kārmic force;so the meaning is ‘by the time that the Kārmic force becomes exhaustedhaving dwelt in the Lunar Region, they return again immediately by the path going to be described

units.sanskrit: पुनर्निवर्तन्त इति प्रयोगात्पूर्वमप्यसकृच्चन्द्रमण्डलं गता निवृत्ताश्चा'सन्निति गम्यते ।
units.english: The use of the phrase ‘return again’ indicates that the persons concerned had previously also gone to the Lunar Region and returned therefrom;

units.sanskrit: तस्मादिह लोक इष्टादिकर्मोपचित्य चन्द्रं गच्छन्ति ।
units.english: while, in this Region, these persons, having developed their Kārmic force, go over to the Moon;

units.sanskrit: तत्क्षये चा'वर्तन्ते । क्षणमात्रमपि तत्र स्थातुं न लभ्यते ।
units.english: and when this force is exhausted, they return, and they are not allowed to stay there for a single moment after that;

units.sanskrit: स्थितिनिमित्तकर्मक्षयात् । स्नेहक्षयादिव प्रदीपस्य ।
units.english: because their going there was due entirely to the Kārmic force and this force has become exhausted;just as the lamp disappears on the exhaustion of the oilsupply

units.sanskrit: तत्र किं येन कर्मणा चन्द्रमण्डलमारूढस्तस्य सर्वस्य क्षये तस्मादवरोहणं किं वा सावशेष इति । किं ततः । यदि सर्वस्यैव क्षयः कर्मणश्चन्द्रमण्डलस्थस्यैव मोक्षः प्राप्नोति । तिष्ठतु तावत्तत्रैव मोक्षः स्यान्न वेति ।
units.english: QuestionWhen one has reached the Lunar Region as the result of his Kārmic force, and descends from there,does this descent take place after the total exhaustion of that force? Or, while there is still some remnant of it left?Well, what if it is?If the entire Kārmic force is exhausted, then Liberation should follow immediately, while the man is still in the Lunar Regions as on exhaustion of the Kārmic force, there is nothing that can keep him from Liberation;

units.sanskrit: तत आगतस्येह शरीरोपभोगादि न सम्भवति ।
units.english: The answer to the above is as followsThe Man has reached the Lunar Regions as the result of the Kārmic farce set up by his performance of acts of public utility and of charity;

units.sanskrit: ततः शेषेणेत्यादिस्मृतिविरोधश्च स्यात् । नन्विष्टापूर्तदत्तव्यतिरेकेणापि मनुष्यलोके शरीरोपभोगनिमित्तानि कर्माण्यनेकानि सम्भवन्ति ।
units.english: and in this world of men, there are many acts done apart from those of public utility and charity; and it is possible that there would be many such acts the Kārmic force of which would lead to the man’s having a physical body and experiences on rebirth;

units.sanskrit: न च तेषां चन्द्रमण्डल उपभोगः ।
units.english: and these experiences cannot all be gone through in the Lunar Regions;

units.sanskrit: अतो ऽक्षीणानि तानि ।
units.english: these therefore would remain unexhausted;

units.sanskrit: यन्निमितं चन्द्रमण्डलमारूढस्तान्येव क्षीणानीत्यविरोधः ।
units.english: and only those acts and their Residual forces would be exhausted by virtue of which the Man had reached the Lunar Regions

units.sanskrit: शेषशब्दश्च सर्वेषां कर्मत्वसामान्यादविरुद्धः ।
units.english: As for the term ‘remnant there can be no incongruity in its use, as it refers to all acts in general not to any particular set of acts, such as those of public utility

units.sanskrit: अत एव च तत्रैव मोक्षः स्यादिति दोषाभावः ।
units.english: Thus then, there is no room for the objection that Liberation would follow then and there

units.sanskrit: विरुद्धानेकयोन्युपभोगफलानां च कर्मणामेकैकस्य जन्तोरारम्भकत्वसम्भवात् ।
units.english: As a matter of fact, whenever any single person is born in the world, such birth may be the result of any one of his numerous acts which are conducive to experiences to be gone through in several mutually incompatible bodies

units.sanskrit: न चैकस्मिञ्जन्मनि सर्वकर्मणां क्षय उपपद्यते ।
units.english: So that it is not possible for the whole Kārmic Residue of the man to be exhausted during a single life

units.sanskrit: ब्रह्महत्यादेश्चैकैकस्य कर्मणो ऽनेकजन्मारम्भकत्वस्मरणात् । स्थावरादिप्राप्तानां चात्यन्तमूढानामुत्कर्मषहेतोः कर्मण आरम्भकत्वासम्भवात् । गर्भभूतानां च स्रंसमानानां कर्मासम्भवे संसारानुपपत्तिः ।
units.english: Further, it has been declared that there are many such acts as Brāhmaṇamurder and other heinous crimes which lead to the person being born during; several lives Further, such persons as have come to be born as inanimate things as the result of grave misdeeds, as these would be entirely dull and nonintelligent, there is no possibility of their doing any such act of superior merit as would lead to an improvement in their position

units.sanskrit: तस्मान्नैकस्मिञ्जन्मनि सर्वेषां कर्मणामुपभोगः ।
units.english: From all this it follows that the experiences resulting from all one’s acts cannot be gone through during a single life

units.sanskrit: यत्तु कैश्चिदुच्यते सर्वकर्मश्रियोपमर्देन प्रायणे कर्मणां जन्मारम्भकत्वम् ।
units.english: Some people have asserted as followsAt the time of death all the Kārmic Residue that was ‘operative Prārabdha, during the life having become exhausted,and the substratum of all the rest of the Man’s Kārmic Residue,in the shape of the deadbodyhaving become destroyed by death,these remaining Residues lead to the birth of a new Body

units.sanskrit: तत्र कानिचित्कर्माण्यनारम्भकत्वेनैव तिष्ठन्ति कानिचिज्जन्मा'रभन्त इति नोपपद्यते ।
units.english: Of these Kārmic residues it is not possible that while some of them become actively operative in bringing about the birth, some continue to remain inoperative;

units.sanskrit: मरणस्य सर्वकर्माभिव्यञ्जकत्वात्स्वगोचराभिव्यञ्जकप्रदीपवदिति ।
units.english: because Death brings to the fore the entire set of the man’s Kārmic residue;

units.sanskrit: तदसत् ।
units.english: This is not right

units.sanskrit: सर्वस्य सर्वात्मकत्वाभ्युपगमात् ।
units.english: Because the accepted view is that all things are essentially the same everything is of the nature of everything;

units.sanskrit: न हि सर्वस्य सर्वात्मकत्वे देशकालनिमित्तावरुद्धत्वात्सर्वात्मनोपमर्दः कस्यचित्क्वचिदभिव्यक्तिर्वा सर्वात्मनोपपद्यते ।
units.english: and when all is essentially the same as all, there can be no entire distinction of anything, regulated as all things are, by condition, of time and place; nor is the entire manifestation of anything possible, for the same reason

units.sanskrit: तथा कर्मणामपि साश्रयाणां भवेत् ।
units.english: Similarly, in the case of the Kārmic Residue along with their substratum

units.sanskrit: यथा च पूर्वानुभूतमनुष्यमयूरमर्कटादिजन्माभिसंस्कृता विरुद्धानेकवासना मर्कटत्वप्रापकेन कर्मणा मर्कटजन्मा'रभमाणेन नोपमृद्यन्ते तथा कर्माण्यप्यन्यजन्मप्राप्तिनिमित्तानि
units.english: For instance, in a certain case the man’s nature may be beset with numerous tendencies and impressions due to his previous births as Man, Peacock, Ape etc, and if his coming birth happens to be brought about by that portion of his Kārmic Residue which is conducive to making him born as Ape,the rest of his Kārmic Residue and tendenciesdoes not become entirely destroyed or set aside

units.sanskrit: यदि हि सर्वाः पूर्वजन्मानुभववासना उपमृद्येरन्मर्कटजन्मनिमित्तेन कर्मणा मर्कटजन्मन्यारब्धे मर्कटस्य जातमात्रस्य मातुः शाखायाः शाखान्तरगमने मातुरुदरसंलग्नत्वादिकौशलं न प्राप्नोति ।
units.english: If all the tendencies and impressions conducive to other hinds of birth as man or peacock etc were entirely set aside or destroyed, then, in the case when the man has been born as an ape, by virtue of that Kārmic Residue which was conducive to his apish birth, and all the rest of his Kārmic Residue were destroyed after this, then it would not be possible for the ape, immediately on birth, to acquire the capacity to jump from the tree, or remain clinging to, the mother’s breasts;

units.sanskrit: इह जन्मन्यनभ्यस्तत्वात् ।
units.english: because it has not had any practice of these arts during its present birth

units.sanskrit: न चातीतानन्तरजन्मनि मर्कटत्वमेवा'सीत्तस्येति शक्यं वक्तुम् । तं विद्याकर्मणी समन्वारभेते पूर्वप्रज्ञा चैति श्रुतेः ।
units.english: Nor can it be asserted that, during the life immediately preceding the present one, it was an Ape so that the capacities come to it out of that past experienceBecause the Vedic Text declares that Knowledge and Action follow him, as also previous experience Bṛhadā

units.sanskrit: तस्माद्वासनावन्नाशेषकर्मोपमर्द इति शेषकर्मसम्भवः ।
units.english: From all this it follows that just like the tendencies and impressions there can be no destruction of all the Kārmic Residues;

units.sanskrit: यत एवं तस्माच्छेषेणोपभुक्तात्कर्मणः संसार उपपद्यत इति न कश्चिद्विरोधः ।
units.english: Thus, what happens is that the Birth is due to that part of his Kārmic Residue which remains after the exhaustion of that part of it which brought about his experience in the past life;and in this there is no incompatibility or incongruity

units.sanskrit: को ऽसावध्वा यं प्रति निवर्तन्त इत्युच्यते । यथेतं यथागतं निवर्तन्ते ।
units.english: The text now proceeds to answer the questionWhat is that Path to which they return?’By the same Path as they came

units.sanskrit: ननु मासेभ्यः पितृलोकं पितृलोकादाकाशमाकाशाच्चन्द्रमसमिति गमनक्रम उक्तो न तथा निवृत्तिः ।
units.english: ObjectionThe journey outward has been described as being ‘from the regions of the Fathers to Ākāśa, from Ākāśa to the Moon; but the return journey has not been described in this way;

units.sanskrit: किं तर्ह्यकाशाद्वायुमित्यादि, कथं यथेतमित्युच्यते ।
units.english: the return journey is said to be from Ākāśa to Air and so forth;how then can it be said to be ‘by the same Path as they came?

units.sanskrit: नैष दोषः ।
units.english: AnswerThis does not vitiate the statement;

units.sanskrit: आकाशप्राप्तेस्तुल्यत्वात्पृथिवीप्राप्तेश्च न चात्र यथेतमेवेति नियमो ऽनेवंविधमपि निवर्तन्ते पुनर्निवर्तन्ते इति तु नियमः ।
units.english: as the reaching of Ākāśa, and that of Earth, is the same in both journeys Nor, again, does it mean that the Returning is always exactly the same way; as a matter of fact, they return in other ways also;

units.sanskrit: अत उपलक्षणार्थमेतद्यथेतमिति । अतो भौतिकमाकाशं तावत्प्रतिपद्यन्ते ।
units.english: hence when it is said that ‘they return the same way’, it is only by way of illustration Thus, they reach the elemental material Ākāśa

units.sanskrit: यास्तेषां चन्द्रमण्डले शरीरारम्भिका आप आसंस्तास्तेषां तत्रोपभोगनिमित्तानां कर्मणां क्षये विलीयन्ते ।
units.english: As for the Water that made up their body in the Lunar Region, they become dissolved on the exhaustion of that Kārmic Residue to which their experiences in that region had been due;

units.sanskrit: ता विलीना अन्तरिक्षस्था आकाशभूता इव सूक्ष्मा भवन्ति ता अन्तरिक्षाद्वायुर्भवन्ति ।
units.english: just like clarified Butter on contact with fire;on being dissolved it continues to remain in subtle form, in the Sky, having been turned into Ākāśa;

units.sanskrit: वायुप्रतिष्ठा वायुभूता इतश्चामुतश्चोह्यमानास्ताभिः सह क्षीणकर्मा वायुभूतो भवति ।
units.english: and from the sky, the Water turns into Air, and resting in Air, and becoming turned into Air, it becomes carried about hither and thither; and the person whose Kārmic Residue has been exhausted also becomes turned into Air

units.sanskrit: वायुर्भूत्वा ताभिः सहैव धूमो भवति । धूमो भूत्वाभ्रमब्भरणमात्ररूपो भवति ॥
units.english: Having become Air, he, along with the Water, becomes Smoke;having become Smoke, he becomes Mist, which looks like being filled with water

units.sanskrit: अभ्रं भूत्वा मेघो भवति । मेघो भूत्वा प्रवर्षति ।
units.english: Having become Mist, he becomes the Rainproducing Cloud;having become the Cloud, he rains;

units.sanskrit: त इह व्रीहियवा ओषधिवनस्पतयस् तिलमासा इति जायन्ते ऽतो वै खलु दुर्निष्प्रपतरम् । यो यो ह्य् अन्नम् अत्ति यो रेतः सिञ्चति तद् भूय एव भवति ॥
units.english: ie the man with the remnant of his Kārmic Residue falls down in the shape of torrents of rain;then they are born as,in the form ofrice and barley, herbs and trees

units.sanskrit: वर्षधारारूपेण शेषकर्मा पततीत्यर्थः । त इह व्रीहियवा ओषधिवनस्पतयस्तिलमाषा इत्येवंप्रकारा जायन्ते ।
units.english: As the number of persons with partly exhausted Kārmic Residue is a large one, and are born in so many diverse forms they have been spoken of by a word in the plural number ‘they’

units.sanskrit: क्षीणकर्मणामनेकत्वाद्बहुवचननिर्देशः । मेघादिषु पूर्वेष्वेकरूपत्वादेकवचननिर्देशः ।
units.english: In the form of Cloud and the rest, on the other hand, they all appear in the single forms of Cloud etc, hence in that connection the singular number has been used;

units.sanskrit: यस्माद्गिरितटदुर्गनदीसमुद्रारण्यमरुदेशादिसन्निवेशसहस्राणि वर्षधाराभिः पतितानाम् ।
units.english: in the case of raintorrents, they are found to have thousands of places like mountainsides, caves, rivers, ocean, forests, deserts, and so forth

units.sanskrit: अतस्तस्माद्धेतोर्वै खलु दुर्निष्प्रपतरं दुर्निष्क्रमणं दुर्निःसरणम् ।
units.english: For this reason, henceforth exit becomes extremely difficult,difficult to move, difficult to get out of;

units.sanskrit: यतो गिरितटादुदकस्रोतसोह्यमाना नदीः प्राप्नुवन्ति ततः समुद्रं ततो मकारादिभिर्भक्ष्यन्ते ।
units.english: as being carried away by the water flowing down the mountain sides, they reach the rivers, thence the ocean; there they are eaten by alligators and other animals;

units.sanskrit: ते ऽप्यन्येन ।
units.english: these animals also are eaten up by other animals;

units.sanskrit: तत्रैव च सह मकरेण समुद्रे विलीनाः समुद्राम्भोभिर्जलधरैराकृष्टाः पुनर्वर्षधाराभिर्मरुदेशे शिलातटे वागम्ये पतितास्तिष्ठन्ति कदाचिद्व्यालमगादिपीता
units.english: thus, along with the alligator, becoming dissolved in the ocean, they become drawn, along with the seawater, by the clouds and falling, in the form of raintorrents, come to rest upon such inaccesible places as the desert or a rock; sometimes however they are drunk up by serpents and wild animals, and eaten by others;

units.sanskrit: भक्षिताश्चान्यैः ।
units.english: and those again by others;

units.sanskrit: ते ऽप्यन्यैरित्येवंप्रकाराः परिवर्तेरन् । कदाचिदभक्ष्येषु स्थावरेषु जातास्तत्रैव शुष्येरन् ।
units.english: and so on they would go on in a round of Evolution;in some cases, they would fall upon such inanimate things as are not eatable, and become dry and evaporated there;

units.sanskrit: भक्ष्येष्वपि स्थावरेषु जातानां रेतःसिग्देहसम्बन्धो दुर्लभ एव बहुत्वात्स्थावराणामित्यतो दुर्निष्क्रमणत्वम् ।
units.english: even among those who become edible inanimate things, it is difficult to become connected with the body of a person capable of ‘sowing the seed because the number of inanimate things is so large;

units.sanskrit: अथवातो ऽस्माद्व्रीहियवादिभावाद्दुर्निष्प्रपतरं दुर्निर्गमतरम् । दुर्निष्प्रपतरमिति तकार एको लुप्तो द्रष्टव्यः । व्रीहियवादिभावो दुर्निष्प्रपतस्तस्मादपि दुर्निष्प्रपताद्रेतःसिग्देहसम्बन्धो दुर्निष्प्रपततर इत्यर्थः । यस्मादूर्ध्वरेतोभिर्बालैः पुंस्त्वरहितैः स्थविरैर्वा भक्षिता अन्तराले शीर्यन्ते ।
units.english: this is what makes the exit extremely difficult Or, the term ‘Durniṣprapatara ’ may be taken to mean that ‘exit herefrom is more difficult than from the position of rice and barley’ etc,this interpretation would involve the assumption of an additional ‘ta’, the form being ‘Durniṣprapatatara ’,in the sense that ‘the position of rice and barley’ etc, is itself difficult to get out of ‘Durniṣprapata’, ‘and more difficult than this is the exit from connection with a body capable of ‘sowing the seed’, because there are many such bodies of human beings who are entirely celibate or infants or persons devoid of masculine virility, and when food is eaten up by these, it perishes without further Procreation;

units.sanskrit: अनेकत्वादन्नादानाम् ।
units.english: because the number of foodeaters is so large

units.sanskrit: कदाचित्काकतालीयवृत्त्या रेतःसिग्भिर्भक्ष्यन्ते यदा तदा रेतः सिग्भावं गतानां कर्मणो वृत्तिलाभः ।
units.english: It is only by sheer chance that once in a way, the food comes to be eaten by persons capable of sowing the seed and when thus they have attained the position of such ‘sowers of seed’, then their Kārmic Residues come to secure a position enabling it to function

units.sanskrit: कथम् । यो यो ह्यन्नमत्त्यनुशयिभिः संश्लिष्टं रेतः सिञ्चत्यृतुकाले योषिति तद्भूय एव तदाकृतिरेव भवति ।
units.english: How?Whoeverperson capable of ‘sowing the seed’, eats food connected with the latent personalities with Kārmic Residues,and who sows the seed,in the woman, during her courses,he becomes like unto him;

units.sanskrit: तदवयवाकृतिभूयस्त्वं भूय इत्युच्यते रेतोरूपेण योषितो गर्भशये ऽन्तः प्रविष्टो ऽनुशयी । रेतसो रेतःसिगाकृतिभावितत्वात् । सर्वेभ्यो ऽङ्गेभ्यस्तेजः संभूतमिति हि श्रुत्यन्तरात् ।
units.english: that is, of the same shape as the ‘sower of seedthe term ‘bhūyaḥ’ signifies a large measure of resemblance in features; what happens is that the latent personality with his Kārmic Residue enters the womb of the woman, in the form of the ‘seed’, and the ‘seed’ bears the features of the ‘sower of the seed’says another Vedic text‘The vigour was produced out of all limbs’;

units.sanskrit: अतो रेतःसिगाकृतिरेव भवतीत्यर्थः ।
units.english: hence it is only natural that he comes to resemble the ‘sower of the seed’

units.sanskrit: तथा हि ।
units.english: Thus, then it is that from Man

units.sanskrit: पुरुषात्पुरुषो जायते गोर्गवाकृतिरेव न जात्यन्तराकृतिस्तस्माद्युक्तं तद्भूय एव भवतीति ।
units.english: is born Man; and from the cow only animals with the bovine shape; and not animals with other shapes Hence, it is only right to say that ‘he becomes like unto him’

units.sanskrit: ये त्वन्ये ऽनुशयिभ्यश्चन्द्रमण्डलमनारुह्येहैव पापकर्मभिर्घोरैव्रीहियवादिभावं प्रतिपद्यन्ते पुनर्मनुष्यादिभावं तेषां नानुशयिनामिव
units.english: There are others apart from these personalities with their Kārmic Residues who fail to ascend to the Lunar Region, and by reason of their extremely sinful acts, they reach the position of rice, barley etc, and then go on to the position of Man;for these the exit is not so difficult as in the case of the abovementioned latent personalities with the Kārmic Residue

units.sanskrit: दुर्निष्प्रतरम् । कस्मात् ।
units.english: Why?Because the body of rice and barley etc

units.sanskrit: कर्मणा हि तैर्व्रीहियवादिदेह उपात्त इति तदुपभोगनिमित्तक्षये व्रीह्यादिस्तम्बदेहविनाशे यथाकर्मार्जितं देहान्तरं नवं नवं जलूकावत्संक्रमन्ते सविज्ञाना एवसविज्ञानो
units.english: has been taken by the person, as a result of their karma,and when this karma has become exhausted through experience, the body due to that karmaof rice and other things, down to the tuft of grass,becomes destroyed,‘and other new bodies, in due course, become taken up, in accordance with the nature of his karma;

units.sanskrit: भवति सविज्ञानमेवान्ववक्रामतिइति श्रुत्यन्तरात् ।
units.english: as declared in the text ‘he becomes endowed with consciousness and they move along while still conscious’ Bṛhadā iv

units.sanskrit: यद्यप्युसंहृतकरणाः सन्तो देहान्तरं गच्छन्ति तथापि स्वप्नवद्देहान्तरप्राप्तिनिमित्तकर्मोद्भावितवासनाज्ञानेन सविज्ञाना एव देहान्तरं
units.english: [The difference between the two cases, according to Ānandagiri, is as follows In the former case, where the man has reached the Lunar Region and descends from there, becoming connected with the bodies of rice, barley etc, the time taken in taking up another body is a long one;

units.sanskrit: गच्छन्ति ।
units.english: hence the exit is difficult’]

units.sanskrit: श्रुतिप्रामाण्यात् । तथार्चिरादिना धूमादिना च गमनं स्वप्त इवोद्भूतविज्ञानेन ।
units.english: This statement is based upon the authority of the Veda For instance, the passing through Light and through Smoke is always accompanied by consciousness as in a dream in both cases, the consciousness being due to tendencies and impressions left by past deeds

units.sanskrit: लब्धवृत्तिकर्मनिमित्तत्वाद्गमनस्य ।
units.english: That this is so is due to the fact that the said passing through Light and Smoke is the direct result of such Kārmic Residues as have become operative and begun to operate

units.sanskrit: न तथानुशयिनां व्रीह्यादिभावेन जातानां सविज्ञानमेव रेतःसिग्योषिद्देहसम्बन्ध उपपद्यते ।
units.english: In the case of those, however, who pass on with their Kārmic Residue clinging to them and who are born as Rice, Barley, etc, it is not possible for these to be conscious of their connection with the procreating agents,the woman and the seedsower;

units.sanskrit: न हि व्रीह्यादिलवनकण्डनपेषणादौ च सविज्ञानानां स्थितिरस्ति ।
units.english: it is not possible for conscious beings to be living in the rice etc, while they go through the process of being cut, thumped, ground down and so forth

units.sanskrit: ननु चन्द्रमण्डलादप्यवरोहतां देहान्तरगमनस्य तुल्यत्वाज्जलूकावत्सविज्ञानतैव युक्ता ।
units.english: ObjectionIn the other case also, where the entities descend from the Lunar Region, the entering into another body is exactly like such entering in the case of those who have not reached the Lunar Region; so that in the former case also the leechlike moving out from one body to another must be accompanied by consciousness

units.sanskrit: तथा सति घोरो नरकानुभव इष्टापूर्तादिकारिणां चन्द्रमण्डलादारभ्य प्राप्तो यावद्ब्राह्मणादिजन्म । तथा च सत्यनर्थायैवेष्टापूर्ताद्युपासनं विहितं स्यात् ।
units.english: And if that be so, then for performers of sacrifices and works of public utility there would be terrible experiences of hell involved throughout the process of descending from the Lunar Region and being ultimately born as Brāhmaṇa etc, as during all this process, the entity would, ex hypothesi, be fully conscious;and this being so, it would come to this, that the injunction of sacrifices and works of public utility really tend to evil consequences;

units.sanskrit: श्रुतेश्चाप्रामाण्यं प्राप्तं वैदिकानां कर्मणामनर्थानुबन्धित्वात् ।
units.english: and this would shake the authority of the Veda, for the simple reason that acts enjoined in the Veda lead to evil consequences

units.sanskrit: न, वृक्षारोहणपतनवद्विशेषसम्भवात् ।
units.english: AnswerIt is not so Because there is a difference between the two cases, just as there is between going up the tree and falling down from it

units.sanskrit: देहाद्देहान्तरं प्रतिपित्सोः कर्मणो लब्धवृत्तित्वाकर्मणोद्भावितेन विज्ञानेन सविज्ञानत्वं युक्तम् । वृक्षाग्रमारोहत इव फलं जिघृक्षोः ।
units.english: It is right that when the entity is passing from one body to the other, he should remain conscious, with the consciousness brought about by that Kārmic Residue which has become operative;just as when one is going up a tree for the purpose of plucking its fruit he is fully conscious;

units.sanskrit: तथार्चिरादिना गच्छतां सविज्ञानत्वं भवेत् । धूमादिना च चन्द्रमण्डलमारुरुक्षताम् ।
units.english: it is on this analogy that consciousness would be present in the entities passing through Light and Smoke, while desirous of reaching the Lunar Region

units.sanskrit: न तथा चन्द्रमण्डलादवरुरुक्षतां वृक्षाग्रादिव पततां सचेतनत्वम् ।
units.english: There would be no such consciousness in the case of the entity descending from the Lunar Region; just as there is no consciousness in the man falling down from the tree

units.sanskrit: यथा च मुद्गराद्यभिहतानां तदभिघातवेदनानिमित्तसंमूर्छितप्रतिबद्धकरणानां स्वदेहेनैव देशाद्देशान्तरं नीयमानानां विज्ञानशून्यता दृष्टा तथा चन्द्रमण्डलान्मानुषादिदेहान्तरं प्रत्यवरुरुक्षतां स्वर्गभोगनिमित्तकर्मक्षयान्मृदिताब्देहानां प्रतिबद्धकरणानाम् ।
units.english: In the case of men struck down by a club or some such instrument, they have all their organs of sensations benumbed and rendered inoperative by the pain caused by that stroke, we find that they are carried along from place to place, in a state of complete unconsciousnesssimilarly, in the case of persons descending from the Lunar Region into the lunar and other bodies, the Kārmic Residue that had led them to the enjoyment of pleasures in Heaven having become exhausted, their aqueous body becomes dissolved and all organs of sensation are rendered inoperative;

units.sanskrit: अतस्ते ऽपरित्यक्तदेहबीजभूताभिरद्भिर्मूर्छिता इवा'काशादिक्रमेणेमामवरुह्य कर्मनिमित्तजातिस्थावरदेहैः संश्लिष्यन्ते प्रतिबद्धकरणतयानुद्भूतविज्ञाना
units.english: hence those entities, rendered unconscious, but still attached to the water that formed the seed of their precious body, descend through Ākāśa etc, and become attached to such inanimate bodies as are ordained by their Kārmic Residues;

units.sanskrit: तथा लवनकण्डनपेषणसंस्कारभक्षणरसादिपरिणामरेतःसेककालेषु मूर्छितवदेव ।
units.english: Thus throughout the time taken by the processes of cutting, thumping, grinding, cooking, eating, digesting, turning into juices, and the first ‘sowing of the seed;the entity remains as if unconscious;

units.sanskrit: देहान्तरारम्भकस्य कर्मणो ऽलब्धवृत्तित्वात् ।
units.english: specially as till then that part of his Kārmic Residue which would produce for him the next body has not yet become operative;

units.sanskrit: देहबीजभूताप्सम्बन्धापरित्यागेनैव सर्वास्ववस्थासु वर्तन्त इति जलूकावच्चेतनावत्त्वं न विरुध्यते ।
units.english: and throughout all theseprocesses, these entities do not lose all contact with the aqueous seed of their previous bodies and hence remain in that unconscious condition equipped with that aqueous seed as their bodies;

units.sanskrit: अन्तराले त्वविज्ञानं मूर्छितवदेवेत्यदोषः ।
units.english: and such momentary consciousness would not be incompatible with our view, though during the whole of the intervening process, they remain unconscious

units.sanskrit: न च वैदिकानां कर्मणां हिंसायुक्तत्वेनोभयहेतुत्वं शक्यमनुमातुम् ।
units.english: Nor is it right to argue that the rites prescribed in the Veda being attended with violence and injury, must be the cause of both merit and demerit

units.sanskrit: हिंसायाः शास्त्रचोदितत्वात् ।
units.english: Because the said violence has been actually enjoined by the scriptures;

units.sanskrit: अहिंसन्सर्वभूतान्यन्यत्र तीर्थेभ्यःइति श्रुतेः शास्त्रचोदिताया हिंसाया नाधर्महेतुत्वमभ्युपगम्यते ।
units.english: clearly indicates the view that there is no justification for the view that the violence killing enjoined by the scriptures is conducive to Demerit evil

units.sanskrit: अभ्युपगते ऽप्यधर्महेतुत्वे मन्त्रैर्विषादिवत्तदपनयोपपत्तेर्न दुःखकार्यारम्भकत्वोपपत्तिर्वैदिकानां कर्मणां मन्त्रेणेव विषभक्षणस्येति
units.english: Even if such a view were accepted, that the killing involved in the enjoined acts is conducive to evil, such evil could be removed by means of Mantras, just as poisons are removed; consequently, there is no possibility of acts prescribed in the Veda bringing about effects productive of pain, just as the effects of taking poison are rendered ineffective by Mantras

units.sanskrit: तद् य इह रमणीयचरणा अभ्याशो ह यत् ते रमणीयां योनिम् आपद्येरन् ब्राह्मणयोनिं वा क्षत्रिययोनिं वा वैश्ययोनिं वा ।
units.english: Then, those who have been of good conduct here would quickly attain good birthbirth of Brāhmaṇa, birth of Kṣatriya, or birth of Vaiśya

units.sanskrit: अथ य इह कपूयचरणा अभ्याशो ह यत् ते कपूयां योनिम् आपद्येरञ् श्वयोनिम् वा सूकरयोनिं वा चण्डालयोनिं वा ॥
units.english: And those who have been of bad conduct here attain evil birth,birth of a dog, the birth of a hog, or the birth of a Caṇḍāla

units.sanskrit: तत्तत्र तेष्वनुशयिनां य इह लोके रमणीयं शोभनं चरणं शीलं येषां ते रमणीयचरणाः रमणीयचरणेनोपलक्षितः शोभनो ऽनुशयः पुण्यं कर्म येषां ते रमणीयचरणा उच्यन्ते ।
units.english: Among the entities beset with their Kārmic Residue those who, herein this worldhave been of goad conduct,ie whose action and character have been good,those who have the qualification of good conduct and character,and on that account, whose deeds have been righteous and hence the Kārmic Residue is good,such persons are said to be ‘of good conduct The presence of good Kārmic Residue can always be inferred in persons free from cruelty, falsity and deceit

units.sanskrit: क्रौर्यानृतमायावर्जितानां हि शक्य उपलक्षयितुं शुभानुशयसद्भावः । तेनानुशयेन पुण्येन कर्मणा चन्द्रमण्डले भुक्तशेषेणाभ्याशो ह क्षिप्रमेव ।
units.english: All this Righteous Act and its resultant Kārmic Residue having led to the experiences in the Lunar Region, what has remained of that residue leads to the entity to be quickly, speedily, ‘Yat’ being an adverb,attain good birth,ie birth free from cruelty and other evil qualities

units.sanskrit: यदिति क्रियाविशेषणं ते रमणीयां क्रौर्यादिवर्जितां योनिमापद्येरन्प्राप्नुयुर्ब्राह्मणयोनिं वा क्षत्त्रिययोनिं वा वैश्ययोनिं वा स्वकर्मानुरूपेण अथ पुनर्ये तद्विपरीताः कपूयचरणोपलक्षितकर्माणो ऽशुभानुशया अभ्याशो ह यत्ते कपूयां यथाकर्म योनिमापद्येरन्कपूयामेव धर्मसम्बन्धवर्जितां जुगुप्सितां योनिमापद्येरन्
units.english: Such birth, for instance, as that of the Brāhmaṇa, the Kṣatriya, or the Vaiśya, according to the character of their Kārmic Residue, Thosewho are of the contrary nature, who have been of bad conduct,ie whose acts have been characterised by bad character,and whose Kārmic Residue, on that account, has been bad, they quickly attain evil birth,in accordance with their past deeds,ie such birth as is completely devoid of all merit and righteousness and hence disgusting;such as birth of a dog, of a hog, or of a Caṇḍāla,all according to the character of his own past deeds

units.sanskrit: ये तु रमणीयचरणा द्विजातयस्ते स्वकर्मस्थाश्चेदिष्टादिकारिणस्ते धूमादिगत्या गच्छन्त्यागच्छन्ति च पुनः पुनर्घटीयन्त्रवत् ।
units.english: Those who have been of good conduct and have been born among, the ‘twice born castes’,if they, in their new life, remain firm in their religious obligations and continue to perform sacrifices and other meritorious acts, they go forward, through Smoke and the rest, and come back, again and again, like the waterpulley

units.sanskrit: विद्यां चेत्प्राप्नुयुस्तदार्चिरादिना गच्छन्ति ॥
units.english: If they happen to attain knowledge, then they proceed by the Path of Light and the rest

units.sanskrit: अथैतयोः पथोर् न कतरेणचन तानीमानि क्षुद्राण्य् असकृदावर्तीनि भूतानि भवन्ति जायस्व म्रियस्वेति ।
units.english: Of these two paths,by neither of them do they proceed, who, being small creatures, keep repeatedly revolvingbeing subject to the process of ‘Be born and Die’

units.sanskrit: एतत् तृतीयं स्थानम् ।
units.english: This is the third Position

units.sanskrit: तेनासौ लोको न संपूर्यते ।
units.english: Thus, it is that that other region is never filled

units.sanskrit: तस्माज् जुगुप्सेत ।
units.english: Hence, one should cultivate a feeling of disgust

units.sanskrit: तद् एष श्लोकः ॥
units.english: To this effect, there is the following Verse

units.sanskrit: यदा तु न विद्यासेविनो नापीष्टादिकर्म सेवन्ते तदाथैतयोः पथोर्यथोक्तयोरर्चिर्धूमादिलक्षणयोर्न
units.english: Sometimes people do not attend to knowledge, nor have they recourse to the performance of sacrifices and other acts; and in these cases, these people do not proceed by either of the abovedescribed two Paths of Light and of Smoke;

units.sanskrit: कतरेणान्यतरेणचनापि यन्ति तानीमानि भूतानि क्षूद्राणि दंशमसककीटादीन्यसकृदावर्तीनि भवन्ति ।
units.english: in fact, these small creatures,in the shape of the flea, the mosquito, the insects and so forth, keep repeatedly revolving;

units.sanskrit: अत उभयमार्गपरिभ्रष्टा ह्यसकृज्जायन्ते म्रियन्ते चेत्यर्थः ।
units.english: that is, having fallen from both Paths, they die and are born again and again

units.sanskrit: तेषां जननमरणसन्ततेरनुकरणमिदमुच्यते । जायस्व म्रियस्वेतीश्वरनिमित्तचेष्टोच्यते ।
units.english: The continuation of their births and deaths is expressed imitatively by means of the two imperative verbs ‘Be Born’ and ‘Die’, which are supposed to be the direction of God

units.sanskrit: जननमरणलक्षणेनैव कालयापना भवति । न तु क्रियासु भोगेषु वा कालो ऽस्तीत्यर्थः ।
units.english: The meaning is that all their time is taken up by the processes of Death and Birth, and there is no time during which acts are performed or their resultant experiences gone through

units.sanskrit: एतत्क्षुद्रजन्तुलक्षणं तृतीयं पूर्वोक्तौ पन्थानावपेक्ष्य स्थानं संसरताम् ।
units.english: This position of the small creatures, represents the third position for people fallen on the wheel of birth and death, in reference to, and as distinguished from the two Paths described above

units.sanskrit: येनैवं दक्षिणमार्गगा अपि पुनरागच्छन्त्यनधिकृतानां ज्ञानकर्मणोरगमनमेव दक्षिणेन पथेति ।
units.english: Thus then, those who proceed by the ‘Southern Path’ also return to this world;and those who are not entitled to Knowledge or Ritualistic Acts naturally never proceed even by the ‘Southern Path’

units.sanskrit: तेनासौ लोको न संपूर्यते ।
units.english: And the result of all this is that that other world is not filled up

units.sanskrit: पञ्चमस्तु प्रश्नः पञ्चाग्निविद्यया व्याख्यातः ।
units.english: Thus, the fifth question has been answered by the Philosophy of the Five Fires

units.sanskrit: प्रथमो दक्षिणोत्तरमार्गाभ्यामपाकृतो दक्षिणोत्तरयोः पथोर्व्यावर्तनापि मृतानामग्नौ प्रक्षेपः समानस्ततो व्यावर्तनान्ये ऽर्चिरादिना यन्त्यन्ये
units.english: The first question has been answered by the description of the Northern and Southern Paths The question relating to the Diverging point between the Northern and Southern Paths,also has been answered; that the Dead are thrown into the Fire, is the same in both Paths;

units.sanskrit: धूमादिना । पुनरुत्तरदक्षिणायने षण्मासान्प्रप्नुवन्तः संयुज्य पुनर्व्यावर्तन्ते ।
units.english: it is after this that the ‘divergence’ comes insome going by the Path of Light etc, and others by the Path of Smoke etc;then they come together again at the six months of the Northern circuit and six of the Southern circuit;

units.sanskrit: अन्ये संवत्सरमन्ये मासेभ्यः पितृलोकमिति व्याख्याता ।
units.english: and then again diverge,some going to the Year, and some to the Months direct and then to the Region of the Fathers

units.sanskrit: पुनरावृत्तिरपि क्षीणानुशयानां चन्द्रमण्डलादाकाशादिक्रमेणोक्ता ।
units.english: The Return also of those whose Kārmic Residue has become attenuated, has been described as Jrom the Lunar Region to Ākāśa and so on

units.sanskrit: अमुष्य लोकस्यापूरणं स्वशब्देनैवोक्तम्तेनासौ लोको न संपूर्यत इति ।
units.english: As for the nonfilling of that other world, it has been asserted in so many words by the text itself‘it is thus that the other is never filled’

units.sanskrit: यस्माच्च जन्ममरणजनितवेदनानुभवकृतक्षणाः क्षुद्रजन्तवो ध्वान्ते च घोरे दुस्तरे प्रवेशिताः सागर इवागाधे ऽप्लवे निराशाश्चोत्तरणं प्रति तस्माच्चैवंविधां संसारगतिं जुगुप्सेत बीभत्सेत घृणी भवेन्मा भूदेवंविधे संसारमहोदधौ घोरे पात इति ।
units.english: Since, the process of the Births and Rebirths is so beset with troubles, therefore, one should cultivate a feeling of disgust That is, because it is found that wretched creatures are every moment of their life taken up by the pangs of births and deaths and are thrust into illimitable terrible darkness,like the unnavigable ocean, and having no hope of going out,therefore one should cultivate feelings of disgust towards this process of Birth and Rebirth,avoid it, shun it, praying that ‘may never fall into this terrible metempsyclic ocean ’

units.sanskrit: तदेतस्मिन्नर्थ एष श्लोकः पञ्चाग्निविद्यास्तुततये ॥
units.english: To this effect,as suming up all this,there is the following verse, in praise of the Philosophy of the Five Fires

units.sanskrit: स्तेनो हिरण्यस्य सुरां पिबंश् च । गुरोस् तल्पम् आवसन् ब्रह्महा च । एते पतन्ति चत्वारः पञ्चमश् चाचरंस् तैर् इति ॥
units.english: ‘One who steals gold, one who drinks wine, one who dishonours the teacher’s bed, and one who kills the Brāhmaṇa,all these four do fall, as also the fifth, one who associates with those’

units.sanskrit: सुरां पिबन्ब्राह्मणः सन् । गुरोश्च तल्पं दारानावसन् । ब्रह्महा ब्राह्मणस्य हन्ता चेत्येते पतन्ति चत्वारः ।
units.english: One who steals gold;ie gold belonging to the Brāhmaṇaone who being a Brāhmaṇa,drinks wine, one who dishonours the teacher’s bed,his wife,one who kills a Brāhmaṇa,these four fall;

units.sanskrit: पञ्चमश्च तैः सहा'चरन्निति ॥
units.english: and also the fifths one who associates with those

units.sanskrit: अथ ह य एतान् एवं पञ्चाग्नीन् वेद न सह तैर् अप्य् आचरन् पाप्मना लिप्यते ।
units.english: ‘One who thus knows these Five Fires,even though he associates with those,does not become contaminated by sin

units.sanskrit: शुद्धः पूतः पुण्यलोको भवति य एवं वेद य एवं वेद ॥
units.english: He becomes pure and clean and attains pure regions,who knows this thus,yea who knows this thus’0

units.sanskrit: अथ ह पुनर्यो यथोक्तान्पञ्चाग्नीन्वेद स तैरप्याचरन्महापातकिभिः सह न पाप्मना लिप्यते शुद्ध एव ।
units.english: But one who knows the five fires as described above,even if he associates with the said great sinners, does not become contaminated by sin

units.sanskrit: तेन पञ्चाग्निदर्शनेन पावितो यस्मात्पूतः पुण्यो लोकः प्राजापत्यादिर्यस्य सो ऽयं पुण्यलोको भवति य एवं वेद यथोक्तं समस्तं पञ्चभिः प्रश्नैः पृष्टमर्थजातं वेद ।
units.english: He is pure and clean by virtue of the Philosophy of the Five Fires, and attains the pure Regions of Prajāpati and other deities,one who knows the whole of the philosophy as above expounded, along with the five questions that had been asked

units.sanskrit: द्विरुक्तिः समस्तप्रश्ननिर्णयप्रदर्शनार्था ॥
units.english: The repetition is meant to indicate that all the questions have been fully disposed of

units.sanskrit: को न आत्मा किं ब्रह्मेति ॥
units.english: End of Section 0 of Discourse

units.sanskrit: दक्षिणेन पथा गच्छतामन्नभाव उत्कस्तद्देवानामन्नं तं देवा भक्षयन्तीति ।
units.english: It has been explained above that those who go by the Southern Path become ‘food’,in the passage ‘That food, the Deities eat’;

units.sanskrit: क्षुद्रजन्तुलक्षणा च कष्टा संसारगतिरुक्ता ।
units.english: it has also been described that there is also a very troublesome course of births and rebirths whereby they become small animals

units.sanskrit: तदुभयदोषपरिजिर्हीर्षया वैश्वानरात्तृभावप्रतिपत्त्यर्थमुत्तरो ग्रन्थ आरभ्यते ।
units.english: In order to avoid both these undesirable contingencies, it is necessary for one to become the Vaiśvānara Fire who is the ‘eater of food’;

units.sanskrit: अत्स्यन्नं पश्यसि प्रियमित्यादिलिङ्गात् ।
units.english: and to that end, the following section has been introduced

units.sanskrit: आख्यायिका तु सुखावबोधार्था विद्यासम्प्रदानन्यायाप्रदर्शनार्था चप्राचीनशाल इति नामत उपमन्योरपत्यमौपमन्यवः ।
units.english: PrācīnaśālaAupamanyava, SatyayajñaPauluṣi, IndradyumnaBhāllaveya,JanaŚārkarākṣya and BuḍilaĀśvatarāśvi,these great Householders and great Vedic Scholars, having come together, held a discussion as to ‘what is our Self?’, ‘what is Brahman?’

units.sanskrit: सत्ययज्ञो नामतः पुलुषस्यापत्यं पौलुषिः । तथेन्द्रद्युम्नो नामतो भल्लवेरपत्यं भाल्लविस्तस्यापत्यं भाल्लवेयः । जन इति नामतः शर्कराक्षस्यापत्यं शार्कराक्ष्यः ।
units.english: Prācīnaśāla,by name,Aupamanyava, the son of Upamanyu;Satyayajñaby name,Pauluṣi, the son of Puluṣa;Indradyumnaby name,Bhāllaveya, the son of Bhāllavi, who was the son of Bhallava;Janaby name,Śārkarākṣya,the son of Śarkarākṣa;

units.sanskrit: बुडिलो नामतो ऽश्वतराश्वस्यापत्यमाश्वतराश्विः ।
units.english: Buḍilaby name, Āśvatarāśvi,the son of Āśvatarāśva

units.sanskrit: पञ्चापि ते हैते महाशाला महागृहस्था विस्तीर्णाभिः शालाभिर्युक्ताः सम्पन्ना इत्यर्थः ।
units.english: All these five were Great Householders,possessed of extensive houses, ie rich,Great Vedic Scholars,fully equipped with Vedic learning and good conduct

units.sanskrit: त एवंभूताः सन्तः समेत्य संभूय क्वचिन्मीमांसा विचारणां चक्रुः कृतवन्त इत्यर्थः । कथम् । को नो ऽस्माकमात्मा किं ब्रह्मेत्यात्मब्रह्मशब्दयोरितरेतरविशेषणविशेष्यत्वम् ।
units.english: All these coming together,met somewhere,held a discussiona consultation;in what manner?as to what is our Self, and what is Brahman The terms ‘Self’ and ‘Brahman’ qualify one another; the term ‘Brahman’ excludes the limited Self encased within the body;

units.sanskrit: ब्रह्मेत्यध्यात्मपरिच्छिन्नमात्मानं निवर्तयत्यात्मेति चा'त्मव्यतिरिक्तस्या'दित्यादिब्रह्मण उपास्यत्वं निवर्तयति ।
units.english: and the term ‘Self’ excludes the Brahman in the form of the Sun and other manifestations apart from the Self as objects of meditation;

units.sanskrit: अभेदेना'त्मैव ब्रह्म ब्रह्मैवा'त्मेत्येवं सर्वात्मा वैश्वानरो ब्रह्म स आत्मेत्येतत्सिद्धं भवति ।
units.english: Self is Brahman and Brahman is Self; and in this way it becomes established that Brahman is the AllSelf, Vaiśvānara, and this is our Self

units.sanskrit: मूर्धा ते व्यपतिष्यदन्धो ऽभविष्यदित्यादिलिङ्गात् ॥
units.english: That this is so that what is the object of meditation is the AllSelf is also indicated by those texts where it has been declared that, If you were to meditate upon the limited Self, not upon the AllSelf, then your head would fall,‘you would become blind’ and so forth

units.sanskrit: ते ह संपादयां चक्रुः । उद्दालको वै भगवन्तो ऽयम् आरुणिः संप्रतीमम् आत्मानं वैश्वानरम् अध्येति ।
units.english: They therefore thought thus‘UddālakaĀruṇi, O, Sirs, is, at present, studying this VaiśvānaraSelf;

units.sanskrit: तं हाभ्याजग्मुः ॥
units.english: let us go to him’;

units.sanskrit: ते ह मीमांसन्तो ऽपि निश्चयमलभमानाः सम्पादयाञ्चक्रुः सम्पादितवन्तः आत्मन उपदेष्टारम् ।
units.english: and they went over to him They carried on the discussion, but did not arrive at any conclusion; therefore they thought,had ah idea of,a teacher for themselves

units.sanskrit: उद्दालको वै प्रसिद्धो नामतो भगवन्तः पूजावन्तो ऽयमारुणिररुणस्यापत्यं सम्प्रति सम्यगिममात्मानं वैश्वानरमस्मदभिप्रेतमध्येति ।
units.english: Uddālakawell known by this name,Āruṇi,the son of Aruṇa,O Sirs,revered gentlemen,is, at present, studying, in the proper manner,this VaiśvānaraSelfwhich we are seeking;

units.sanskrit: तं हन्तेदानीमभ्यागच्छामेत्येवं निश्चित्यं तं हाभ्याजग्मुर्गतवन्तस्तमारुणिम् ॥ स ह संपादयां चकार ।
units.english: let us go to him Having thus made up their mind, they went over to him,went to Āruṇi

units.sanskrit: प्रक्ष्यन्ति माम् इमे महाशाला महाश्रोत्रियाः ।
units.english: He thought‘These great Householders and great Vedic Scholarsare going to question me;

units.sanskrit: तेभ्यो न सर्वम् इव प्रतिपत्स्ये ।
units.english: and cannot tell them anything;

units.sanskrit: हन्ताहम् अन्यम् अभ्यनुशासानीति ॥
units.english: so shall advise them of another teacher

units.sanskrit: स ह तान्दृष्ट्वैव तेषामागमनप्रयोजनं बुद्ध्वा सम्पादयाञ्चकार । कथम् । प्रक्ष्यन्ति मां वैश्वानरमिमे महाशाला महाश्रोत्रियास्तेभ्यो ऽहं न सर्वमिव पृष्टं प्रतिपत्स्ये वक्तुं नोत्सहे ।
units.english: As soon as he saw them, he knew for what purpose they had come, and then thoughtWhat?‘These great Householders and great Vedic Scholars are going to question me regarding the Vaiśvānara,and cannot tell them, dare not tell themeverythingregarding what they ask;hence shall,nowadvise them of another suggest to them another expounder

units.sanskrit: तान् होवाच । अश्वपतिर् वै भगवन्तो ऽयं कैकेयः संप्रतीमम् आत्मानं वैश्वानरम् अध्येति ।
units.english: He said to them‘Revered Sirs, at present, AśvapatiKaikeya is studying this Self;

units.sanskrit: तं हाभ्याजग्मुः ॥
units.english: let us go to him They went over to him

units.sanskrit: एवं सम्पाद्य तान्होवाच । अश्वपतिर्वै नामतो भगवन्तो ऽयं केकयस्यापत्यं कैकेयः सम्प्रति सम्यगिममात्मानं वैश्वानरमध्येतीत्यादि समानम् ॥
units.english: Having thought so, he said to thempatiyby nameKaikeya,the son of Kekaya,at presentis properly studying this Self,Vaiśvānara; etc, etc, as before

units.sanskrit: तेभ्यो ह प्राप्तेभ्यः पृथग् अर्हाणि कारयां चकार ।
units.english: When they approached, he had welcome offered to them separately with proper rites

units.sanskrit: स ह प्रातः संजिहान उवाच । न मे स्तेनो जनपदे न कदर्यो न मद्यपः । नानाहिताग्निर् नाविद्वान् न स्वैरी स्वैरिणी कुतः ।
units.english: The next morning, having risen, he said to them‘In my kingdom, there is no thief, no miser, no drunkard, no man who has not installed the fire, no illiterate person, no adulterer,whence then an adulteress? am going to perform a sacrifice

units.sanskrit: यक्ष्यमाणो वै भगवन्तो ऽहम् अस्मि ।
units.english: Revered Sirs;

units.sanskrit: यावद् एकैकस्मा ऋत्विजे धनं दास्यामि तावद् भगवद्भ्यो दास्यामि ।
units.english: and as much wealth as give to each single officiating priest, shall give the same to you, Respected Sirs, please stay’

units.sanskrit: ते होचुः । येन हैवार्थेन पुरुषश् चरेत् तं हैव वदेत् ।
units.english: They said‘The purpose for which a man comes,that he should speak out

units.sanskrit: आत्मानम् एवेमं वैश्वानरं संप्रत्य् अध्येषि ।
units.english: You are, at present, studying the Self, Vaiśvānara, please expound to us that’

units.sanskrit: तान् होवाच । प्रातर् वः प्रतिवक्तास्मीति । ते ह समित्पाणयः पूर्वाह्णे प्रतिचक्रमिरे ।
units.english: He said,‘ shall answer you, in the morningEarly in the morning, they approached him, with fuel in their hands;

units.sanskrit: तान् हानुपनीयैवैतद् उवाच ॥
units.english: and without ‘initiating’ them, he expounded to them as follows

units.sanskrit: तेभ्यो ह राजा प्राप्तेभ्यः पृथक्पृथगर्हाण्यर्हणानि पुरोहितैर्भृत्यैश्च कारयाञ्चकार कारितवान् । स हान्येद्यू राजा प्रातः सञ्जिहान उवाच विनयेनोपगम्यैतद्धनं मत्त उपादद्ध्वमिति ।
units.english: When they approached him, the kinghad welcome offered to them,through priests and attendants The next day, having risen in the morning, the king approached them with due humility and asked them to accept riches from him

units.sanskrit: तैः प्रत्याख्यातो मयि दोषं पश्यन्ति नूनं यतो न प्रतिगृह्णन्ति मत्तो धनमिति मन्वान आत्मनः सद्वृत्ततां प्रतिपिपादयिषन्नाह । न मे मम जनपदे स्तेनः परस्वहर्ता विद्यते । न कदर्यो ऽदाता सति विभवे । न मद्यपो द्विजोत्तमः सन् । नानाहिताग्निः शतगुः ।
units.english: Being refused by them, he thought,‘these sages perceive in me a certain defect, whereby they refuse to accept gifts from me and pointing out to them how wellbehaved he was, he said ‘In my kingdom, there is no thief,who misappropriates the belongings of others,no miser,who gives not to others, even when he has the intention to do so,no drunkard,no Brāhmaṇas drinking wine,no one who has not installed the fires,even though possessed of a hundred cows,no illiterate person,who has not read all that he is entitled and able to read,no adultererperson associating with another’s wife,hence, how could there by any misbehaved woman?that is, it is not possible

units.sanskrit: तैश्च न वयं धनेनार्धिन इत्युक्त आहअल्पं मत्वैते धनं न गृह्णन्तीति । यक्ष्यमाणो वै कतिभिरहोभिरहं हे भगवन्तो ऽस्मि । तदर्थं कॢप्तं धनं मया यावदेकैकस्मै यथोक्तमृत्विजे धनं दास्यामि तावत्प्रत्येकं भगवद्भ्यो ऽपि दास्यामि । वसन्तु भगवन्तः पश्यन्तु च मम यागमित्युक्तास्ते होचुः ।
units.english: When they said that they did not take riches, the king thought that ‘they consider what am offering too small and hence are not accepting it’, and said‘Revered Sirs, am going to perform a sacrificein a few days,and have set aside wealth for that purpose,and as much wealth as give to each officiating priest, l shall give the sameto each of you, Respected Sirs,please stay and witness my sacrificial performances? Being thus addressed, they said‘The purpose for which a man comesto a person,that he should speak outthat have come for such and such a purpose;

units.sanskrit: इदमेव प्रयोजनमागमनस्येत्ययं न्यायः सताम् । वयं वैश्वानरज्ञानार्थिनः ।
units.english: such is the practice of all good men;we are, in fact, seeking for knowledge of Vaiśvānara;

units.sanskrit: आत्मानमेवेमं वैश्वानरं संप्रत्यध्येषि सम्यग्जानासि ।
units.english: and this SelfVaiśvānara you are studying at present,ie you know It rightly;

units.sanskrit: अतस्तमेव नो ऽस्मभ्यं ब्रूहीत्युक्तस्तान्होवाच । प्रातर्वो युष्मभ्यं प्रतिवक्तास्मि प्रतिवाक्यं दातास्मीत्युक्तास्ते ह राज्ञो ऽभिप्रायज्ञाः समित्पाणयः समिद्भारहस्ता अपरेद्युः पूर्वाह्ने राजानं
units.english: hence expound that to us’Thereupon, he said to them‘In the morning, shall answer you,give you the right answer’Being told thus and understanding what the king meant,with fuel in their hands,ie carrying bundles of fuel in their hands,the next day, early in the morning,they approachedwent over to himthe king

units.sanskrit: यत एवं महाशाला महाश्रोत्रिया ब्राह्मणाः सन्तो महाशालत्वाद्यभिमानं हित्वा समिद्भारहस्ता जातितो हीनं राजानं विद्यार्थिनो विनयेनोपजग्मुः तथान्यैर्विद्योपादित्सुभिर्भवितव्यम् ।
units.english: As these great Householders and great Vedic Scholars, who are Brāhmaṇas, have renounced the pride of these qualifications, and with loads of fuel in their hands, have come with due humility, seeking for knowledge, to me,who is of a lower casteso must behave all those who seek to obtain knowledge

units.sanskrit: तेभ्यश्चादाद्विद्यामनुपनीयैवोपनयनमकृत्वैव तान् ।
units.english: He imparted to them the knowledge they were seeking, without initiating them,without performing the initiatory rites

units.sanskrit: यथा योग्येभ्यो विद्यामदात्तथान्येनापि विद्या दातव्येत्याख्यायिकार्थः ।
units.english: As the king imparted the knowledge to persons who were fit to receive it, so should other persons also impart knowledge to fit pupils;

units.sanskrit: एतद्वैश्वानरविज्ञानमुवाचेति वक्ष्यमाणेन सम्बन्धः ॥ इति च्छान्दोग्योपनिषदि पञ्चमाध्यायस्यैकादशः खण्डः
units.english: and such is the purport of this story,Thereupon he expounded to them, the following Philosophy of the Vaiśvānara; this sentence being construed with what follows End of Section of Discourse

units.sanskrit: औपमन्यव कं त्वम् आत्मानम् उपास्स इति । दिवम् एव भगवो राजन्न् इति होवाच । एष वै सुतेजा आत्मा वैश्वानरो यं त्वम् आत्मानम् उपास्से ।
units.english: ‘Aupamanyava, what is that Self on which you meditate?’He said‘the Heaven, O Revered King’This that you meditate upon as Self is that VaiśvānaraSelf which is highly Brilliant

units.sanskrit: तस्मात् तव सुतं प्रसुतम् आसुतं कुले दृश्यते ॥
units.english: Therefore it is that in your family is seen ‘Suta, Prasuta and Āsuta’

units.sanskrit: स कथमुवाचेत्याहऔपमन्यव हे कमात्मानं वैश्वानरं त्वमुपाःस इति पप्रच्छ ।
units.english: The text describes what the king saidHe asked‘O Aupamanyava, what is that VaiśvānaraSelf which you meditate upon?’

units.sanskrit: नन्वयमपन्यायः आचार्यः सञ्शिष्यं पृच्छतीति ।
units.english: ObjectionThis is highly unfairthat the teacher should question the pupil

units.sanskrit: नैष दोषः ।
units.english: AnswerThere is nothing wrong in this;

units.sanskrit: यद्वेत्थ तेन मोपसीद ततस्त ऊर्ध्वं वक्ष्यामीति न्यायदर्शनात् ।
units.english: the idea in the teachers mind is‘come to me and tell me what you already know, then shall teach you what there is beyond that’, and this method is quite fair

units.sanskrit: अन्यत्राप्याचार्यस्य अप्रतिभानवति शिष्ये प्रतिभोत्पादनार्थः प्रश्नो दृष्टो ऽजातशत्रोःक्वैष तदाभूत्कुत एतदागाद् इति ।
units.english: In other cases also, it has been found that a question has been put by the teacher to a pupil who was not very intelligent, in order to arouse his intelligence; e g, in the case of Ajātaśatru, when the question was put‘Where did this exist then? Whence did it come?’

units.sanskrit: दिवमेव द्युलोकमेव वैश्वानरमुपासे भगवो राजन्निति होवाच । एष वै सुतेजाः शोभनं तेजो यस्य सो ऽयं सुतेजा इति प्रसिद्धो वैश्वानर आत्मा'त्मनो
units.english: ‘O Revered King, meditate upon the Heaventhe Heavenly Regionas the VaiṣvānaraSelf’;he said‘This is that VaiśvānaraSelf which is highly brilliant,ie known as one of high brilliance;

units.sanskrit: ऽवयवभूतत्वाद्यं त्वमात्मानमात्मैकदेशमुपाःसे तस्मात्सुतेजसो वैशेवानरस्योपासनात्तव
units.english: this is called ‘VaiśvānaraSelf’ because it is one part of that Self;this is thus only a part of the Self which you meditate upon

units.sanskrit: सुतमभिषुतं सोमरूपं कर्मणि प्रसुतं प्रकर्षेण च सुतमासुतं चाहर्गणादिषु
units.english: It is on account of this meditation of the ‘Highly Brilliant’ Vaiśvānara that Sutain the form of the Somajuice extracted at the performance of sacrifices, Prasutawhat is extracted in a specially excellent manner, and Āsutawhat is extracted of the Ahargaṇa and other sacrifices,all this is found in your family;

units.sanskrit: तव कुले दृश्यते ऽतीव कर्मिणस्त्वत्कुलीना इत्यर्थः ॥
units.english: that is, people born in your family are performers of sacrificial acts’

units.sanskrit: अत्स्य् अन्नं पश्यसि प्रियम् ।
units.english: ‘You eat food and see what is dear

units.sanskrit: अत्त्य् अन्नं पश्यति प्रियम् भवत्य् अस्य ब्रह्मवर्चसं कुले ये एतम् एवम् आत्मानं वैश्वानरम् उपास्ते ।
units.english: One who meditates upon this VaiśvānaraSelf eats food, sees what is dear and there is Brahmic glory in his family,But this is only the head of the Self;

units.sanskrit: मूर्धा ते व्यपतिष्यद् यन् मां नागमिष्य इति ॥
units.english: and your head would surely have fallen if you had not come to me’ You eat food

units.sanskrit: अत्स्यन्नं दीप्ताग्निः सन्पश्यसि च पुत्रपौत्रादि प्रियमिष्टम् ।
units.english: with sharpened appetite,and see what is dear in the shape of your sonsand grandsons and other agreeable things

units.sanskrit: अन्यो ऽप्यत्त्यन्नं पश्यति च प्रियं भवत्यस्य सुतं प्रसुतमासुतमित्यादिकर्मित्वं; ब्रह्मवर्चसं कुले यः कश्चिदेतं यथोक्तमेवं वैश्वानरमुपास्ते ।
units.english: Another person also eats food and sees what is dear, and there is Suta, Prasuta and Āsuta, and other characteristics of the Ritualist,and there is this Brahmic glory in his family,if he meditates upon the said VaiśvānaraThis however is only the head of the Vaiśvānara

units.sanskrit: मूर्धा त्वात्मनो वैश्वानरस्यैष न समस्तो वैश्वानरः । अतः समस्तबुद्ध्या वैश्वानरस्योपासनान्मूर्धा शिरस्ते विपरीतग्राहिमो व्यपतिष्यद्विपतितमभविष्यत् ।
units.english: not the entire Vaiśvānara;hence on account of your meditating upon this partial Vaiśvānara as the entire Vaiśvānara, your head would have fallen off by reason of your entertaining a wrong notion,if you had not come to me;

units.sanskrit: यद्यदि मां ना'गमिष्यो ना'गतो ऽभविष्यः ।
units.english: that is, you have done well in coming to me’

units.sanskrit: इति च्छान्दोग्योपनिषदि पञ्चमाध्यायस्य द्वादशः खण्डः
units.english: End of Section of Discourse

units.sanskrit: अथ होवाच सत्ययज्ञं पौलुषिम् । प्राचीनयोग्य कं त्वम् आत्मानम् उपास्स इति । आदित्यम् एव भगवो राजन्न् इति होवाच । एष वै विश्वरूप आत्मा वैश्वानरो यं त्वम् आत्मानम् उपास्ते ।
units.english: Then he said to SatyayajñaPauluṣi ‘O, ancient adept, what is that Self on which you meditate?’He replied‘The Sun, O Revered King’‘This that you meditate upon as Self is that Vais vānara Self which is multiform

units.sanskrit: तस्मात् तव बहु विश्वरूपं कुले दृश्यते ॥
units.english: Hence, it is that in your family are seen many allcoloured things’

units.sanskrit: अथ होवाच सत्ययज्ञं पौलुषिं हे प्राचीनयोग्य कं त्वमात्मानमुपास्त इत्यादित्यमेव भगवो राजन्निति होवाच ।
units.english: He said to SatyayajñaPauluṣi‘O ancient adept, what is that Self on which you meditate?’He said‘The Sun, O Revered King,’‘This that you meditate upon is that VaiśvānaraSelf which is multiform’;the Sun is called ‘multiform’, because of the presence there of white, blue and other colours

units.sanskrit: शुक्लनीलादिरूपत्वाद्विश्वरूपत्वमादित्यस्य सर्वरूपत्वाद्वा ।
units.english: or because of its containing all forms; as a matter of fact, all colours have their origin in the Sun;

units.sanskrit: सर्वाणि रूपाणि हि त्वाष्ट्राणि यतो ऽतो वा विश्वरूप आदित्यस्तदुपासनात्तव बहु विश्वरूपमिहामुत्रार्थमुपकरणं दृश्यते कुले ॥
units.english: hence the Sun is ‘multiform and on account of your meditating upon the Sun there are seen in your family many multiform things,in the form of accessories useful in this and in the other world’

units.sanskrit: प्रवृत्तो ऽश्वतरीरथो दासी निष्कः ।
units.english: ‘Ready for you is the chariot with mules, slavegirls and jewels;

units.sanskrit: अत्स्य् अन्नं पश्यसि प्रियम् ।
units.english: you eat food and see what is dear

units.sanskrit: अत्त्य् अन्नं पश्यति प्रियं भवत्य् अस्य ब्रह्मवर्चसं कुले य एतम् एवम् आत्मानं वैश्वानरम् उपास्ते ।
units.english: One who thus meditates upon this VaiśvānaraSelf eats food and sees what is dear; and there is Brahmic glory in his family

units.sanskrit: चक्षुष् ट्व् एतद् आत्मन इति होवाच । अन्धो ऽभविष्यो यन् मां नागमिष्य इति ॥
units.english: But this is only the Eye of the Self’He said‘You would have become blind if you had not come to me’

units.sanskrit: किञ्च त्वामनु प्रवृत्तो ऽश्वतरीभ्यां युक्तो रथो ऽश्वतरीरथो दासीनिष्को दासीभिर्युक्तो निष्को हारो दासीनिष्कः ।
units.english: Further,‘Ready for you is the chariot with mules,ie the chariot with mules yoked to it,also slavegirls along with jewelsie necklace;you eat food etc, etc,’as before

units.sanskrit: चक्षुर्वैश्वानरस्य तु सविता । तस्य समस्तबुद्ध्योपासनादन्धो ऽभविष्यश्चक्षुर्हीनो ऽभवि ष्यो यन्मां ना'गमिष्य इति पूर्ववत् ॥
units.english: But the Sun is only the eye of Vaiśvānara and since you meditate upon this as the whole Vaiśvānara, you would have become blinddeprived of your eyes, if you had not come to me’,as before

units.sanskrit: इति च्छान्दोग्योपनिषदि पञ्चमाध्यायस्य त्रयोदशः खण्डः
units.english: End of Section of Discourse

units.sanskrit: अथ होवाचेन्द्रद्युम्नं भाल्लवेयम् । वैयाघ्रपद्य कं त्वम् आत्मानम् उपास्स इति । वायुम् एव भगवो राजन्न् इति होवाच ।
units.english: Then he said to IndradyumnaBhāllaveya ‘O, Descendant of Vyāghrapada, what is that Self on which you meditate?’‘The Air, O, Revered King,’he said

units.sanskrit: एष वै पृथग्वर्त्मात्मा वैश्वानरो यं त्वम् आत्मानम् उपास्से । तस्मात् त्वां पृथग् बलय आयन्ति पृथग् रथश्रेणयो ऽनुयन्ति ॥
units.english: ‘This that you meditate upon as Self is that VaiśvānaraSelf which is ‘diversecoursed Hence, there come to you diverse offerings and rows of chariots follow you in diverse ways’

units.sanskrit: अथ होवाचेन्द्रद्युम्नं भाल्लवेयं वैयाघ्रपद्य कं त्वमात्मानमुपाःस इत्यादि समानम् ।
units.english: He said to IndradyumnaBhāllaveya‘O, Descendant of Vyāghrapāda, what is that Self on which you meditate?’ etc as before

units.sanskrit: पृथग्वर्त्मा नाना वर्त्मानि यस्य वायोरावहोद्वहादिभिर्भेदैर्वर्तमानस्य सो ऽयं पृथग्वर्त्मा वायुः ।
units.english: Diversecoursed,the Air has various courses; existing as it does in various forms, such as the Āvaha, Udvaha and the like;

units.sanskrit: तस्मात्पृथग्वर्त्मात्मनो वैश्वानरस्योपासनात्पृथङ्नानादिक्कास्त्वां बलयो वस्रान्नादिलक्षणा बलय आयन्त्यागच्छन्ति । पृथग्रथश्रेणयो रथपङ्क्तयो ऽपि त्वामनुयन्ति ॥
units.english: hence, on account of your meditating upon the ‘diversecoursed’ Vaiśvānara, there come to you offeringsof cloth, food and other thingsfrom various directions,and rows of chariots also follow you in diverse ways’

units.sanskrit: अत्स्य् अन्नं पश्यसि प्रियम् ।
units.english: ‘You eat food and see what is dear

units.sanskrit: अत्त्य् अन्नं पश्यति प्रियं भवत्य् अस्य ब्रह्मवर्चसं कुले य एतम् एवम् आत्मानं वैश्वानरम् उपास्ते ।
units.english: One who thus meditates upon this VaiśvānaraSelf eats food and sees what is dear and there is Brahmic glory in his family

units.sanskrit: प्राणस् त्व् एष आत्मन इति होवाच । प्राणस् त उदक्रमिष्यद् यन् मां नागमिष्य इति ॥
units.english: But this is only the Lifebreath of the Self;he saidand your Lifebreath would have gone out if you had not come to me’

units.sanskrit: अत्स्यन्नमित्यादि समानम् ।
units.english: ‘You eat food etc, etc,’as before

units.sanskrit: प्रणस्त्वेष आत्मन इति होवाच प्राणस्ते तवोदक्रमिष्यदुत्क्रान्तो ऽभविष्यद्यन्मां ना'गमिष्य इति ॥
units.english: This however is only the Lifebreath of the Self he said‘Your Lifebreath would have gone outdeparted,if you had not come to me’

units.sanskrit: इति च्छान्दोग्योपनिषदि पञ्चमाध्यायस्य चतुर्दशः खण्डः
units.english: End of Section of Discourse

units.sanskrit: अथ होवाच जनं शार्कराक्ष्यम् । शार्कराक्ष्य कं त्वम् आत्मानम् उपास्स इति ।
units.english: Then he said to JanaO, Śārkarākṣya, what is that Self on which you meditate?’‘The Ākāśa, O Revered Sir,’he said

units.sanskrit: एष वै बहुल आत्मा वैश्वानरो यं त्वम् आत्मानम् उपस्से ।
units.english: ‘This that you meditate upon as Self is that VaiśvānaraSelf which is ‘Extensive’

units.sanskrit: तस्मात् त्वं बहुलो ऽसि प्रजया च धनेन च ॥
units.english: Hence, you are extensive in offspring and wealth’

units.sanskrit: अथ होवाच जनमित्यादि समानम् । एष वै बहुल आत्मा वैश्वानरः ।
units.english: He said to Jana etc, etc,as before This VaiśvānaraSelf is extensive

units.sanskrit: बहुलत्वमाकाशस्य सर्वगतत्वात् ।
units.english: The Ākāśa is ‘Extensive’, because it is allpervading

units.sanskrit: बहुलगुणोपासनाच्च त्वं बहुलो ऽसि प्रजया च पुत्रपौत्रादिलक्षणया धनेन च हिरण्यादिना ॥
units.english: And because you meditate upon it as endowed with the quality of ‘extensiveness’, therefore you are extensive in offspringin the shape of sons, grandsons and the rest,and wealth

units.sanskrit: अत्स्य् अन्नं पश्यसि प्रियम् ।
units.english: ‘You eat food and see what is dear

units.sanskrit: अत्त्य् अन्नं पश्यति प्रियं भवत्य् अस्य ब्रह्मवर्चसं कुले य एतम् एवम् आत्मानं वैश्वानरम् उपास्ते ।
units.english: One who thus meditates upon this VaiśvānaraSelf eats food and sees what is dear; and there is Brahmic glory in his family But this is only the trunk of the VaiśvānaraSelf;

units.sanskrit: संदेहस् ते व्यशीर्यद् यन् मां नागमिष्य इति ॥
units.english: and your trunk would have been shattered if you had not come to me’

units.sanskrit: सन्देहस्त्वेष सन्देहो मध्यमं शरीरं वैश्वानरस्य । दिहेरुपचयार्थत्वान्मांसरुधिरास्थ्यादिभिश्च बहुलं शरीरं तत्सन्देहस्ते तव शरीरं व्यशीर्यच्छीर्णमभविष्यद्यन्मां ना'गमिष्य इति ॥
units.english: But this is only the Trunk,ie, the middle position of the body of Vaiśvānara;the term ‘sandeha’ being derived from the root ‘dihi’ signifying conglomeration, and the body being a conglomeration of flesh, blood, bones etc,it is called ‘Sandeha’ Your trunk would have been shatteredtorn asunder, if you had not come to me’

units.sanskrit: इति च्छान्दोग्योपनिषदि पञ्चमाध्यायस्य पञ्चदशः खण्डः
units.english: End of Section of Discourse

units.sanskrit: अथ होवाच बुडिलम् आश्वतराश्विम् । वैयाघ्रपद्य कं त्वम् आत्मानम् उपास्स इति ।
units.english: Then he said to BuḍilaĀśvatarāśvi‘ O, descendant of Vyāghrapāda, what is that Self on which you meditate?’‘Water, O Revered King’he said

units.sanskrit: एष वै रयिर् आत्मा वैश्वानरो यं त्वम् आत्मानम् उपास्से ।
units.english: ‘This that you meditate upon as Self is that VaiśvānaraSelf which is ‘Wealth’;

units.sanskrit: तस्मात् त्वं रयिमान् पुष्टिमान् असि ॥
units.english: hence you are possessed of wealth and bodily strength’

units.sanskrit: अथ होवाच बुडिलमाश्वतराश्विमित्यादि समानम् ।
units.english: He said to BuḍilaĀśvatarāśvi etc, etc,as before

units.sanskrit: एष वै रयिरात्मा वैश्वानरो धनरूपः ।
units.english: This VaiśvānaraSelf is ‘Wealth’,in the form of wealth;

units.sanskrit: अद्भ्यो ऽन्नं ततो धनमिति ।
units.english: as from water, proceeds food, and from food, wealth

units.sanskrit: तस्माद्रयिमान्धनवांस्त्वं पुष्टिमांश्च शरीरेण; पुष्टेश्चान्ननिमित्तत्वात् ॥
units.english: Hence you are possessed of wealth wealthyand of bodily strength,the strength of the body being dependent upon food

units.sanskrit: अत्स्य् अन्नं पश्यसि प्रियम् ।
units.english: ‘You eat food and see what is dear

units.sanskrit: अत्त्य् अन्नं पश्यति प्रियं भवत्य् अस्य ब्रह्मवर्चसं कुले य एतम् एवम् आत्मानं वैश्वानरम् उपास्ते ।
units.english: One, who thus meditates upon this VaiśvānaraSelf eats food and sees what is dear; and there is Brahmic glory in his family

units.sanskrit: बस्तिस् त्व् एष आत्मन इति होवाच । बस्तिस् ते व्यभेत्स्यद् यन् मां नागमिष्य इति ॥
units.english: But this is only the bladder of the Self and your bladder would have burst if you had not come to me’

units.sanskrit: बस्तिस्त्वेष आत्मनो वैश्वानरस्य बस्तिर्मूत्रसंग्रहस्थानं बस्तिर्मूत्रसंग्रहस्थानं बस्तिस्ते व्यभेत्स्यद्भिन्नो ऽभविष्यद्यन्मां
units.english: But this is the Bladder of the VaiśvānaraSelf;‘Bladder’ being the place where urine becomes collected,your bladder would have burstbecome tornif you had not come to me’

units.sanskrit: अथ होवाचोद्दालकम् आरुणिम् ।
units.english: End of Section of Discourse

units.sanskrit: गौतम कं त्वम् आत्मानम् उपस्स इति । पृथिवीम् एव भगवो राजन्न् इति होवाच ।
units.english: He said to UddālakaĀruṇiO, Gautama! What is that Self on which you meditate? ‘The Earth, O Revered King’, he said

units.sanskrit: एष वै प्रतिष्ठात्मा वैश्वानरो यं त्वम् आत्मानम् उपास्से ।
units.english: ‘This that you meditate upon as Self is that VaiśvānaraSelf which is firmness;

units.sanskrit: तस्मात् त्वं प्रतिष्ठितो ऽसि प्रजया च पशुभिश् च ॥
units.english: hence, you are firmas regards offspring and cattle’

units.sanskrit: अत्स्य् अन्नं पश्यसि प्रियम् ।
units.english: ‘You eat food and see what is dear

units.sanskrit: अत्त्य् अन्नं पश्यति प्रियं भवत्य् अस्य ब्रह्मवर्चसं कुले य एतम् एवम् आत्मानं वैश्वानरम् उपास्ते ।
units.english: One who thus meditates upon this VaiśvānaraSelf eats food and sees what is dear, and there is Brahmic glory in his famliy

units.sanskrit: पादौ त्व् एताव् आत्मन इति होवाच ।
units.english: But this is only the feet of the That Self;

units.sanskrit: पादौ ते व्यम्लास्येतां यन् मां नागमिष्य इति ॥
units.english: and your feet would have faded if you had not come to me

units.sanskrit: अथ होवाचोद्दालकमित्यादि समानम् ।
units.english: Then he said to Uddālaka etc, etc as before

units.sanskrit: पृथिवीमेव भगवो राजन्निति होवाच ।
units.english: ‘The Earthy O Revered King’he said

units.sanskrit: एष वै प्रतिष्ठा पादौ वैश्वानरस्य । पादौ ते व्यम्लास्येतां विम्लानावभविष्यतां श्लथीभूतौ यन्मां ना'गमिष्य इति ॥
units.english: ‘This firmness is the feet of Vaiśvānara’, and your feet would be faded, benumbed, paralysed,if you had not come to me’

units.sanskrit: इति च्छान्दोग्योपनिषदि पञ्चमाध्यायस्य सप्तदशः खण्डः
units.english: End of Section of Discourse

units.sanskrit: तान् होवाच । एते वै खलु यूयं पृथग् इवेमम् आत्मानं वैश्वानरं विद्वांसो ऽन्नम् अत्थ ।
units.english: He said to them‘All of you, knowing the VaiśvānaraSelf differently as it were, eat food

units.sanskrit: यस् त्व् एतम् एवं प्रादेशमात्रम् अभिविमानम् आत्मानं वैश्वानरम् उपास्ते । स सर्वेषु लोकेषु सर्वेषु भूतेषु सर्वेष्व् आत्मस्व् अन्नम् अत्ति ॥
units.english: But one who meditates upon this VaiśvānaraSelf as a whole, composed of parts and selfconscious, eats food in all regions, in all beings and in all Selves’

units.sanskrit: तान्यथोक्तवैश्वानरदर्शनवतो होवाच । एते यूयं वै खल्वित्यनर्थकौ ।
units.english: Thereupon he said to all those who had held the abovementioned views regarding Vaiśvānara All of you;the particles ‘vai’ and ‘khalu’ are meaningless;know this VaiśvānaraSelf,who is one and not diverse,differently as it were;

units.sanskrit: यूयं पृथगिवापृथक्सन्तमिममेकं वैश्वानरमात्मानं विद्वांसो ऽन्नमत्थ परिच्छिन्नात्मबुद्ध्येत्येतद्धस्तिदर्शन इव जात्यन्धाः ।
units.english: and you thus regard the Self as a limited entity, in the same way as a number of persons born blind perceiving the elephant through touching its different parts, come to have diverse notions regarding it each one regarding it to be like the part that he had touched;

units.sanskrit: यस्त्वेतमेवं यथोक्तावयवैर्द्युमूर्धादिभिः पृथिवीपादान्तैर्विशिष्टमेकं प्रादेशमात्रं प्रादेशैर्द्युमूर्धादिभिः पृथिवीपादान्तैरध्यात्मं
units.english: One who meditates upon this VaiśvānaraSelf as a whole composed of parts, such parts as the Heaven as His head, down to the Earth as His feet

units.sanskrit: मुखादिषु वा करणेष्वत्तृत्वेन मीयत इति प्रादेशमात्रः । द्युलोकादिपृथिव्यन्तप्रदेशपरिमाणो वा प्रादेशमात्रः । प्रकर्षेण शास्रेणा'दिश्यन्त इति प्रादेशा द्युलोकादय एतावत्परिमाणः । शाखान्तरे तु मूर्धादिः चिबुकप्रतिष्ठ इति प्रादेशमात्रं कल्पयन्ति ।
units.english: He is prādeśamātra which means that a he is one who is known, in the physical form through his compound parts, such as the Heaven as his head, ending with the Earth as his feet;or b it may mean that he is inferred as the ‘Eater’, in regard to the organs;or c that he extends from the Heaven down to the Earth;or d ‘Prādeśa’ may be taken as standing for the Heavenly and other regions, in the sense that they are flatteringly described in the scriptures and the Vaiśvānara is of the same size as all these;e in another Vedic text, this Self has been described as ‘prādeśamātra’, in its literal sense,namely, of the same size as the distance between the Head and the Chin;

units.sanskrit: इह तु न तथाभिप्रेतः ।
units.english: but this is not the sense intended here;

units.sanskrit: प्रत्यगात्मतयाभिविमीयते ऽहमिति ज्ञायत इत्यभिविमानस्तमेतमात्मानं वैश्वानरं
units.english: as is clear from the summing up contained in the next text He is also ‘Selfconscious’,ie he is cognised as the Individualised Self in the notion of ‘’

units.sanskrit: विश्वान्नरान्नयति पुण्यपापानुरूपां गतिं सर्वात्मैष ईश्वरो वैश्वानरो विश्वो नर एव वा सर्वात्मत्वात् । विश्वैर्वा नरैः प्रत्यगात्मतया प्रविभज्य नीयत इति वैश्वानरस्तमेवमुपास्ते यः सो ऽदन्नन्नादी सर्वेषु लोकेषु द्युलोकादिषु सर्वेषु भूतेषु चराचरेषु सर्वेष्वात्मसु शरीरेन्द्रियमनोबुद्धिषु तेषु ह्यात्मकल्पनाव्यपदेशः प्राणिनामन्नमत्ति वैश्वानरवित्सर्वात्मा सन्नन्नमत्ति ।
units.english: This is Vaiśvānara,in the sense of ‘Viśvān narān nayati’, carries all men, to their states in accordance with their merit and demerit;He, the Allself, the God or He may be called ‘Vaiśvānara’ in the sense of being ‘AllMan’, being the Self of all,or he may be ‘Vaiśvānara’ in the sense that ‘He is treated by all men as the Individualised Self One who meditates upon this VaiśvānaraSelf eats food in all regionsHeaven and the rest,in all beingsanimate and inanimate, and in all Selves,Body, Organs, Mind and Intellect,all these being sometimes spoken of as ‘Self’

units.sanskrit: न यथाज्ञः पिण्डमात्राभिमानः सन्नित्यर्थः ॥
units.english: he is not like the ignorant man who knows only the physical body with which he identifies himself
