units.sanskrit: इति च्छान्दोग्योपनिषदि अष्टमाध्यायस्य तृतीयः खण्डः
units.english: End of Section of Discourse

units.sanskrit: अथ य आत्मा स सेतुर् धृतिर् एषां लोकानाम् असंभेदाय ।
units.english: Now, this Self is the dam, the embankment for the safety of those Regions

units.sanskrit: नैतं सेतुम् अहोरात्रे तरतो न जरा न मृत्युर् न शोको न सुकृतम् ।
units.english: This dam, Day and Night, do not cross, nor decrepitude, nor death, nor sorrow, nor merit, nor demerit;

units.sanskrit: सर्वे पाप्मानो ऽतो निवर्तन्ते ।
units.english: all evils turn away from it;

units.sanskrit: अपहतपाप्मा ह्य् एष ब्रह्मलोकः ॥
units.english: as this Brahmanregion is free from evil

units.sanskrit: अथ य आत्मेति ।
units.english: Now, this Self etc, etc

units.sanskrit: उक्तलक्षणो यः संप्रसादस्तस्य स्वरूपं वक्ष्यमाणैरुक्तैश्च गुणैः पुनः स्तूयते ब्रह्मचर्यसाधनसंबन्धार्थम् ।
units.english: The ‘Serene and happy Being’ described above is again being eulogised, through its form as being endowed with many qualities, told as well as untold,for the purpose of thinking it up with the accomplishment of celibacy

units.sanskrit: य एष यथोक्तलक्षण आत्मा स सेतुरिव सेतुः ।
units.english: This Selfas described above,is the dam, like a dam,the embankment,the bulwark;

units.sanskrit: अनेन हि सर्वं जगद्वर्णाश्रमादिक्रियाकारकफलादिभेदनियमैः कर्तुरनुरूपं विदधता विधृतम् ।
units.english: the entire universe is held up by this Self which makes it compatible with the character of the acting agent, by rules relating to the divisions into Castes, Lifestages, Action, Actor and results of action

units.sanskrit: अध्रियमाणं हीश्वरेणेदं विश्वं विनश्येद्यतस्तस्मात्स सेतुर्विधृतिः ।
units.english: If it were not so held up by God, the universe would be destroyed; hence, He is the ‘dam the ‘Embankment’

units.sanskrit: किमर्थं स सेतुरित्याहएषां भूरादीनां कर्तृकर्मलाश्रयाणामसंभेदायाविदारणायाविनाशायेत्येतत् ।
units.english: For what purpose is He the ‘dam’?For the safety of these Regions;for the safety, the nondisintegration, the nondestruction of the Regions of Bhūḥ, Bhavaḥ and the rest, which are the locus of Actors, Actions, and Results

units.sanskrit: किंविश्ष्टश्चासौ सेतुरित्याहनैतम् सेतुमात्मानमहोरात्रे सर्वस्य जनिमतः परिच्छेदके सती नैतं तरतः । यथान्ये संसारिणः कालेनाहोरात्रादिलक्षणेन परिच्छेद्या न तथायं कालपरिच्छेद्य इत्यभिप्रायः ।
units.english: What are the qualities of this Dam?This Dam, the SelfDay and Night,the determinant of all that is born,do not cross; other selves entrusted in the cycle of Birth and Death are always determined, circumscribed by time in the shape of Day and Night; this Self, in question however, is not so circumscribed by Time; such is the meaning

units.sanskrit: यस्मादर्वाक्संवत्सरो ऽहोभिः परिवर्ततैति श्रुत्यन्तरात् ।
units.english: This follows from such Śrutitexts as‘Because the year revolves below through days’ Bṛhada

units.sanskrit: अत एवैनं न जरा तरति न प्राप्नोति । तथा न मृत्युर्न शोको न सुकृतं न दृष्कृतं सुकृतदुष्कृते धर्माधर्मै ।
units.english: ;for this same reason, decrepititude crosses it not,it does not approach it;similarly, death does not cross it; nor sorrow, nor merit, nor demerit;the terms ‘Sukṛta’ and ‘Duṣkṛta’ stand for Merit and Demerit

units.sanskrit: प्राप्तिरत्र तरणशब्देनाभिप्रेता नातिक्रमणम् ।
units.english: What is meant by crossing here is approaching, affecting,not the acṭual going over from one side to the other;

units.sanskrit: कारणं ह्यात्मा । न शक्यं हि कारणातिक्रमणं कर्तुं कार्येण ।
units.english: because the Self is the cause of all things and no effect product can ever cross over go beyond its cause

units.sanskrit: अहोरात्रादि च सर्वं सतः कार्यम् ।
units.english: Day and Night and the other things are all the products of Being;

units.sanskrit: अन्येन ह्यन्यस्य प्राप्तिरतिक्रमणं वा क्रियेत । न तु तेनैव तस्य ।
units.english: where there is approach or crossing, it is always of one thing by another thing, not by itself;

units.sanskrit: न हि घटेन मृत्प्राप्यते ऽतिक्रम्यते वा ।
units.english: the Clay, for instance, is never approached or crossed over by the jar

units.sanskrit: यद्यपि पूर्वं य आत्मापहतपाप्मेत्यादिना पाप्मादिप्रतिषेध उक्त एव तथापीहायं विशेषो न तरतीति प्राप्तिविषयत्वं प्रतिषिध्यते ।
units.english: Though on a precious occasion the Self has been already described as ‘free from Evil etc’by the denial of evil and other things,yet in the present context, an additional trait is pointed out by the phrase ‘crosses not which denies the possibility of the Self being an object of approach;

units.sanskrit: तत्रा विशेषेण जराद्यभावमात्रमुक्तम् ।
units.english: and along with these, the similar negation of decrepitude and other things also has been reiterated

units.sanskrit: अहोरात्राद्या उक्ता अनुक्ताश्चान्ये सर्वे पाप्मान उच्यन्ते ऽतो ऽस्मादात्मनः सेतोर्निवर्तन्ते ऽप्राप्यैवेत्यर्थः । अपहतपाप्मा ह्येष ब्रह्मैव लोको ब्रह्मलोक उक्तः ॥
units.english: Day and Night are directly mentioned, and all the other ‘evils’ are not mentioned specifically, they are mentioned by the single common word ‘Evils All evils turn away from this Dam, the Self, without approaching it;as this BrahmanRegionthe Region, Brahmanhas been declared to be free from evil

units.sanskrit: तस्माद् वा एतं सेतुं तीर्त्वा अन्धः सन्न् अनन्धो भवति । विद्धः सन्न् अविद्धो भवति ।
units.english: Therefore, having reached this Dam, the blind ceases to be blind, the hurt ceases to be hurt, the afflicted ceases to be afflicted

units.sanskrit: तस्माद् वा एतं सेतुं तीर्त्वा अपि नक्तम् अहर् एवाभिनिष्पद्यते । सकृद् विभातो ह्य् एवैष ब्रह्मलोकः ॥
units.english: Therefore, having reached this Dam, even Night becomes Day as this BrahmanRegion is lighted once for all

units.sanskrit: यस्माच्च पाप्मकार्य मान्ध्यादि शरीरवतः स्यान्न त्वशरीरस्य तस्माद्वा एतमात्मानं सेतुं तीर्वा प्राप्यानन्धो भवति देहवत्त्वे पूर्वमन्धो ऽपि सन् । तता विद्धः सन्देहवत्त्वे स देहवियोगे सेतुं तीर्त्वा प्राप्यानन्धो भवति देहवत्त्वे पूर्वमन्धो ऽपि सन् । तथा विद्धः सन्देहवत्त्वे स देहवियोगो सेतुं प्राप्याविद्धो भवति । तथोपतापी रोगाद्युपतापवान्सन्ननुपतापी भवति ।
units.english: Because blindness and other disabilities, which are the effects of sin, come only to one with a body, and never to one who has no body,therefore, having reached this Dam,having got at it,one ceases to be blind,even though when he had the body, he was blind; similarly one who was hurt while he was in the body,ceases to be hurt,when, on being separated from the body, he has reached the Damsimilarly one who was afflicted suffering from disease and other afflictions,ceases to be afflicted

units.sanskrit: किञ्च यस्मादहोरात्रे न स्तः सेतौ तस्माद्वा एतं सेतुं तीर्त्वा प्राप्य नक्तमपि तमोरूपं रात्रिरपि सर्वमहरेवाभिनिष्पद्यते ।
units.english: Further, because there is no Night and Day at the Dam, therefore, on reaching the dam, even night,in the form of darknessbecomes day;

units.sanskrit: विज्ञप्त्यात्मज्योतिः स्वरूपमहरिवाहः सदैकरूपं विदुषः संपद्यत इत्यर्थः । सकृद्विभातः सदा विभातः सदैकरूपः स्वेन रूपेणैष ब्रह्मलोकः ॥
units.english: that is to say, for the knowing man, everything becomes day,which is of the form of the light of consciousness, and is like the day, comes to be one uniform formthat of Being,The BrahmanRegion is lighted once for all,ie it is ever effulgent and always of the same form of Being,

units.sanskrit: तद् य एवैतं ब्रह्मलोकं ब्रह्मचर्येणानुविन्दन्ति तेषाम् एवैष ब्रह्मलोकः ।
units.english: Those who attain this BrahmanRegion through Celibacy,to them belongs this BrahmanRegion;

units.sanskrit: तेषां सर्वेषु लोकेषु कामचारो भवति ॥
units.english: and for them there is freedom to act as they please in all regions

units.sanskrit: तत्तत्रैवं सत्येतं यथोक्तं ब्रह्मलोकं ब्रह्मचर्येण स्रीविषयतृष्णात्यागेन शास्राचार्योपदेशमनुविन्दन्ति स्वात्मसंवेद्यतामापादयन्ति ये तेषामेव ब्रह्मचर्यसाधनवतां ब्रह्मविदामेष ब्रह्मलोकः नान्येषां स्रीविषयसंपर्कजाततृष्णानां ब्रह्मविदामपीत्यर्थः । तेषां सर्वेषु लोकेषु कामचारो भवतीत्युक्तार्थम् ।
units.english: Such being the case, those who attain this BrahmanRegion through Celibacy,through renouncing all desires for women, and after having learnt the scriptures and received instructions from Teachers,attain itie realise it within their own self,to themwho are equipped with the weapon of celibacy, and have come to know Brahman,belongs this BrahmanRegion,not to the others, who still entertain longings for the contact of women and other objects of sense,even though they may have come to know Brahman;for them there is freedom to act as they please, in all regions,as already explained above

units.sanskrit: तस्मात्परममेतत्साधनं ब्रह्मचर्यं ब्रह्मविदामित्यभिप्रायः ॥
units.english: Thus what is meant is that celibacy is the highest means of success for knowers of Brahman,

units.sanskrit: इति च्छान्दोग्योपनिषदि अष्टमाध्यायस्य चतुर्थः खण्डः अथ यद् यज्ञ इत्य् आचक्षते ब्रह्मचर्यम् एव तत् ।
units.english: and the text also eulogises it through Sacrifice and other things, in order toshow that it is well worth carrying into practice Now, that which they call ‘Sacrifice’ is only Celibacy;

units.sanskrit: ब्रह्मचर्येण ह्य् एव यो ज्ञाता तं विन्दते ।
units.english: as it is only by means of Celibacy that the knower attains that

units.sanskrit: अथ यद् इष्टम् इत्य् आचक्षते ब्रह्मचर्यम् एव तत् ।
units.english: And that which they call ‘Worship’ is only Celibacy;

units.sanskrit: ब्रह्मचर्येण ह्य् एवेष्ट्वात्मानम् अनुविन्दते ॥
units.english: as it is by means of Celibacy that, having worshipped, one attains the Self

units.sanskrit: यज्ञादिभिश्च तत्स्तौति कर्तव्यार्थम् अथ यद्यज्ञ इत्याचक्षते लोके परमपुरुषार्थसाधनं कथयन्ति शिष्टास्तद्ब्रह्मचर्यमेव ।
units.english: Now that which, in the ordinary world, they call ‘Sacrifice’,which cultured people declare to be the means of accomplishing the highest purpose of man, is only Celibacy;

units.sanskrit: यज्ञस्यापि यत्फलं तद्ब्रह्मचर्यवाल्लंभते ऽतो यज्ञो ऽपि ब्रह्मचर्यं भवति प्रतिपत्तव्यम् ।
units.english: the result that follows from the sacrifice is secured only by one who is equipped with Celibacy, and in this sense the sacrifice also should be understood to be Celibacy,

units.sanskrit: कथं ब्रह्मचर्यं यज्ञ इत्याहब्रह्मचर्येणैव हि यस्माद्यो ज्ञातास तं ब्रह्मलोकं यज्ञस्यापि पारम्पर्येण फलभूतं विन्दते लभते ततो
units.english: QuestionIn what way is sacrifice Celibacy? AnswerAs it is only by means of Celibacy that the knower attainssecuresthatthe BrahmanRegion,which is also the indirect result of sacrifice;

units.sanskrit: यज्ञो ऽपि ब्रह्मचर्यमेवेति । यो ज्ञातेत्यक्षरानुवृत्तेर्यज्ञो ब्रह्मचर्यमेव । अथ यदिष्टमित्याचक्षते ब्रह्मचर्यमेव तत् ।
units.english: Further, Sacrifice yajña is only Celibacy, because of the presence of the letters ya’ and ‘jña’ in the expressions ‘yajñātā’ knower as also in the term ‘yajña’ That which they call ‘worship’that also is only celibacy

units.sanskrit: कथम् । ब्रह्मचर्येणैव साधनेन तमीश्वरमिष्ट्वा पूजयित्वाथवैषणामात्मविषयां कृत्वा तमात्मानमनुविन्दते ।
units.english: How?It is by means of celibacy that one Worships God or iṣṭvā,or evinces an eager desire for knowing the Self which is also meant by ‘iṣṭvā’,and attains the Self;

units.sanskrit: एषणादिष्टमपि ब्रह्मचर्यमेव ॥
units.english: so that because of the presence of the root ‘iṣ’ in both ‘eṣaṇā’ worship or Desire and ‘iṣṭa’ worship, the worship also is only Celibacy

units.sanskrit: अथ यत् सत्त्रायणम् इत्य् आचक्षते ब्रह्मचर्यम् एव तत् ।
units.english: Now, what they call Sattrāyaṇa Sacrificial Session, that is only Celibacy;

units.sanskrit: ब्रह्मचर्येण ह्य् एव सत आत्मनस् त्राणं विन्दते ।
units.english: as it is by means of celibacy that one attains Salvation ‘trāṇa’ from Being ‘sat’

units.sanskrit: अथ यन् मौनम् इत्य् आचक्षते ब्रह्मचर्यम् एव तत् । ब्रह्मचर्येण ह्य् एवात्मानम् अनुविद्य मनुते ॥
units.english: Now, that which they call ‘Mauna’, Silent meditationthat is only Celibacy, as it is by means of Celibacy that one understands the Self and then Meditates ‘manute’

units.sanskrit: अथ यत्सत्त्रायणमित्याचक्षते ब्रह्मचर्यमेव तत्तथा सतः परस्मादात्मन आत्मनस्राणं रक्षणं ब्रह्मचर्यसाधनेन विन्दते
units.english: Now, that which they call ‘Sattrāyaṇa’ Sacrificial Session that is only celibacy; as it is by means of celibacy that one securesfrom the Supreme Self,his salvationprotection

units.sanskrit: अतः सत्त्रायणशब्दमपि ब्रह्मचर्यमेव सत् ।
units.english: Hence the name ‘Sattrāyaṇa’ also is only celibacy

units.sanskrit: अथ यन्मौनमित्याचक्षते ब्रह्मचर्यमेव तद्ब्रह्मचर्येणैव साधनेन युक्तः सन्नात्मानं शास्राचार्याभ्यामनुविद्य पश्चान्मनुते ध्यायति ।
units.english: Now, what they call ‘Mauna’ Silent meditation, that is only celibacy;as it is by means of celibacy,when one is equipped with celibacythat one understands the Self,through the scriptures and the teacher,and then meditatescontemplates manute;

units.sanskrit: अतो मौनशब्दमपि ब्रह्मचर्यमेव ॥
units.english: hence, the name ‘Mauna’ also is only celibacy

units.sanskrit: अथ यद् अनाशकायनम् इत्य् आचक्षते ब्रह्मचर्यम् एव तत् ।
units.english: Now, what they call ‘Anāśakāyana’Indestructible, that is celibacy;

units.sanskrit: एष ह्य् आत्मा न नश्यति यं ब्रह्मचर्येणानुविन्दते ।
units.english: as his Self never perishes which one attains by means of celibacy

units.sanskrit: अथ यद् अरण्यायनम् इत्य् आचक्षते ब्रह्मचर्यम् एव तत् ।
units.english: Now, that which they call ‘Araṇyāyana’ Ocean path, that is celibacy;

units.sanskrit: तत् अरश् च ह वै ण्यश् चार्णवौ ब्रह्मलोके तृतीयस्याम् इतो दिवि ।
units.english: as ‘Ara’ and ‘Ṇya’ are two oceans in the BrahmanRegion in the third Heaven from this;

units.sanskrit: तद् ऐरंमदीयं सरः । तद् अश्वत्थः सोमसवनः । तद् अपराजिता पूर् ब्रह्मणः प्रभुविमितं हिरण्मयम् ॥
units.english: and therein is the Airammadīya Lake, and there the Banyantree, Somasavana, there the Aparājitā unconquered city of Brahman, as also the Golden Hall, specially built by the Lord

units.sanskrit: अथ यदनाशकायनमित्याचक्षते ब्रह्मचर्यमेव तत् ।
units.english: Now, what they call ‘Anāśakāyana’ Indestructible, that is Celibacy;

units.sanskrit: यमात्मानं ब्रह्मचर्येणानुविन्दते स एष ह्यात्मा ब्रह्मचर्यसाधनवतो न नश्यति तस्मादनाशकायनमपि ब्रह्मचर्यमेव ।
units.english: the Self that one attains by means of Celibacy, that never perishes for the man who is equipped with Celibacy; hence, the Anāśakāyana also is only celibacy

units.sanskrit: अथ यदरण्यायनमित्याचक्षते ब्रह्मचर्यमेव तत् । अरण्यशब्दयोरर्णवयोर्ब्रह्मचर्यवतो ऽयनादरण्यायनं ब्रह्मचर्यम् ।
units.english: Now, that which they call ‘Araṇyāyana’ Oceanpath, that is only celibacy; inasmuch as the two oceans named ‘Ara’ and ‘Ṇya’ are the ‘path’ ayana of the man equipped with celibacy,the Araṇyāyana is celibacy

units.sanskrit: यो ज्ञानाद्यज्ञ एषणादिष्टं सतस्राणात्सत्त्रायणं मननान्मौनमनशनादनाशकायनमरण्ययोर्गमनादरण्यायनमित्यादिभिर्महद्भिः पुरुषार्थसाधनैः स्तुतत्वाद्ब्रह्मचर्यं परमं ज्ञानस्य सहकारिकारणं साधनमित्यतो ब्रह्मविदा यत्नतो रक्षणीयमित्यर्थः ।
units.english: The sense of all this is that the man who knows Brahman should carefully guard his celibacy, which is the highest auxiliary of knowledge, which has been eulogised as being identical with some of the best means of accomplishing man’s purpose in life,eg being knowledge, it is Sacrifice,being worshipped, it is worship,being the salvation from Being, it is Sattrāyaṇa,being meditation, it is Mauna,being imperishable, it is Anāśakāyana, passing through the two oceans ‘Ara’ and ‘Ṇya’, it is Araṇyāyana, and so forth

units.sanskrit: तत्तत्र हि ब्रह्मलोके ऽरश्च ह वै प्रसिद्धो ण्यश्चार्णवौ समुद्रोपमे वा सरसी तृतीयस्यां भुवमन्तरिक्षं चापेक्ष्य तृतीया द्यौस्तस्यां तृतीयस्यामितो ऽस्माल्लोकादारभ्य गण्यमानायां दिवि । तत्तत्रैव चैरमिरान्नं तन्मय ऐरो मण्डस्तेन पूर्णमैरं मदीयं तदुपयोगिनां मदकरं हर्षोत्पादकं सरः । तत्रैव चाश्वत्थो वृक्षः सोमसवनो नामतः सोमो ऽमृतं तन्निःस्रवो ऽमृतस्रव इति वा ।
units.english: In that BrahmanRegion, there are the wellknown oceans, ‘Ara’ and ‘Ṇya’,two lakes like oceans,in the third Heaven from thisie the third, from the Earth and Sky which are first and secondin that third Heaven ie counting from this World, Earth;there also lies the Airammadīya Lake;‘Aira’ is gruel, the lake Aira is filled with gruel, and it is also ‘Madīya, Exhilarating, rendering joyful, who make use of that gruel;there also lies the Banyan treeSomasavanaby nameor it may be an adjective signifying that wherefrom Soma, nectar, flows; so the tree is nectardropping

units.sanskrit: तत्रैव च ब्रह्मलोके ब्रह्मचर्यसाधनरहितैर्ब्रह्मचर्यसाधनवद्भ्यो ऽन्यैर्न जीयत इत्यपराजिता नाम पूः पुरी ब्रह्मणो हिरण्यगर्भस्य
units.english: In that same BrahmanRegion is the Aparājitā unconquered city,that is, that what is not conquered won by persons other than those equipped with Celibacy, who are not so equipped with it such is the City of Brahman, the HiraṇyaGarbha;as also the golden hall specially built by the Lord;

units.sanskrit: ब्रह्मणा च प्रभुणा विशेषेण मितं निर्मितं तच्च हिरण्मयं सौवर्णं प्रभुविमितं मण्डपमिति वाक्यशेषः ॥
units.english: the term ‘Hall’ has to be added to complete the sentence

units.sanskrit: तद् य एवैताव् अरं च ण्यं चार्णवौ ब्रह्मलोके ब्रह्मचर्येणानुविन्दन्ति तेषाम् एवैष ब्रह्मलोकः ।
units.english: Those who attain the two oceans, Ara and Ṇya in the BrahmanRegion,by means of Celibacy,to them, belongs this BrahmanRegion and for them there is freedom of action in all regions

units.sanskrit: तत्तत्र हि ब्रह्मलोक एतावर्णवौ यावरण्याख्यावुक्तौ ब्रह्मचर्येण साधनेनानुविन्दन्ति ये तेषामेवैष यो व्याख्यातो ब्रह्मलोकस्तेषां च ब्रह्मचर्यसाधवनतां
units.english: In the BrahmanRegion, there are two oceans Ara and Ṇya as described above;those who attain these oceans by means of celibacy,to them belongs the BrahmanRegion described above;

units.sanskrit: ब्रह्मविदां सर्वेषु लोकेषु कामचारो भवति ।
units.english: and for those, who arc equipped with Celibacy and who know Brahman, there is freedom of action, in all regions;

units.sanskrit: नान्येषामब्रह्मचर्यपराणां बाह्यविषयासक्तबुद्धीनां कदाचिदपीत्यर्थः ।
units.english: never for any others who are not firm in their celibacy and who have their merits attached to external things

units.sanskrit: नन्वत्र त्वमिन्द्रस्त्वं यमस्त्वं वरुण इत्यादिभिर्यथा कश्चित्स्तूयते महार्ह एवमिष्टादिभिः
units.english: In this connection, some people hold the following viewIn the ordinary world a great man is praised as ‘you arc Indra,you are Yamayou are Varuṇa in the same manner, what deserves to be praised here, by means of the terms ‘Iṣṭa’ ‘Worship;

units.sanskrit: शब्दैर्न स्त्र्यादिविषयतृष्णानिवृत्तिमात्रं स्तुत्यर्हं किं तर्हि ज्ञानस्य मोक्षसाधनत्वात्तदेवेष्टादिभिः स्तूयत इति केचित् । न ।
units.english: and the rest, is not merely the cessation of the longing for woman and other senseobjects, but knowledge which is the Direct means of Liberation; hence, it is this knowledge that should be regarded as praised by means of the terms ‘worship’ and the rest

units.sanskrit: स्त्र्यादिबाह्यविषयतृष्णापहृतचित्तानां प्रत्यगात्मविवेकविज्ञानानुपपत्तेः । पराञ्चि खानि व्यतृणत्स्वयंभूस्तस्मात्पराङ्पश्यति नान्तरात्मनित्यादिश्रुतिस्मृतिशतेभ्यः ।
units.english: For people whose mind is carried away by longings for woman and other external objects, it is not possible to have any discriminative knowledge of the Self and counterSelf; as is clear from hundreds of Vedic and Smṛti Texts, such as‘The Selfborn one pierced the senseopenings outwards, hence one sees what is outside, not the inner Self’ Kaṭha

units.sanskrit: ज्ञानसहकारिकारणं स्त्र्यादिविषयतृष्णानिवृत्तिसाधनं विधातव्यमेवेति युक्तैव तत्स्तुतिः ।
units.english: Then again, it is necessary to lay down accessory aids to Knowledge, in the shape of the cessation of the longing for woman and other things,hence it is only right and proper that there should be praise of this latter

units.sanskrit: ननु च यज्ञादिभिः स्तुतं ब्रह्मचर्यमिति यज्ञादीनां पुरुषार्थसाधनत्वं गम्यते ।
units.english: Inasmuch as Celibacy has been praised as ‘Sacrifice and other things; it carries with it the implication that these latter also are the means of accomplishing the purposes of man

units.sanskrit: सत्यं गम्यते ।
units.english: True, it does carry that implication;

units.sanskrit: न त्विह ब्रह्मलोकं प्रति यज्ञादीनां साधनत्वमभिप्रेत्य यज्ञादिभिर्ब्रह्मचर्यं स्तूयते किं तर्हि तेषां प्रसिद्धं पुरुषार्थसाधनत्वमपेक्ष्य
units.english: but when Celibacy is praised as ‘Sacrifice’ and the rest, it is not in view of the sacrifice and the rest being the means of attaining the BrahmanRegion,but in view of the wellknown idea that they serve to accomplish some purposes of man;

units.sanskrit: यथेन्द्रादिभी राजा न तु यत्रेन्द्रादीनां व्यापारस्तत्रैव राज्ञ इति तद्वत् ।
units.english: just as when the king is praised as ‘Indra’ and other deities, it does not mean that the king performs precisely those functions that are performed by Indra and other deities

units.sanskrit: य इमेर्ऽणवादयो ब्राह्मलौकिकाः संकल्पजाश्च पित्रादयो भोगास्ते किं पार्थिवा आप्याश्च यथेह लोके दृश्यन्ते तद्धदर्णववृक्षपूःस्वर्णमण्डपान्याहोस्विन्मानसप्रत्ययमात्राणीति
units.english: QuestionThese oceans and other things described as existing in the BrahmanRegion,and the experiencing of meeting with one’s ancestors, described as resulting from one’s Will,are these real and exterior like the Earth, and Acquatic things found in the ordinary world, in the form of Ocean, tree, city, and golden hall,or have they mere ideas present only in the mental conception of the man

units.sanskrit: किञ्चातः, यदि पार्थिवा आप्याश्च स्थूलाः स्युर्हृद्याकाशे समाधानानुपपत्तिः ।
units.english: What if it is so? If they are like ordinary Earthly and Acquatic things, existing in the gross physical external world, then they cannot be ‘contained’ in the Ākāśa of the Heart as described above;

units.sanskrit: पुराणे चमनोमयानि ब्रह्मलोके शरीरादीनीति वाक्यं विरुध्येत । अशोकमहिममित्याद्याश्च श्रुतयः ।
units.english: and secondly, such a conception would go against the declaration in the Purāṇas that the Body and other things’, in the BrahmanRegion, are purely mental ideas also against such Vedic texts as ‘It is without grief, without cold’ Bṛhada

units.sanskrit: ननुसमुद्राः सरितः सरांसि वाप्यः कूपा यज्ञा वेदा मन्त्रादयश्च मूर्तिमन्तो ब्रह्माणमुपतिष्ठन्तैति मानसत्वै विरुध्येत पुराणस्मृतिः
units.english: x But if these things existed only in the mind, then this would be incompatible with such Purāṇic texts as ‘oceans, rivers, lakes, tanks, wells, sacrifices, Vedas, Mantras and such other things approach Brahman in their gross physical forms’
Not so;

units.sanskrit: मूर्तिमत्त्वे प्रसिद्धरूपाणामेव तत्र गमनानुपपत्तेः ।
units.english: because if they had real physical forms, then it would be impossible for them to go to Brahman in their wellknown physical forms;

units.sanskrit: तस्मात्प्रसिद्धमूर्तिव्यतिरेकेण सागरादीनां मूर्त्यन्तरं सागरादिभिरुपात्तं ब्रह्मलोकगन्तृ
units.english: hence it has to be assumed that what is described as going to Brahman is some form assumed by the ocean and other things, other than their wellknown physical forms

units.sanskrit: कल्पनायां यथाप्रसिद्धा एव मानस्य आकारवत्यः पुंस्त्र्याद्या मूर्तयो युक्ताः कल्पयितुं
units.english: And as some sort of an assumption is necessary in both cases, it is more reasonable to assume the generally accepted purely mental forms actually in the shape of men and women;

units.sanskrit: मानसदेहानुरूप्यसंबन्धोपपत्तेः । दृष्टा हि मानस्य एवा'कारवत्यः पुंस्त्र्याद्या मूर्तयः स्वप्ने ।
units.english: specially as all the connections described above are possible only with regard to the mental body In fact, in dreams what are seen are men and women with purely mental bodies

units.sanskrit: ननु ता अनृता एव ।
units.english: But those are all unreal;

units.sanskrit: त इमे सत्याः कामा इति श्रुतिस्तथा सति विरुध्येत । न ।
units.english: and hence if these were what was meant then it would melitate against the Vedic text that ‘His desires are true real’

units.sanskrit: मानसप्रत्ययस्य सत्त्वोपपत्तेः ।
units.english: because there is a reality in the mental concept;

units.sanskrit: मानसा हि प्रत्ययाः स्रीपुरुषाद्याकाराः स्वप्ने दृश्यन्ते । ननु जाग्रद्वासनारूपाः स्वप्नदृश्या न तु तत्र स्त्र्यादयः स्वप्ने विद्यन्ते ।
units.english: as a matter of fact men and women in purely mental forms are actually perceived during dreams But what are perceived during dreams exist only in the tendencies and impressions of the previous waking cognitions

units.sanskrit: अत्यल्पमिदमुच्यते ।
units.english: What you say is a very small part of the truth;

units.sanskrit: जाग्रद्विषया अपि मानसप्रत्ययाभिनिर्वृत्ता एव सदीक्षाभिनिर्वृत्ततेजो ऽबन्नमयत्वाज्जाग्रद्विषयाणाम् ।
units.english: in fact, even those things that are perceived during the waking state are evolved only out of consciousness which is purely mental;

units.sanskrit: संकल्पमूला हि लोका इति चोक्तम्समकॢपतां द्यावापृथिवीइत्यत्र ।
units.english: It has also been declared that all regions have their root in the Will in such texts as ‘they concerned the Heaven and Earth Chā

units.sanskrit: सर्वश्रुतिषु च प्रत्यगात्मन उत्पत्तिः प्रलयश्च तत्रैव स्थितिश्चयथा वा अरा नाभौइत्यादिनोच्यते ।
units.english: in fact, in all Vedic texts, it is in the Self alone that all regions have their origin, existence and dissolution vide such texts as ‘just as the spokes are fastened to the nave’ etc, etc

units.sanskrit: तस्मान्मानसानां बाह्यानां च विषयाणामितरेतरकार्यकारणमिष्यत एव बीजाङ्कुरवत् ।
units.english: Thus, then, as between external physical and mental internal things, the relation of cause and effect is mutual, like that between the seed and the sprout

units.sanskrit: यद्यपि बाह्या एव मानसा मानसा एव च बाह्या नानृतत्वं तेषां कदाचिदपि स्वात्मनि भवति ।
units.english: Though the mental are external and the external are the mental, yet they are never unreal in regard to the man’s own Self

units.sanskrit: ननु स्वप्ने दृष्टाः प्रतिबुद्धस्यानृता भवन्ति विषयाः ।
units.english: But objects perceived during dreams become unreal for the man on waking

units.sanskrit: सत्यमेव । जाग्रद्बोधापेक्षं तु तदनृतत्वं न स्वतः ।
units.english: True, but that unreality is in relation to the waking cognition, and does not attach to the dreamt of things by themselves

units.sanskrit: तथा स्वप्नबोधापेक्षं च जाग्रद्दृष्टविषयानृतत्वं न स्वतः ।
units.english: That is, they are unreal not per se, but only relatively to the waking cognition Similarly commonly the objects of waking perception are unreal, not by themselves, but relativelyto the dreamcognition

units.sanskrit: विशेषाकारमात्रं तु सर्वेषां मिथ्याप्रत्ययनिमित्तमिति वाचा'रम्भणं विकारो नामधेयमनृतं त्रीणि रूपाणीत्येव सत्यम् ।
units.english: What is truly unreal in regard to all things is the particular form perceived, which, in all cases, is the product of false wrong cognition, as declared in the text‘all product has its origin in some word, it is a mere name and is unreal, all that is real and true is that there are three forms universal, not particular;

units.sanskrit: तान्यप्याकारविशेषतो ऽनृतं स्वतः सन्मात्ररूपतया सत्यम् प्राक्सदात्मप्रतिबोधात्स्वविषये ऽपि सर्वं स्त्यमेव स्वप्नदृश्या इवेति न कश्चिद्विरोधः
units.english: but these also, in their particular forms, are unreal, though by themselves, in the form of Pure Being, they are real Before the cognition of the True Self, every cognition is real in regard to its own object, like things perceived during dreams So that there is no contradiction or incompatibility

units.sanskrit: तस्मान्मानसा एव ब्राह्मलौकिका अरण्यादयः पित्रादयः कामाः ।
units.english: From all this it follows that the Ara, the Ṇya and other things connected with the BrahmanRegion are purely mental objects; and so also are the fathers and other desired things, born of will

units.sanskrit: बाह्यविषयभोगवदशुद्धिरहितत्वाच्छुद्धसत्त्वसंकल्पजन्या इति निरतिशयसुखाः सत्याश्चेश्वराणां भवन्तीत्यर्थः ।
units.english: And as these are free from impurities attaching to the enjoyment of external things,being the products of the will of Pure Being,they are supremely happy and real for the Lords

units.sanskrit: सत्सत्यात्मप्रतिबोधे ऽपि रज्ज्वामिव कल्पिताः सर्पादयः सदात्मस्वरूपतामेव प्रतिपद्यन्त इति सदात्मना सत्या एव भवन्ति ॥
units.english: And even on the Cognition of Being, the True Self, all things that had been produced by such volitions become merged into the form of the Being, the True Self,just like the Serpent and other things produced by the imagination of the person become dissolved into the rope which had been mistaken for the Serpent; and on thus becoming merged into Being, they become quite real and true

units.sanskrit: इति च्छान्दोग्योपनिषदि अष्टमाध्यायस्य पञ्चमः खण्डः
units.english: End of Section of Discourse

units.sanskrit: यस्तु हृदयपुण्डरीकगतं यथोक्तगुणविशिष्टं ब्रह्म ब्रह्मचर्यादिसाधनसंपन्नस्त्यक्तबाह्यविषयानृततृष्णः
units.english: If one, who is equipped with Celibacy and other means, and is free from all longings for all external objects, meditates upon Brahman located in the Lotus of the Heart, as described above, he goes out at death through the artery in the Head;

units.sanskrit: सन्नुपास्ते तस्येयं मूर्धन्यया नाड्या गतिर्वक्तव्येति नाडीखण्ड आरभ्यते अथ या एता वक्ष्यमाणा हृदयस्य पुण्डरीकाकारस्य ब्रह्मोपासनस्थानस्य संबन्धिन्यो नाड्यो
units.english: this is what has got to be expounded now; hence the text proceeds with the ‘ArterySection’ of the Upaniṣad Now, the arteries that belong to the Heart consist of the brown substance, of the white, of the blue, of the yellow and of the red This Sun is verily brown, white, blue, yellow and red

units.sanskrit: हृदयमांसपिण्डात्सर्वतो विनिःसृता आदित्यमण्डलादिव रश्मयस्ताश्चैताः पिङ्गलस्य वर्णविशेषविशिष्टस्याणिम्नः सूक्ष्मरसस्य रसेन पूर्णास्तदाकारा एव तिष्ठन्ति वर्तन्त इत्यर्थः । तथा शुक्लस्य नीलस्य पीतस्य लोहितस्य च रसस्य पूर्णा इति सर्वत्राध्याहार्यम् ।
units.english: described as related to the Heart, shaped like the white lotus which the locus of meditation on Brahman,which spread out on all sides from the fleshy substance of the Heart, just as the Sun’s rays spread out from the solar disc,these consist of the brown substanceie filled with the extremely subtile essence of the subtile juice coloured brown,and continue to exist in that form;similarly they consist of the essence of white substance, the blue substance, the yellow substance and the red substance;

units.sanskrit: सौरेण तेजसा पित्ताख्येन पाकाभिनिर्वृत्तेन कफेनाल्पेन संपर्कात्पिङ्गलं भवति सौरं तेजः पित्ताख्याम् तदेव च वातभूयस्त्वान्नीलं भवति
units.english: When the heat of the Sun in the form of ‘Bile’ passes through a process of heating in the human body and becomes mixed up with a small quantity of Phlegm, it becomes Brown in colour, and called ‘Bile’,that same, when the Element of Wind predominates, becomes Blue;

units.sanskrit: कफेन समतायां पीतम् । शोणित बाहुल्येन लोहितम् ।
units.english: and when the Element of Phlegm predominates, it becomes White;and when there is an equal quantity of Phlegm, it becomes Yellow;

units.sanskrit: वैद्यकाद्वा वर्णविशेषा अन्वेष्टव्याः कथं भवन्तीति । श्रुतिस्त्वाहा'दित्यसंबन्धादेव तत्तेजसो नाडीष्वनुगतस्यैते वर्णविशेषा इति ।
units.english: and when there is an excess of blood, it becomes Yellow;Or the actual colours of these substanees may be found out from works on medicine As regards the question as to why these substances are so, the Vedic text declares that it is all due to connection with the Sun;

units.sanskrit: कथम् । असौ वा आदित्यः पिङ्गलो वर्णत एष आदित्यः शुक्लो ऽप्येष नील एष पीत एष लोहित आदित्य एव ॥
units.english: the heat fromthe Sun enters the arteries and assumes these colours How?This Sun is brownin colour,the Sun is white,the Sun is blue,the Sun is yellow,The Sun is red

units.sanskrit: तद् यथा महापथ आतत उभौ ग्रामौ गच्छतीमं चामुं चैवम् एवैता आदित्यस्य रश्मय उभौ लोकौ गच्छन्तीमं चामुं च ।
units.english: Just as longdistance road goes to both villages, this as well as that,so do the rays of the Sun go to both regions,this as well as that

units.sanskrit: अमुष्माद् आदित्यात् प्रतायन्ते ता आसु नाडीषु सृप्ताः । आभ्यो नाडीभ्यः प्रतायन्ते ते ऽमुष्मिन्न् आदित्ये सृप्ताः ॥
units.english: They spread out of the Sun and flow into these arteries; and spreading out of these arteries, they flow into the Sun

units.sanskrit: तस्याध्यात्मं नाडीभिः कथं संबन्ध इत्यत्र दृष्टान्तमाहतत्तत्र यथा लोके महान्विस्तीर्णः पन्था महापथ आततो व्याप्त उभौ गच्छतीमं च संनिहितममुं
units.english: The Text proceeds to explain in what way is the Sun connected with the arteriesIn the ordinary world, a longdistance roadspreading far and widegoes to both villagesthisnear oneas well as thatthat remote one;

units.sanskrit: आदित्यस्य रश्मय उभौ लोकावमुं चा'दित्यमण्डलमिमं च पुरुषं गच्छन्त्युभयत्र प्रविष्टाः ।
units.english: just as in this example, the long road enters into both the villages,in the same manner the Rays of the Sun go to both regions,thisthe solar disc,as well as thatthe man, and enter into both;

units.sanskrit: यथा महापथः ।
units.english: just like the long road

units.sanskrit: कथम् । अमुष्मादादित्यमण्डलात्प्रतायन्ते संतता भवन्ति । ता अध्यात्ममासु पिङ्गलादिवर्णासु यथोक्तासु नाडीषु सृप्ता गताः प्रविष्टा इत्यर्थः ।
units.english: How so?They spread outproceedof the Sun,the solar discand they flow intoenterthe arteriesin the body of mandescribed above as being of brown and other colours;and out of these arteries they spread outproceed in a seriesand enter the Sun

units.sanskrit: रश्मीनामुभयलिङ्गत्वात्त इत्युच्यन्ते ॥
units.english: The term ‘ray’ raśmi is both masculine and femininehence, they are spoken of as ‘they’ ‘te’ in the last sentence

units.sanskrit: तद् यत्रैतत् सुप्तः समस्तः संप्रसन्नः स्वप्नं न विजानाति । आसु तदा नाडीषु सृप्तो भवति ।
units.english: And when one is thus sound asleep, at perfect rest, so that he knows no dreams,then he enters into these arteries

units.sanskrit: तं न कश्चन पाप्मा स्पृशति ।
units.english: Him no evil touches, as he is filled with light

units.sanskrit: तत्तत्रैवं सति यत्र यस्मिन्काल एतत्स्वपनमयं जीवः सुप्तो भवति । स्वापस्य द्विप्रकारत्वाद्विशेषणं समस्त इति ।
units.english: Under the circumstances described above,whenat which timeonethe ‘Living self’is thus sound asleep;as sleep is of two kinds with and without

units.sanskrit: उपसंहृतसर्वकरणवृत्तिरित्येतत् । अतो बाह्यविषयसंपर्कजनितकालुष्याभावात्सम्यक् ।
units.english: dreams, the text has specified it as ‘sound’, which means that the functioning of all the organs has been withdrawn,and hence, there being none of the impurities due to the contact of external objects, he is at perfect rest;

units.sanskrit: अत एव स्वप्नं विषयाकाराभासं मानसं स्वप्नप्रत्ययं न विजानाति नानुभवतीत्यर्थः । यदैवं सुप्तो भवत्यासु सौरतेजःपूर्णासु यथोक्तासु नाडीषु तदा सृप्तः प्रविष्टो नाडीभिर्द्वारभूताभिर्हृदयाकाशं गतो भवतीत्यर्थः ।
units.english: and on that account, he knows no dreamshas no apprehension of any mental dreamcognition bearing an external form;at the time that the man is thus asleep, he enters into these arteries,that is, he enters into the said arteries which are full of the solar light, which means that he has entered the Ākāśa in the Heart through the said arteries

units.sanskrit: न ह्यन्यत्र सत्संपत्तेः स्वप्नादर्शनमस्तीति सामर्थ्यान्नाडीष्विति सप्तमी तृतीयया परिणम्यते ।
units.english: As a matter of fact, there is no cessation of Dreamcognition except when one has reached the True Being;

units.sanskrit: तं सता संपन्नं न कश्चन न कश्चिदपि धर्माधर्मरूपः पाप्मा स्पृशतीति स्वरूपावस्थितत्वात्तदा'त्मनः ।
units.english: Him,when he has reached the Pure Beingno evilin the shape of Merit and Demerittouches, as during that time the Self stands in Its own form

units.sanskrit: देहेन्द्रियविशिष्टं हि सुखदुःखकार्यप्रदानेन पाप्मा स्पृशतीति न तु सत्संपन्नं स्वरूपावस्थं कश्चिदपि पाप्मा स्प्रष्टुमुत्सहते ।
units.english: It is only when the Self is circumscribed by the body and the senseorgans, that the said evil touches it by bringing to it pleasure and pain;but when it has reached its own state of pure Being, no evil dares touch it;

units.sanskrit: अविषयत्वात् ।
units.english: for the single reason that it is no longer an ‘objective’;

units.sanskrit: अन्यो ह्यन्यस्य विषयो भवति न त्वन्यत्वं केनचित्कुतश्चिदपि सत्संपन्नस्य ।
units.english: it is only when there are two distinct things that one becomes the objective of another; and there can be no such difference for one who has reached the state of Pure Being;

units.sanskrit: स्वरूपप्रच्यवनं त्वात्मनो जाग्रत्स्वप्नावस्थां प्रति गमनं बाह्यविषयप्रतिबोधो
units.english: in fact, it is only when the Self has fallen off from its own nature of Pure Being that it enters the states of Waking or of Dream;

units.sanskrit: ऽविद्याकामकर्मबीजस्य ब्रह्मविद्याहुताशादाहनिमित्तमित्यवोचाम षष्ठ एव तदिहापि प्रत्येतव्यम् । यदैवं सुप्तः सौरेण तेजसा हि नाड्यन्तर्गतेन सर्वतः संपन्नो व्याप्तो भवति ।
units.english: during which there appear cognitions of external things, due to the fact that the seeds of the man’s ignorance, desires and Karmic Residum have not been quite burnt up by the fire of the Knowledge of Brahman; this we have explained under Discourse , and it should be understood in the present context alsowhen the man is thus sound asleep, he is filled uppervaded overwith the lightof the Sun, which is contained in the arteries

units.sanskrit: अतो विशेषेण चक्षुरादिनाडीद्वारैर्बाह्यविषयभोगायाप्रसृतानि करणान्यस्य तदा भवन्ति । तस्मादयं करणानां निरोधात्स्वात्मन्येवावस्थितः स्वप्नं न विजानातीति युक्तम् ॥
units.english: Hence, at this time, the man’s organs do not go out for bringing about the experiences of external objects, through the arteries of the eye etc, and thus the organs being prohibited, the man remains firm in his own self, and it is only natural that he knows no dreams

units.sanskrit: तम् अभित आसीना आहुर् जानासि मां जानासि माम् इति । स यावद् अस्माच् छरीराद् अनुत्क्रान्तो भवति । तावज् जानाति ॥
units.english: And when he is reduced to a weakened condition, those sitting around him say‘Do you know me? Do you know me?’and so long as he has not departed from this body, he knows them

units.sanskrit: जरादिनिमित्तं वा कृशीभावमेतन्नयनं नीतः प्रापितो देवदत्तो भवति मुमूर्षर्यदा भवतीत्यर्थः । तमभितः सर्वतो वेष्टयित्वा'सीना ज्ञातय आहुर्जानासि मां तव पुत्रं जानासि मां पितरं चेत्यादि । स मुमूर्षुर्यावदस्माच्छरीरादनुत्क्रान्तो ऽनिर्गतो भवति तावत्पुत्रादीञ्जानाति ॥
units.english: Such being the case, whenat which time Devadattais reducedbrought toa weakened condition, leanness and weakness due to disease or to old age, ie when he is on the point of death,then, those relations of his who are sitting around himsurround himsay‘Do you know me? Do you know me?who are your son, or your father?’ and so forth,so long as the dying man has not departed fromgone out ofthis body,he recognises his son and other relations

units.sanskrit: अथ यत्रैतद् अस्माच् छरीराद् उत्क्रामति । अथैतैर् एव रश्मिभिर् ऊर्ध्वम् आक्रमते ।
units.english: When he thus departs from this body, then, through these very rays, he proceeds upwards;

units.sanskrit: स ओम् इति वा होद् वा मीयते ।
units.english: or goes up meditating on ‘Om’ and dies;

units.sanskrit: स यावत् क्षिप्येन् मनस् तावद् आदित्यं गच्छति ।
units.english: and while his mind is failing, he goes to the Sun;

units.sanskrit: एतद् वै खलु लोकद्वारं विदुषां प्रपदनं निरोधो ऽविदुषाम् ॥
units.english: as that indeed is the door to the Regions; the knowing ones pass through, while the ignorant ones are shut out

units.sanskrit: अथ यत्र यदैतत्क्रियाविशेषणमित्यस्माच्छरीरादुत्क्रामति । अथ तदैतैरेव यथोक्ताभी रश्मिभिरूर्ध्वमाक्रमते यथाकर्मार्जितं लोकं प्रत्यविद्वान् ।
units.english: ‘Atha yatra’ is an adverbial phrase, meaning Thuswhen he departs from this body,then, through these Very rays, he proceeds upwardsto the region that he has earned for himself by his actions;

units.sanskrit: इतरस्तु विद्वान्यथोक्तसाधनसंपन्नः स ओमित्योङ्कारेणा'त्मानं ध्यायन्यथापूर्वं वा हैव, उद्वोर्ध्वं वा विद्वांश्चेदितरस्तिर्यङ्वेत्यभिप्रायः । मीयते प्रमीयते गच्छतीत्यर्थः ।
units.english: this refers to the ignorant person;as for the other, the knowing man, who is fully equipped with all the accessories described above,be goes upMeditating, through the syllable ‘Om’, on the Self; he goes, as before, or upwards,if he knows Brahman,while the other, the ignorant person goes, horizontally;and diesgoes out

units.sanskrit: स विद्वानुत्क्रमिष्यन्यावत्क्षिप्येन्मनो यावता कालेन मनसः क्षेपः स्यात्तावता कालेना'दित्यं गच्छति प्रप्नोति क्षिप्रं गच्छतीत्यर्थो न तु
units.english: The knowing person, when departing, while his mind is failing,during the time that the mind is thrown out of gear,he goes toreachesthe Sun; that is, very quickly; it does not mean that the time taken by him in reaching the Sun is exactly that during which his mind is failing

units.sanskrit: किमर्थमादित्यं गच्छतीत्युच्यतेएतद्वै खलु प्रसिद्धं ब्रह्मलोकस्य द्वारं य आदित्यस्तेन द्वारभूतेन ब्रह्मलोक गच्छति विद्वान् ।
units.english: The next sentence explains why he goes to the Sun As thatSunindeed is thewellknowndoor through which the knowing one goes to the Brahmic Region;

units.sanskrit: अतो विदुषां प्रपदनं प्रपद्यते ब्रह्मलोकमनेन द्वारेणेति प्रपदनम् ।
units.english: hence, for the knowing persons there is passing through,they pass through that doorto the Brahmic Region;

units.sanskrit: निरोधनं निरोधो ऽस्मादादित्यादविदुषां भवतीति निरोधः ।
units.english: while for the ignorant persons, there is shutting outthey are shut outfrom the Sun;

units.sanskrit: सौरेण तेजसा देह एव निरुद्धाः सन्तो मूर्धन्यया नाड्या नोत्क्रमन्त एवेत्यर्थः ।
units.english: that these latter are held back in the body by the light of the Sun, and hence do not pass through the Artery in the Head

units.sanskrit: विष्वङ्ङन्या इति श्लोकात् ॥
units.english: That this is so is also indicated by the verseViṣvananyā etc’, the last foot of the next text

units.sanskrit: तद् एष श्लोकः । शतं चैका च हृदयस्य नाड्यस् तासां मूर्धानम् अभिनिःसृतैका ।
units.english: To this end, there is the following verse‘There are a hundred and one arteries of the Heart; one of them goes out into the Head;

units.sanskrit: तयोर्ध्वम् आयन्न् अमृतत्वम् एति विष्वङ्ङ् अन्या उत्क्रमणे भवन्त्य् उत्क्रमणे भवन्ति ॥
units.english: passing upwards by way of that, one reaches the Immortal; while the other arteries serve as ways for departing in various directions;yea, for departing in various directions’

units.sanskrit: तदेतस्मिन्यथोक्तेर्ऽथ एष श्लोको मन्त्रो भवति । शतं चैका चैकोत्तरशतं नाड्यो हृदयस्य मांसपिण्डभूतस्य संबन्धिन्यः प्रधानतो भवन्ति । आनन्त्याद्देहनाडीनाम् ।
units.english: To this end,ie in the sense of what has gone above,there is the following versemantra textthere are a hundred and one arteries of the Heart,these are the principal arteries connected with fleshy mass of the Heart, as the actual number of such arteries is endless;of them, one goes out into the Head,passed upwards into the Head;

units.sanskrit: तासामेका मूर्धानमभिनिःसृता विनिर्गता तयोर्ध्वमायन्गच्छन्नमृतत्वममृतभावमेति विष्वङ्नानागतयस्तिर्यग्विसर्पिण्य ऊर्ध्वगाश्चान्या नाड्यो भवन्ति संसारगमनद्वारभूता
units.english: passing upwards by way of that, one reaches the immortal, ie the state of immortality; while the other arteries serve as Ways for departing in various directionsproceeding towards various directions, ie both horizontally and vertically;being the doors leading to the Cycle of Births and Deaths;

units.sanskrit: न त्वमृतत्वाय किं तर्ह्यत्कमण एवोत्क्रान्त्यर्थमेव भवन्तीत्यर्थः ।
units.english: and these latter do not lead to immortality; they only serve as the ways for going out of the present bodyto others

units.sanskrit: द्विरभ्यासः प्रकरणसमाप्त्यर्थः ॥
units.english: End of Section of Discourse It has been declared above under iii

units.sanskrit: इति च्छान्दोग्योपनिषदि अष्टमाध्यायस्य षष्ठः खण्डः
units.english: and it is for this purpose that the text proceeds with the next Section

units.sanskrit: य आत्मा अपहतपाप्मा विजरो विमृत्युर् विशोको विजिघत्सो ऽपिपासः सत्यकामः सत्यसंकल्पः सो ऽन्वेष्टव्यः स विजिज्ञासितव्यः ।
units.english: ‘That Selfwhich is free from evil, free from decrepitude, free from death, free from sorrow, free from hunger and thirst, with true desires and true volitions,should be sought after, should be sought to be understood;

units.sanskrit: स सर्वांश् च लोकान् आप्नोति सर्वांश् च कामान् यस् तम् आत्मानम् अनुविद्य विजानातीति ह प्रजापतिर् उवाच ॥
units.english: he attains all regionsand all desires,who has sought to know Self and understands It’;so said Prajāpati

units.sanskrit: अथ य एष संप्रसादो ऽस्माच्छरीरात्समुत्थाय परं ज्योतिरुपसंपद्य स्वेन रूपेणाभिनिष्पद्यत एष आत्मेति होवाचैतदमृतमभयमेतद्ब्रह्मैत्युक्तम्
units.english: That Self, which is free from evil, free from decrepitude, free from death, free from sorrow, free from hunger and thirst, with true desires and true volitions,for the purpose of meditating upon which the white lotus of the Heart has been declared to be the place when it can be perceived,wherein are contained all true desires concealed by the untrue,as a concomitant with the meditation whereof Celibacy has been declared to be a means,and for the knowledge of the result of whose meditation, the passing out by the Artery in the Head has been described,this Self should be sought after,should be sought to be known through scriptures and the Teachings of the Teacher;

units.sanskrit: तत्र को ऽसौ संप्रसादः,
units.english: So said Prajāpati

units.sanskrit: कथं वा तस्याधिगमो यथा सो ऽस्माच्छरीरात्सविजिज्ञासितव्य इति चैष नियमविधिरेव नापूर्वविधिः ।
units.english: The two expressions ‘should be sought to be known’ and ‘should be sought to be understood’ contain restrictive,not originativeinjunctions;

units.sanskrit: एवमन्वेष्टव्यो विजिज्ञासितव्य इत्यर्थः ।
units.english: the sense being that ‘It is to be sought to be known,and sought to be understood,in this particular manner’;

units.sanskrit: दृष्टार्थत्वादन्वेषणविजिज्ञासनयोः ।
units.english: that such is the restriction implied follows from the fact that both the actsthe seeking to know and seeking to understand,serve perceptible purposes;

units.sanskrit: दृष्टार्थत्वं च दर्शयिष्यति नाहमात्र भोग्यं पश्यामीत्यनेनासकृत् ।
units.english: that this is so is going to be shown repeatedly later on, in the texts, ‘ see no good in this etc, etc

units.sanskrit: पररूपेण च देहादिधर्भैरवगन्यमानस्या'त्मनः स्वरूपाधिगमे विपरीताधिगमनिवृत्तिर्दृष्टं फलमिति नियमार्थतैवास्य विधेर्युक्ता न त्वाग्निहोत्रादीनामिबापूर्वविधित्वमिह संभवति ॥ तद् धोभये देवासुरा अनुबुबुधिरे ।
units.english: When hitherto the Self has been known through the qualities of the Body, the senseorgans etc,if and when its own real form causes to be understood,it leads to the perceptible result in the form of the cessation disappearance of the preceding wrong notion; for this reason the injunction in question should be taken to be a restrictive one, and an originative one, like the injunction of Agnihotra and other acts

units.sanskrit: ते होचुर् हन्त तम् आत्मआनम् अन्वेच्छामो यम् आत्मानम् अन्विष्य सर्वांश् च लोकान् आप्नोति सर्वांश् च कामान् इति ।
units.english: Both Devas and Asuras heard this, and they said‘Well, we shall search for that Self by searching which one attains all regions and all desires’

units.sanskrit: इन्द्रो हैव देवानाम् अभिप्रवव्राज विरोचनो ऽसुराणाम् ।
units.english: Indra, from among the Devas, went out, and so did Virocana from among the Asuras;

units.sanskrit: तौ हासंविदानाव् एव समित्पाणी प्रजापतिसकाशम् आजग्मतुः ॥
units.english: and both, without communicating with one another, with fuel in their hands, approached Prajāpati

units.sanskrit: तद्धोभय इत्याद्याख्यायिकाप्रयोजनमुक्तम् ।
units.english: Both etc the purpose of this story has been already stated befor

units.sanskrit: तद्ध किल प्रजापतेर्वचनमुभये देवासुरा देवाश्चासुराश्च देवासुरा अनु परम्परागतं स्वकर्णगोचरापन्नमनुबुबुधिरे ऽनुबुद्धवन्तः । ते चैतत्प्रजापतिवचो बुद्ध्वा किमकुर्वन्नित्युच्यतेते होचुरुक्तवन्तो ऽन्योन्यं देवाः स्वपरिषद्यसुराश्च हन्त यद्यनुमतिर्भवतां प्रजापतिनोक्तं तमात्मानमन्विच्छामो
units.english: What Prajāpati had said as reported at the end of the last sectionboth Devas and Asuras heard;it came to their ears through longcontinued tradition And having understood what Prajāpati had said, what they did is next described they saidthe Devas in their own assembly, and the Asuras in theirs‘Well,if you all agree we shall search for that Selfwhich Prajāpati has spoken of,we shall carry on a search for It,by searching which one attains all regions and all desires’

units.sanskrit: हैव राजैव स्वयं देवानामितरान्देवांश्च भोगपरिच्छदं च सर्वं स्थापयित्वा शरीरमात्रेणैव प्रजापतिं प्रत्यभिप्रवव्राज प्रगतवांस्तथा विरोचनो ऽसुराणाम् ।
units.english: Having said this, Indra,this kingfrom among the Devashimself, leaving behind all other Devas and the all accessories of enjoyment, with his body alonewent outtowards Prajāpati; and so also did Virocana from among the Asuras

units.sanskrit: विनयेन गुरवो ऽभिगन्तव्या इत्येतद्दर्शयति । त्रैलोक्यराज्याच्च गुरुतरा विद्यते ।
units.english: The text shows that Teachers have to be approached in due humilitybecause Learning is superior even to the kingdom of the three regions;

units.sanskrit: यतो देवासुरराजौ महार्हभोगार्है सन्तौ तथा गुरुमभ्युपगतवन्तौ ।
units.english: inasmuch as the king of the Devas and the king of the Asuras,deserving and to the best of comforts, went out to meet the Teacher

units.sanskrit: तौ ह किलासंविदानावेवान्योन्यं संविदमकुर्वाणौ विद्याफलं प्रत्यन्योन्यमीर्ष्यां दर्शयन्तौ समित्पाणी समिद्भारहस्तौ प्रजापतिसकाशमाजग्मतुरागतवन्तौ
units.english: They went, without comunicating with one another,without consulting between themselves,thereby showing their jealousy towards each other regarding the reward of Learning;they went with fuel in their hands,carrying loads of fuel in their hands, approachedcame over toPrajāpati

units.sanskrit: तौ ह प्रजापतिर् उवाच । किम् इच्छन्ताव् अवास्तम् इति । तौ होचतुर् य आत्मा अपहतपाप्मा विजरो विमृत्युर् विशोको विजिघत्सो ऽपिपासः सत्यकामः सत्यसंकल्पः सो ऽन्वेष्टव्यः स विजिज्ञासितव्यः । स सर्वांश् च लोकान् आप्नोति सर्वांश् च कामान् यस् तम् आत्मानम् अनुविद्य विजानातीति भगवतो वचो वेदयन्ते । तम् इच्छन्ताव् अवास्तम् इति ॥
units.english: They dwelt there as Religious students, for thirtytwo years,Then Prajāpati said to them‘Desiring what, have you dwelt here?’They said‘They report a saying of yours, Sir, to the effect that that Self which is free from evil, free from decrepitude, free from death, free from sorrow, free from hunger and thirst, with true desires and true volitions, should be sought after should be sought to be understood, and he attains all regions and all desires who has sought to know the Self and understands it;it is desiring this that we have dwelt here’

units.sanskrit: तौ ह गत्वा द्वात्रिंशतं वर्षाणि शुश्रूषापरौ भूत्वा ब्रह्मचर्यमूषतुरुषितवन्तौ ।
units.english: Having gone to Prajāpati, both of them dwelt as Religious students, devoting themselves to service, for thirtytwo years

units.sanskrit: अभिप्रायज्ञः प्रजापतिस्तावुवाच किमिच्छन्तौ किं प्रयोजनमभिप्रेत्येच्छन्ताववास्तमुषितवन्तौ युवामितीत्युक्तौ तौ होचतुः ।
units.english: knowing their intentions, Prajāpati said to them‘Desiring what,for what purpose in view,have you dwelt here ’thus asked, they said‘that Self etc etc,is a saying of forms which cultured people report;

units.sanskrit: यद्यपि प्राक्प्रजापतेः समीपागमनादन्योन्यमीर्ष्यायुक्तावबूतां तथापि विद्याप्राप्तिप्रयोजनगौरवात्त्यक्तरागद्वेषमोहेर्ष्यादि दोषावेव भूत्वोषतुर्ब्रह्मचर्यं
units.english: hence it is with a view to find out that Self that we have dwelt here’ Though, before coming to Prajāpati, the two persons were full of mutual jealousy, yet, inview of the great importance of the acquisition of learning, both of them had renouncedall love, hatred, delusion, jealousy, and all such impurities of character, while dwelling as religious students, with Prajāpati

units.sanskrit: तेनेदं प्रख्यापितमात्मविद्यागौरवम् ॥
units.english: This indicates the great importance of the Philosophy of Self

units.sanskrit: तौ ह प्रजापतिर् उवाच य एषो ऽक्षिणि पुरुषो दृष्यत एष आत्मेति होवाच ।
units.english: Prajāpati said to them‘the person that is seen in the eye,that is the Self that spoke of;

units.sanskrit: एतद् अमृतम् अभयम् एतद् ब्रह्मेति । अथ यो ऽयं भगवो ऽप्सु परिख्यायते यश् चायम् आदर्शे कतम एष इति । एष उ एवैषु सर्वेष्वन्न्तेषु परिख्यायत इति होवाच ॥
units.english: this is the immortal, the fearless, Brahman’‘Sir, he that is perceived in water, and he that is perceived in the mirror,which of these is That?’ He said‘It is He himselfis perceived in all insides’

units.sanskrit: तावेवं तपस्विनौ शुद्धकल्मषौ योग्यावुपलभ्य प्रजापतिरुवाचहय एषो ऽक्षिणि पुरुषो निवृत्तचक्षुर्भिर्मृदितकषायैर्दृश्यते
units.english: Finding that the two pupils had passed through asceticism and had all their impurities cleared off and hence become qualified

units.sanskrit: एष आत्मापहतपाप्मादिगुणो यमवोचं पुराहं यद्विज्ञानात्सर्वलोककामावाप्तिरेतदमृतं भमाख्यमत एवाभयमत एव ब्रह्म वृद्धतममिति । अथैतत्प्रजापतिनोक्तमक्षिणि पुरुषो दृश्यत इति वचः श्रुत्वा छायारूपं पुरुषं जगृहतुः ।
units.english: Prajāpati said to them‘The person that is seen in the Eye,by mystics, as the seer,ihat is the Self,endowed with such qualities as freedom from evil and the like,that spoke ofon a former occasion,by the understanding whereof all regions and all desires are attained;this is the Immortal,named ‘the Infinite, and hencefearless and henceBrahmanthe Highest’Having heard the words ‘the person seen in the eye’, the two pupils understood this person to be the reflected image in the eye;

units.sanskrit: गृहीत्वा च दृढीकरणाय प्रजापतिं पृष्टवन्तौ ।
units.english: and having understood it thus, they asked Prajāpati, with a view to confirm it;

units.sanskrit: अथ यो ऽयं हे भगवो ऽप्सु परिख्यायते परिसमन्ताज्ज्ञायते यश्चायमादर्श आत्मनः प्रतिबिम्बाकारः परिख्यायते खड्गादौ च कतम एष एषां भगवद्भिरुक्तः किंवैक एव सर्वेष्विति । एवं पृष्टः प्रजापतिरुवाचएष उ एव यश्चक्षुषि द्रष्टा मयोक्त इति ।
units.english: ‘Sir, He that is perceived in water, and he that is perceived in the mirror,the reflected image of one’s Self,as also in such reflecting surfaces as the bright sword and the like,which of these is that,Self which you spoke of? Is it that which is reflected in one only? or in all?’ Thus questioned, Prajāpati said‘It is He himselfthe one seen in the eye, as the seer, which spoke of;

units.sanskrit: एतन्मनसि कृत्वैषु सर्वेष्वन्तेषु मध्येषु परिख्यायत इति होवाच ।
units.english: having kept this idea in his mind, he added‘perceived in all insides inside all reflecting surfaces’

units.sanskrit: ननु कथं युक्तं शिष्योर्विपरीतग्रहणमनुज्ञातुं प्रजापतेर्विगतदोषस्या'चार्यस्य सतः ।
units.english: ObjectionHow can it be proper to accede to a wrong idea entertained by the pupils the wrong idea being that ‘it is the reflected image in all reflecting surfaces that is the Self’for Prajāpati who is a Teacher entirely free from all deficiencies?

units.sanskrit: सत्यमेव, नानुज्ञातम् ।
units.english: True; but he did not accede to it

units.sanskrit: कथम् ।
units.english: How so?

units.sanskrit: आत्मन्यध्यारोपितपाण्डित्यमहत्त्वबोद्धृत्वौ हीन्द्रविरोचनौ तथैव च प्रथितौ लोके ।
units.english: As a matter of fact, both Indra and Virocana were persons who had arrogated to themselves learning, greatness and understanding; they are to be so in the world;

units.sanskrit: तौ यदि प्रजापतिना मूढौ युवां विपरीतग्राहिणावित्युक्तौ स्यातां ततस्तस्तयोश्चित्ते दुःखं स्यात्तज्जनिताच्च चित्तावसादात्पुनः प्रश्नश्रवणग्रहणावधारणं प्रत्युत्साहविधातः
units.english: that being so, if they were told straightway, by Prajāpati ‘Both of you are fools and have understood things ‘wrongly’,then it would have caused pain in their mindsand on account of this mental depression, they would not be encouraged to put further questions and learn things;

units.sanskrit: स्यादतो रक्षणीयौ शिष्याविति मन्यते प्रजापतिः ।
units.english: hence Prajāpati thinks of saving His pupils from such depression;

units.sanskrit: गृह्णीतां तावत्तदुदशरावदृष्टान्तेनापनेष्यामीति च ।
units.english: His idea being‘let them apprehend things as they have, am going to remove their misconception by means of the illustration of the Cup of water next section

units.sanskrit: ननु न युक्तमेष उ एवेत्यनृतं वक्तुम् ।
units.english: Any way, it was not right for him to say‘it is He Himself that is seen in the eyeperceived in all insides’,which was evidently untrue

units.sanskrit: न चानृतमुक्तम् ।
units.english: Nothing untrue has been said

units.sanskrit: कथम् ।
units.english: How so?

units.sanskrit: आत्मनोक्तो ऽक्षिपुरुषो मनसि संनिहिततरः शिष्यगृहीताच्छायात्मनः सर्वेषां चाभ्यन्तरःसर्वान्तरःइति श्रुतेः ।
units.english: What Prajāpati himself had said in regard to the Person in the Eye, was closer in His Mind than the Self of the Reflections which had been understood by the pupils The ‘inside of all is the allinside’ says the Vedic text;

units.sanskrit: तमेवावोचदेष उ एवेत्यतो नानृतमुक्तं प्रजापतिना । तथा च तयोर्विपरीतग्रहणनिवृत्त्यर्थं ह्याह ॥
units.english: and it was with reference to this ‘Allinside’ that he declared that it was perceived in all insides So that Prajāpati said nothing that was not true His assertion that ‘the Person in in Eye is perceived in allinsides’ being perfectly true

units.sanskrit: इति च्छान्दोग्योपनिषदि अष्टमाध्यायस्य सप्तमः खण्डः
units.english: With a view to remove the misconception in the minds of his pupils, Prajāpati said as follows End of Section of Discourse

units.sanskrit: उदशराव आत्मानम् अवेक्ष्य यद् आत्मनो न विजानीथस् तन् मे प्रब्रूतम् इति ।
units.english: ‘Look at yourselves in a cup of water, and then what you do not understand of the Self,tell me’They looked at themselves in a cup of water

units.sanskrit: तौ ह प्रजापतिर् उवाच किं पश्यथ इति । तौ होचतुः सर्वम् एवेदम् आवां भगव आत्मानं पश्याव आ लोमभ्यः आ नखेभ्यः प्रतिरूपम् इति ॥
units.english: Prajāpati said to them‘What do you see?’They said‘Sir, we see ourselves entirely as we are, even to the hairs and nails,a perfect replica’

units.sanskrit: उदशराव उदकपूर्णे शरावादावात्मानमवेक्ष्यानन्तरं यत्तत्रा'त्मानं पश्यन्तौ न विजानीथस्तन्मे मम प्रब्रूतमाचक्षीयाथामित्युक्तौ तौ ह तथैवोदशरावे
units.english: ‘In a cap of water,In a cup filled with water, and such other receptacles,look at yourselves,and then, what you do not understand of the Selftell me’ Being thus directed, they looked at themselves in the cup of wateraccordingly

units.sanskrit: तथा कृतवन्तौ तौ ह प्रजापतिरुवाच किं पश्यथ इति ।
units.english: When they had done that, Prajāpati said to them‘What do you see?’

units.sanskrit: ननु तन्मे प्रब्रूतमित्युक्ताभ्यामुदशरावे ऽवेक्षणं कृत्वा प्रजापतये न निवेदितमिदमावाभ्यां न विदितमित्यनिवेदिते चाज्ञानहेतौ ह प्रजापतिरुवाच किं पश्यथ इति तत्र को ऽभिप्राय इति ।
units.english: after looking into the cup of water, they did not tell anything to Prajāpati, as to what they did not understand; and without this nonunderstanding and its cause having been repeated to him, Prajāpati at once put the question ‘What do you see?’now what is the meaning of this?

units.sanskrit: उच्यतेनैव तयोरिदमावयोरविदितमित्याशङ्काभूच्छायात्मन्यात्मप्रत्ययो निश्चित एवा'सीत् ।
units.english: AnswerAs a matter of fact, they did not have the least suspicion as to their having not understood anything, as they had the definite conviction that the reflection was the Self that this was so is shown by the declaration later on that ‘they went out with their hearts satisfied and at peace Text , below;

units.sanskrit: न ह्यनिश्चिते ऽभिप्रेतार्थे प्रशान्तहृदयत्वमुपपद्यते ।
units.english: no such peace in heart would be possible if the conviction had not been firm and certain

units.sanskrit: तेन नोचतुरिदमावाभ्यामविदितमिति ।
units.english: This is the reason why they did not say ‘we have not understood this’

units.sanskrit: विपरीतग्राहिणौ च शिष्यावनुपेक्षणीयाविति स्वयमेष पप्रच्छ किं पश्यथ इति,
units.english: And yet the teacher put the question himself‘What do you see?’because it would not be right to ignore the pupils who had formed wrong conclusions;

units.sanskrit: विपरीतनिश्चयापनयाय च वक्ष्यति साध्वलकृतावित्येवमादि ।
units.english: in fact, in order to remove their misconception, he is going to assert later on next sentence‘Having adorned yourself etc, etc’

units.sanskrit: तौ होचतुःसर्वमेवेदमावां भगव आत्मानं पश्याव आ लोमभ्य आ नखेभ्यः प्रतिरूपमिति, यथैवा'वां हे भगवो लोमनखादिमन्तौ स्व एवमेवेदं लोमनखादिसहितमावयोः प्रतिरूपमुदशरावे पश्याव इति ॥ तौ ह प्रजापतिर् उवाच साध्वलंकृतौ सुवसनौ परिष्कृतौ भूत्वोदशरावे ऽवेक्षेथाम् इति ।
units.english: To Prajāpati’s question, they replied‘Sir, we see ourselves entirely as we are, even to the hairs and nails,an exact replica;just as we are, with hairs and nails and other things, so do we see ourselves in the watercup, along with the hairs and nails our exact replica’ Prajāpati said to them‘Having become welladorned, welldressed and wellgroomed, look into the watercup’ Becoming welladorned, welldressed and wellgroomed, they looked into the watercup

units.sanskrit: तौ ह प्रजापतिर् उवाच किं पश्यथ इति ॥
units.english: Prajāpati said to them‘What do you see?’

units.sanskrit: तौ ह पुनः प्रजापतिरुवाच च्छायात्मनिश्चयापनयाय,
units.english: Prajāpati said to them, againfor the purpose of removing their misconception regarding the Self

units.sanskrit: साध्वलङ्कृतौ यथा स्वगृहे सुवसनौ महार्हवस्त्रपरिधानौ परिष्कृतौ छिन्नलोमनखौ च भूत्वोदशरावे तयोश्छायात्मग्रहो ऽपनीतः स्यात्
units.english: ‘Having become welladorned,as you generally are, at home,welldressed,dressed in valuable clothes,wellgroomedwith hairs cut and nails paredlook again into the watercup’ In this case, he did not add ‘tell me what you do not understand’

units.sanskrit: साध्वलङ्कारसुवसनादीनामागन्तुकानां छायाकरत्वमुदशरावे यथा शरीरसंबद्धानामेवं शरीरस्यापि च्छायाकरत्वं पूर्वं बभूवेति गम्यते शरीरैकदेशानां च लोमनखादीनां नित्यत्वेनाभिप्रेतानामखण्डितानां छायाकरत्वं पूर्वमासीत् । छिन्नेषु च तेषु नैव लोमनखादिच्छाया दृश्यते ऽतो लोमनखादिवच्छरीरस्याप्यागमापायित्वं
units.english: What is implied is thatjust as the reflection in the watercup in the second case, has been brought about by such adventitious characteristics as the ornamentation, dressing, and the rest attached to the body, so, in the former case also, the reflection was apparently due to the Hairs and Nails and other parts of the body, which had not been cut and which had been regarded as permanent features,and when, on the latter occasion, the Hairs and Nails had been cut off, no reflection of these Hairs and Nails is seen; and from this analogy of the Hairs and Nails, it follows that the Body also is only an appendage liable to come and go;

units.sanskrit: सिद्धमित्युदशरावादौ दृश्यमानस्य तन्निमित्तस्य च देहस्यानात्मत्वं सिद्धम् उदशारावादौ
units.english: and from all this it becomes established that the reflection seen in the watercup,as also its source, the Body itself,is not the Self;

units.sanskrit: छायाकरत्वाद्देहसंबद्धालङ्कारादिवत् ।
units.english: just like the ornaments and other things attached to the body which had caused the reflection in the watercup

units.sanskrit: न केवलमेतावदेतेन यावत्किञ्चिदात्मीयत्वाभिमतं सुखदुःखरागद्वेषमोहादि च कादाचित्कत्वान्नखलोमादिवदनात्मेति प्रत्येतव्यम् ।
units.english: It is not only this; in fact, whateverin the shape of Pleasure and Pain, Love and Hatred and Delusion etc,is generally regarded as one’s own, is all Notself, because all this is adventitious, just like the Hairs and Nails

units.sanskrit: एवमशेषमिथ्याग्रहापनयनिमित्ते साध्वलङ्कारादिदृष्टान्ते प्रजापतिनोक्ते श्रुत्वा तथा कृतवतोरपि च्छायात्मविपरीतग्रहो नापजगाम यस्मात्तस्मात्स्वदोषेणैव केनचित्प्रतिबद्धविवेकविज्ञानाविन्द्रविरोचनावभूतामित् इ गम्यते ।
units.english: When thus Prajāpati had cited the illustration of the ‘Ornament, dress and grooming for the purpose of removing all wrong notions,and the pupils heard it, and did as they were told, the wrong notion that they had with regard to the reflection being the Self did not disappear From this it would appear as if Indra and Virocana had their sense of discrimination obstructed by some fault of their own

units.sanskrit: तौ पूर्ववदेव दृढनिश्चयौ पप्रच्छ किं पश्यथ इति ॥
units.english: Hence finding them still firm in their previous conception, Prajāpati said to them‘what do you see?’

units.sanskrit: तौ होचतुर् यथैवेदम् आवां भगवः साध्वलंकृतौ सुवसनौ परिष्कृतौ स्व एवम् एवेमौ भगवः साध्वल्लंकृतौ सुवसनौ परिष्कृताव् इति
units.english: They said‘Just as we are ourselves, welladorned, welldressed and wellgroomed,so are these also welladorned, welldressed and wellgroomed’

units.sanskrit: एष आत्मेति होवाच । एतद् अमृतम् अभयम् एतद् ब्रह्मेति ।
units.english: He said‘That is the Self,the ‘Immortal, the Fearless;

units.sanskrit: तौ ह शान्तहृदयौ प्रवव्रजतुः ॥
units.english: that is Brahman’They both went away with their hearts satisfied

units.sanskrit: तौ तथैव प्रतिपन्नो यथैवेदमिति पूर्ववद्यथा साध्वलङ्कारादिविशिष्टावावां स्व एवमेवेमौ छायात्मानाविति सुतरां विपरीतनिश्चयौ
units.english: They continued to have the same ideaexactly as they had understood it in the first instance ‘just as we are welladorned etc so are these reflected Selves also’,such was the wrong notion in which they definitely persisted

units.sanskrit: यस्या'त्मनो लक्षणं य आत्मापहतपाप्मेत्युक्तवा पुनस्तद्विशेषमन्विष्यमाणयोर्य एषो
units.english: The distinguishing characteristics of the Self had been declared to be freedom from evil and the rest;

units.sanskrit: ऽक्षिणि पुरुषो दृश्यत इति साक्षादात्मनि निर्दिष्टे तद्विपरीतग्रहापनयायोदशरावसाध्वलङ्कारदृष्टान्ते
units.english: and then when the two pupils came seeking for further knowledge of the qualifications of the Self,Prajāpati directly pointed out to them the Self by the words ‘the person that is seen in the Eye’;

units.sanskrit: ऽप्यभिहित आत्मस्वरूपबोधाद्विपरीतग्रहो नापगतः । अतः स्वदोषेण केनचित्प्रतिबद्धविवेकविज्ञानसामर्थ्याविति मत्वा यथाभिप्रेतमेवा'त्मानं मनसि निधायैष आत्मेति होवाचैतदमृतमभयमेतद्ब्रह्मेति
units.english: thereupon, for the purpose of removing false notions regarding the Self, the illustration of the watercup and the ornamentation was put forward;though all this was done, the wrong notion that they had formed has not yet been removed by the correct notion of the Self;hence both these persons have their powers of discrimination obstructed by some fault of their own;having thought over all this, Prajāpati,still keeping within his mind his own correct notion of the Self,said ‘That is the Self,the Immortal, the Fearless, It is

units.sanskrit: प्रजापतिः पूर्ववत् ।
units.english: Brahman’, as before;

units.sanskrit: न तु तदभिप्रेतमात्मानम् ।
units.english: all this he said in reference to the Self as present in His own mind, and not in reference to the Self as conceived by the pupils

units.sanskrit: य आत्मेत्याद्यात्मलक्षणश्रवणेनाक्षिपुरुषश्रुत्या चोदशरावाद्युपपत्त्या च संस्कृतौ तावत् । मद्वचनं सर्वं पुनः पुनः स्मरतोः प्रतिबन्धक्षयाच्च स्वयमेवा'त्मविषये विवेको भविष्यतीति मन्वानः पुनर्ब्रह्मचर्यादेशे च तयोश्चित्तदुखोत्पत्तिं परिजिहीर्षन्कृतार्थबुद्धितया
units.english: ‘By this time, the two pupils had become duly educated and cultured by hearing the definition of the Self as free from evil etc, by learning ofthe Person in the Eye, and by the reasonings declared from the example of the Watercup;and by pondering over my words again and again, the obstruction to their understanding having disappeared, they would, by themselves attain the true discriminative knowledge of Self’;with this idea in his mind, Prajāpati thought that if he were to advise them to dwell again as religious students, they would be pained in their hearts;

units.sanskrit: गच्छन्तावप्युपेक्षितवान्प्रजापतिः ।
units.english: and with a view to saving from this he permitted them to depart when they were going out with the satisfaction that they had accomplished their purpose

units.sanskrit: तौ हेन्द्रविरोचनौ शान्तहृदयौ तुष्टहृदयौ कृतार्थबुद्धी इत्यर्थः । न तु शम एव,
units.english: And they bothIndra and Virocanawith their hearts satisfied with the notion that their purpose had been fulfilled;they did not attain real peace;

units.sanskrit: शमश्चेत्तयोर्जातो विपरीतग्रहो विगतो ऽभविष्यत्प्रवव्रजतुर्गतवन्तौ ॥
units.english: for if they had attained real peace, their wrong notion would have automatically disappeared;thus they went away

units.sanskrit: तौ हान्वीक्ष्य प्रजापतिर् उवाच । अनुपलभ्यात्मानम् अननुविद्य व्रजतो यतर एतदुपनिषदो भविष्यन्ति देवा वा असुरा वा ते पराभविष्यन्तीति । स ह शान्तहृदय एव विरोचनो ऽसुराञ् जगाम । तेभ्यो हैताम् उपनिषदं प्रोवाच आत्मैवेह महय्य आत्मा परिचर्यः ।
units.english: And Prajāpati, looking after them,said,‘without having perceived and without having understood this Self, they are going away; now, whoever of the two, Devas or Asuras, will accept this doctrine will be landed in trouble’Now, Virocana, with a satisfied heart, went out to the Asuras and preached to them this doctrineviz ‘The Self alone is to be worshipped, the Self alone is to be attended upon;

units.sanskrit: आत्मानम् एवेह महयन्न् आत्मानं परिचरन्न् उभौ लोकाव् आप्नोतीमं चामुं चेति ॥
units.english: and it is only by worshipping the Self and attending upon the Self that one secures both regions,this as well as that other’

units.sanskrit: स्यादित्याशङ्क्याप्रत्यक्षं प्रत्यक्षवचनेन च चित्तदुःखं परिजिहीर्षुस्तौ दूरं गच्छन्तावन्वीक्ष्य य आत्मापहतपाप्मेत्यादिवचनवदेतदप्यनयोः श्रवणगोचरत्वमेष्यतीति मत्वोवाच प्रजापतिः । अनुपलभ्य यथोक्तलक्षणमात्मानमननुविद्य स्वात्मप्रत्यक्षं चाकृत्वा विपरीतनिश्चयौ च भूत्वेन्द्रविरोचनावेतौ व्रजतो गच्छेयाताम् । अतो यतरे देवा वासुरा वा किं विशेषितेनैतदुपनिषद आभ्यां या गृहीता'त्मविद्या सेयमुपनिषद्येषां देवानामसुराणां वा त एतदुपनिषद एवंविज्ञाना
units.english: ‘When the two kings, Indra and Virocana have gone away and become addicted to thempleasurable experiences,they would forget what has been said to them,’suspecting this, and being desirous of removing their troubles indirectly and yet by direct assertion,Prajāpati,seeing them going away at a distance, said,in the hope that, like my declaration regarding ‘the Self being free from evil’ and etc,my present warning also might reach their earswithout having perceived the Self described aboveie not having realised it in their own perception without selfrealisation,and entertaining entirely notions regarding it,these twoIndra and Virocanaare going away;now, whoever of the two, Devas or Asuras,will be what?will accept this doctrine,ie those for whom the true philosophy of the Self will be what these two have understood it to be,those among Devas and Asuras will accept this view, entertain this notion,they what?They will be landed in troublebe flung away from the path of prosperity,be destroyed

units.sanskrit: स्वगृहं गच्छतोः सुरासुरराजयोर्यो ऽसुरराजः स ह शान्तहृदय एव सन्विरोचनो ऽसुराञ्जगाम ।
units.english: When the two kingsthe king of Devas and the king of Asuraswere going away; the King of Asuras, Virocana, with a satisfied heart, went to the Asuras;

units.sanskrit: गत्वा च तेभ्यो ऽसुरेभ्यः शरीरात्मबुद्धिर्योपनिषत्तामेतामुपनिषदं प्रोवाचोक्तवान् । देहमात्रमेवा'त्मा पित्रोक्त इति ।
units.english: and having gone to them,preached to themthe Asurasthis doctrinethat the body is the Self,the father has declared the body itself to be the self;

units.sanskrit: तस्मादात्मैव देह इह लोक महय्यः पूजनीयस्तथा परिचर्यः परिचरणीयस्तथा'त्मानमेवेह लोके देहं महयन्परिचरंश्चोभौ लोकाववाप्नोतीमं
units.english: hence the Selfie the Bodyalone is to be Worshippedin this world,and to be attended upon,and it is only by worshipping the selfie the Bodyand attending upon it,secures both regions,this as well as that other;

units.sanskrit: चामुं च । इहलोकपरलोकयोरेव सर्वे लोकाः कामाश्चान्तर्भवन्तीति राज्ञो ऽभिप्रायः ॥
units.english: what the king means was that these two regions include all Regions and all desirable things

units.sanskrit: तस्माद् अप्यद्द्येहाददानम् अश्रद्दधानम् अयजमानम् आहुर् आसुरो बतेति । असुराणां ह्य् एषोपनिषत् ।
units.english: For this reason, even to this dayif one does not give, has no faith, and does not perform sacrifices,they say of him, ‘oh! he is Āsura demoniacal as such is the doctrine of the Asuras

units.sanskrit: प्रेतस्य शरीरं भिक्षया वसनेनालंकारेणेति संस्कुर्वन्ति ।
units.english: They deck the body of the dead with food, wrappings and ornaments;

units.sanskrit: एतेन ह्य् अम्मुं लोकं जेष्यन्तो मन्यन्ते ॥
units.english: and by this they think they are securing the other world

units.sanskrit: तस्मात्तत्संप्रदायो ऽद्याप्यनुवर्तत इतीह लोके ऽददानं दानमकुर्वाणमविभागशीलमश्रद्दधानं सत्कार्येषु श्रद्धारहितं यथाशक्त्ययजमानमयजनस्वभावमाहुरासुरः खल्वयं
units.english: For this reason, the said tradition continues to this day, in the world;if one does not give,does not bestow gifts, who has not shared his gifts,has no faith, in the performance of good deeds,and does not perform sacrifices,to the best of his capacity,is not in the habit of offering sacrifices,theythe cultured people living there, say of him‘Oh! He is Āsura demoniacal’;

units.sanskrit: असुराणां हि यस्मादश्रद्दधानतादिलक्षणैषोपनिषत् ।
units.english: and the reason for this lies in the fact that such is the doctrine of the Asuras,the doctrine ie which is marked by absence of Faith and the like

units.sanskrit: तयोपनिषदा संस्कृताः सन्तः प्रेतस्य शरीरं कुणपं भिक्षया गन्धमाल्यान्नादिलक्षणया वसनेन वस्रादिना'च्छादनादिप्रकारेणालङ्कारेण ध्वजपताकादिकरणेनेत्येवं संस्कुर्वन्त्येतेन
units.english: Those who are brought up under this doctrine, deck the body of the deadthe corpsewith food,ie with perfumes, garlands and articles of food,wrappingsclothes and other forms of coverings,and ornamentssuch as standards, flags etc;by thisdecking of the corpse,they think they are securing both regionsto be reached after death

units.sanskrit: इति च्छान्दोग्योपनिषदि अष्टमाध्यायस्याष्टमः खण्डः
units.english: End of Section of Discourse

units.sanskrit: अथ हेन्द्रो ऽप्राप्यैव देवान् एतद् भयं ददर्श । यथैव खल्व् अयम् अस्मिञ् छरीरे साध्वलंकृते साध्वलंकृतो भवति सुवसने सुवसनः परिष्कृते परिष्कृत एवम् एवायम् अस्मिन्न् अन्धे ऽन्धो भवति स्रामे स्रामः परिवृक्णे परिवृक्णः ।
units.english: Now, Indra, before getting at the Devas, saw this difficulty‘just as when the body is welladorned, it becomes welladorned,when the body is welldressed, it becomes welldressed,when the body is wellgroomed, it becomes wellgroomed,so, in the same manner, when the body becomes oneeyed, it should become oneeyed,when the body becomes crippled, it should become crippled;and when the body perishes, it should also perish’

units.sanskrit: अथ ह किलेन्द्रो ऽप्राप्यैव देवान्दैव्याक्रौर्यादिसंपदा युक्तत्वाद्गुरोर्वचनं पुनः पुनः स्मरन्नेव गच्छन्नेतद्वक्ष्यमाणं भयं स्वात्मग्रहणनिमित्तं ददर्श दृष्टवान् ।
units.english: Now, Indra, before getting at the Devas; being endowed as he was with the divine qualities of mercy and the like, he went along pondering again and again over the words of the teacher, and while so going along, he sees this difficultygoing to be set forth,in his theory of the Self

units.sanskrit: उदशरावदृष्टान्तेन प्रजापतिना यदर्थो न्याय उक्तस्तदेकदेशो मघवतः प्रत्यभाद्बुद्धौ । येन च्छायात्मग्रहणे दोषं ददर्श ।
units.english: What Prajāpati had taught him through the illustration of the watercup,a part of that teaching now flashed into Indra’s mind, whereby he perceived the difficulty that the Reflection is the Self

units.sanskrit: कथम् । यथैव खल्वयमस्मिञ्छरीरे साध्वलङ्कृते छायात्मापि साध्वलङ्कृतो भवति सुवसने च सुवसनः परिष्कृते परिष्कृतो यथा नखलोमादिदेहावयवापगमे छायात्मापि परिष्कृतो भवति नखलोमादिरहितो भवति । एवमेवायं छायात्माप्यस्मिञ्छरीरे नखलोमादिभिर्देहावयवत्वस्य तुल्यत्वादन्धे चक्षुषो ऽपगमे ऽन्धो बवति स्रामे स्रामः ।
units.english: What difficulty?Just as when the body is welladorned, itReflectionSelfalso becomes welladorned,when the body is welldressed, it becomes welldressed,when the body is wellgroomed, it becomes wellgroomed,ie on the removal of hairs, and such other parts of the body, the ReflectionSelfalso becomes ‘wellgroomed’ie free from hairs and nails and such excrescences;so, in the same manner,as the eye and the rest are as good parts of body as the Hairs and Nails,when the body becomes blind on the removal of the eyes,itthe reflectionSelfalso should become blind;when the body becomes oneeyed, it should become oneeyed the term ‘srāma’ signified oneeyed’, and as this might be included under ‘blind’, the term may be taken to stand for constantly flowing nose and Eyes;crippled,bands or legs cut off;when the body has become oneeyed or crippled, the reflection Selfalso should become so;and it should also perish when the body perishes,

units.sanskrit: तथास्य देहस्य नाशमन्वेष नश्यति ॥
units.english: ‘ see no good in this’ Then with fuel in his hand, he came back

units.sanskrit: स समित्पाणिः पुनर् एयाय । तं ह प्रजापतिर् उवाच । मघवन् यच् छान्तहृदयः प्राव्राजीः सार्धं विरोचनेन किम् इच्छन् पुनर् आगम इति । स होवाच यथा एव खल्वय्यं भगवो ऽस्मिञ् छरीरे साध्वलंकृते साध्वलंकृतो
units.english: Prajāpati said to them‘Well, Indra, as you went away, satisfied at heart, with Virocana, for what purpose have you come back?’He said‘Revered sir, as when the body is welladorned, it is welladorned,when the body is welldressed, it is welldressed,when the body is wellgroomed, it is wellgroomed,so also when the body is blind, it should be blind,when the body is oneeyed, it should become oneeyed, when the body is crippled, it should be crippled;

units.sanskrit: अस्यैव शरीरस्य नाशम् अन्व् एष नश्यति ।
units.english: and when the body perishes, it would also perish

units.sanskrit: नाहम् अत्र भोग्यं पश्यामीति ॥
units.english: Therefore, see no good in this’

units.sanskrit: अतो नाहमत्रास्मिंश्छायात्मदर्शने देहात्मदर्शने वा भोग्यं फलं पश्यामीत्येवं दोषं देहच्छायात्मदर्शने ऽध्यवस्य स समित्पाणिर्ब्रह्मचर्यं वस्तुं पुनरेयाय ।
units.english: ‘For these reasons, in thisin the doctrine that the reflection is the Self, or the body is the Self, see no good, do not see that any good can come of it’Having thus made up his mind that the doctrine of the ‘BodyReflectionSelf’ is defective,he, with fuel in his hands, came back,determind to dwell as a Religious student again

units.sanskrit: तं ह प्रजापतिरुवाचमघवन्यच्छान्तहृदयः प्राव्राजीः प्रगतवानसि विरोचनेन सार्धं किमिच्छन्पुनरागम इति । विजानन्नपि पुनः पप्रच्छेन्द्राभिप्रयाभिव्यक्तये यद्वेत्थ तेन मोपसीदेति यद्वत् ।
units.english: To him said Prajāpati‘O Indra, as you Went away, satisfied at heart, with Virocana, for what purpose have you come back ’Though knowing why he had come back, the Teacher put the question, for the purpose of bringing out Indra’s real intentions;

units.sanskrit: तथा च स्वाभिप्रयां प्रकटमकरोद्यथैव खल्वयमित्यदि, एवमेवेति चान्वमोदत प्रजापतिः ।
units.english: just as he had done Before,in the case of Sanatkumāra saying to Nārada Come to me with what you know’Indra made up his intentions clear in the sentence ‘Just as etc, etc’And this statement was acceded to by Prajāpati in the next sentence ‘So it is’

units.sanskrit: ननु तुल्ये ऽक्षिपुरुषश्रवमे देहच्छायामिन्द्रो ऽग्रहीदात्मेति देहमेव व विरोचनस्तत्किंनिमित्तम् ।
units.english: QuestionThe teaching imparted by the Teacher regarding ‘the person in the eye’ being the same to both,how was it that, while Indra understood it to mean that the Reflection of the Body was the Self, Virocana understood it to mean that the body is the Self;

units.sanskrit: तत्र मन्यते ।
units.english: what was the reason for this?

units.sanskrit: यथेन्द्रस्योदशरावादिप्रजापतिवचनं स्मरतो देवानप्राप्तस्यैवा'चार्योक्तबुद्ध्या छायात्मग्रहणं तत्र दोषदर्शनं चाभूत् । न तथा विरोचनस्य किं तर्हि देह एवा'त्मदर्शनं नापि तत्र दोषदर्शनं बभूव ।
units.english: In the case of Indra, when he remembered the words of Prajāpati relating to the ‘Watercup’, before he got at the Devas, the idea came to him that what the Teacher had taught was that the Reflection was the Self, and in that idea he perceived a difficulty;such was not the case with Virocana; he understood the body itself to be the Self,and he perceived no difficulty in this doctrine

units.sanskrit: तद्वदेव विद्याग्रहणसामर्थ्यप्रतिबन्धदोषाल्पत्वबहुत्वापेक्षमिन्द्रविरोचनयोश्छायात्मदेहयोर्ग्रहणम् ।
units.english: Similarly, the fact that while Indra understood the Reflection to be the Self, Virocana understood the body itself to be the Self,was due to the smaller or larger deficiency in their capacity of understanding Philosophy;

units.sanskrit: इन्द्रो ऽल्पदोषत्वाद्दृश्यत इतिश्रुत्यर्थमेव श्रद्दधानतया जग्राहेतरश्छायानिमित्तं देहं हित्वा श्रुत्यर्थं लक्षणया जग्राह प्रजापतिनोक्तो
